{"lines":[{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以日爲主者如人行君之令四柱尊日爲主也法運四時者春夏秋冬也假如孟春木旺火生木能生火也孟夏火旺土生火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"能生土也孟秋金旺水生金能生水也孟冬冬旺木生水能生木也土旺四季辰戌丑未月也故法運四時剛柔之情者隂有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"剛柔陽有刚柔月令有氣日剛無氣曰柔内外否泰之道年月日時也三元配合天干地支凡天千地支透出日外暗藏日内","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"否塞也泰通也一歲之週歲有十二月日有十二時葢積時成歲歲與日陰陽之主也歲之正朝日之從朝君臣之朝合從命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也臣禀命於君推之行之於身也故人臣行君之合則有貴賤吉凶之重葢能期日不能期月日能期歲不能期日也故言日爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主日之主者法運四時法從常也葢天地之氣有囚時常用五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007493929549859"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旺七十二日秋之氣凉金旺七十二日冬之氣寒木旺七十二日四季月土各旺十八日共計三百六十日以成歲功歲云播","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歲功四季以年陰陽者甲丙戊庚壬傷陽干乙丁巳辛癸爲陰干凡推五行陰陽五配上下不相偏者爲貴命也若柱中有偏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陰偏陽者刚柔也見如木用金爲官其金秋生或带水人則金剛矣若金春夏生带丙丁則木强而金柔矣凡陰陽偏枯不成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"配偶雖金木見官鬼妻財不北反爲仁義俱無剛柔不濟故偏陰偏陽之謂疾此謂之有情無情也凡術者且要眀剛柔之情","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"坤識其牲牲金木定居剛柔也凡看命者专以日上也賦云乾天元爲主定其禍福荣枯之埋支上天元日能支中所藏者内","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天干與地支中所藏者人元或爲官爲福爲禍方可定其吉凶之理且如甲日生甲子爲印綬甲寅爲建禄甲辰爲財庫甲午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲妻財甲申爲官鬼甲戌爲財官若人月生正氣官大貴命也甲以辛酉金爲官星若有丁火傷辛金之官柱中有癸水喜制","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"其丁火故癸水乃甲之印綬也更表推詳四柱内外吉凶而宜之當言元有財官運臨財官多是荣逹之命也元無財官復行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財官而不發也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以日爲主年月時中看有官無官有財無財有甲無印則貴賤可知故年可爲根苗看年月中先有財官印𦆵是根苗先有氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也然後内不可象開花結果也經曰根在苗先實在花後日爲己身捜用八字有得吉神凶神格局之類喜者取之忌者捨之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"賦云喜者存之憎者棄之日干弱則木氣旺之藉口干旺却嫌氣旺怕太過反爲不足之命由此损財傷妻本是天元地支故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"看根苗花果之説仔細詳之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四柱年月日時貴賤高低則有根苗花實之類如人命元有財官運臨財官則爲福當主無財官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"運臨財官則亦不爲福爲根先生而後苖花開而後有實覌乎前兆以察其源根在苗先實在花後又擇四柱之中以年爲祖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上根基田宅世代宗派之宫若與年月日合爲富貴更生月時不夾刑害生年則宗祖根基光華而不衰也更得祖上名譽寶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"堪廕祖先田宅之福爲荣華而永不衰也若反此則不然矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以主月爲父母之宫若月内有財官之星旺盛無冲破更生日天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"元居生養之地則人承父母之福日干居死衰之地爲人須有父母之福終不爲久長親廕也以日爲己身者是生日天元乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007493929599011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人己身也自得之宫必須推詳生日天元看臨何宫之分更看年月時中有何格局若貴人禄馬之類並無諸破害便爲好命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"直此生旺無刑害則喜而取之爲福若當生之神而逢死絶休敗更直刑害冲破則憎而棄之爲禍者干衰而求氣旺之藉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"且","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如壬癸巳午之類皆生日天元臨死絶之地爲身弱也壬癸以丙子爲財星以戊巳爲官星巳午火王臨官生旺之地更加九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夏四季生則有官星並祿馬之星爲有福氣之慶當有餘木也若壬癸生人在冬月生雖日干特其氣旺終身以不取富也若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財官之氣俱皆旺水火死土日也若人遇之平生逸塞奔馳難享用之人也□班亦多成敗則官将不成財将不進矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"且如庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅日乃是天下氣衰弱也三命云爲命多削遇鬼方受官旺當有財官之貴矣爲人當以乙木爲財丁火爲官寅甲木臨官丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"火長生为官之星也爲人當以全之分看春夏則偏矣秋冬生人要建旺财官之氣退散遇死絶休囚之地爲人常有不足之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"宫家道寂寞難治也定是克妻害子矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"干與支同者甲寅乙卯之類又日若地支同局之命則損財傷妻更月令氣旺年時未见財官又有格局窮必徹骨矣凡干旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲妻財財乃生日干克他爲財之星也若柱中财多而日旺者凡舉動無不稱意經云處世安然財運有氣若反此財多而日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"干弱者此命定因妻財而致禍則并力衰不能任厚福財多身旺者假如己末年戊辰月甲寅日癸酉時如甲以戊巳爲財年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月自建居财库當生年又如巳未土重乃天元贵人带財合申申禄自建其官禄财多官旺則多稱意也假如一命乙酉年壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午月壬午日癸卯時壬癸以丙丁爲財五月自恃财旺之丁逢火禄之鄉壬癸胎元絶之地爲身弱不能任重財見壬癸爲比","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"局分財故因妻以致祸卒死牢獄之中術經云六壬生臨午位号曰禄馬同鄉此言之論虚謂年月日時有卯字尅子午中巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"禄之官故曰六壬日禄馬同鄉是也賦云福星臨而禍發以表凶人干與支同如甲寅之類雖然强健無他殘疾多主損財傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"妻若年月日時别入他格或遇四柱中財官田之星是贵显有權之命也若三元無他格四柱又無財官印反生氣旺之月日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有背禄逐馬之星此輩主穹必彻骨尅妻多數終身無禄則是常人賦云小盈大虧恐是刼財之地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此論拱貴拱禄二格乃两位虚拱貴禄之地四柱不可占了貴禄之宫則填實不容物矣只爲吉星榮顯也其禄貴者拱之成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"物之器皿若空則容物乃貴禄榮顯經云官崇禄顯定知夾禄之鄉又忌傷子日時皆拱不住矣假如丁巳丙午甲寅甲子旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是壬郞中之命此二甲來夾丑中之癸氣丑中癸水餘氣辛金庫基己土東旺乃甲木之財官之命生豈不爲貴後運行辛丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"除通判入庚子運庚金尅甲木又是年月冲破甲子乃天中杀即空亡夾貴不住走了貴人一旦壞了","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此論偏官之格若四柱中全無一㸃官星用七杀爲偏官者有丑官此謂七杀之鬼乃生天干也故未見不見之形全要日干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生旺故喜身旺怕冲長辛月只要制伏不要四柱見正官有兄不顯其弟之説或四柱中歲運或是六官留杀何也乃制伏是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也若官杀混雜不爲清福只此偏官七杀者乃小人之軰多兇暴無忌禪乃能劳力以着君子也怕是不懲不刑無衝以控制","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之則不能馳伏而爲用矣若四柱中元無制伏要行制伏之運四柱中元有制伏要行身旺之鄉若有制伏又行制伏之運葢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲盡法無名之揄假如巳未乙亥丙寅辛卯乃王章明相公命也乃月偏官制伏住年上兼日坐長生之火三合壬日逢貴所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以發禄後遭刑戮無棺槨初行壬申趣福運矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刼財乃是日上天元分争財禄比肩是也羊刃者日干禄前一位是也且如禄馬甲禄在寅甲用己士爲財見卯为刃來相侵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"奪己土也假如戊午月併月時相司者二三了戊字者其相侵奪矣水爲財故曰刼財以戊禄在巳前一辰見午午有己上尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸水此之謂刼財羊刃故主破財散業𩀌家失祖施恩反怨心性卒暴進退狐疑偏主庶妻爲正带疾破相性貪婪智大心高","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"傷害不足若運流年逢之因財争競不然疾病運連妻子矣〇假如癸未乙卯甲子己巳此岳飛将軍命此爲去財羊刃甲以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007493929844771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無殺女人之命一貴可作良人","logicSentenceId":"7679069386909548607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此甲日生人見卯，乃爲羊刅，遇酉金而冲之，見戌而合之，則禍","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801244723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801244723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若當生四柱中元有羊刄之神，忽來相對，尅破流年太歲，或","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801261107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合相招，尅害嵗君，則其勃然禍至。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801261107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若嵗乙","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801277491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：財多生官雖要身强，財多盗氣本身","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801326643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柔。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801326643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如甲乙庚辛","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801343027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲官，戊巳爲財氣得天干生旺，則土生金，金乃木之官也，而先","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801343027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧後富，葢是","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801343027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：旺財以𣏂化權，衰則變官爲鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801392179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如甲乙生人，巳午亥爲","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801408563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身灾失天時，見庚辛申酉來尅，不夭則貧則賤矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801408563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼以丁爲財馬，己爲祿官，丁巳祿居午，故曰祿馬同鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801441331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格喜","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801457715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋生，有庚辛金其甲乙，故爲遠害。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801457715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見寅卯旺，則文秀而不明；","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801474099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬生立武當權，知是火財而分端。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801474099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801490483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日以戊爲官，丙爲財，乃丙戊祿在巳也，故日財官䨇羙。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801539635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801556019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱巾不要見水局，時逢癸丑不爲凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801556019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何故巳中戊士，丑中癸","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801572403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水，水餘氣，乃","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801572403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是財馬也。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801588787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財多身弱，正爲富屋貧人。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801605171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如甲申年王申月丙申日辛卯時，申中有庚金，乃財多，又有","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801621555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬水，乃七杀制日，主身弱之甚也。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801621555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此是富家營幹之命也。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801637939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以殺化權，定顯寒門貴客。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801654323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵偏官化爲官星，如丙忌壬爲𣏂，己午財反恃土之勢，則𡈼","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801670707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不能爲害，化杀爲官，癸于白屋。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801670707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱中有土，則丙𡈼時以爲","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801687091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"極品之","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801687091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"混雜，行此運，幼年必正。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801752627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"登科及第，","logicSentenceId":"7679065785801769011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有官有印，乃雜氣所藏官印也。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785802014771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼谷子云：罡中有乙，魁中伏辛，","logicSentenceId":"7679065785802031155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此爲雜氣印綬財官也，乃少年不發庫中人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785802031155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如丙寅、辛丑，","logicSentenceId":"7679065785802047539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰、丙寅，此延生俊命中用辛爲官，己土爲財，癸爲印，提綱中","logicSentenceId":"7679065785802047539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有癸水餘氣，产余庫墓，巳生見旺，故得謚封之貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785802047539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無官無印有格，乃朝廷之用，","logicSentenceId":"7679065785802063923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正氣雜氣，慿財官印綬，爲貴格，富貴之命。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785802080307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若成格局，要全無一","logicSentenceId":"7679065785802096691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"點財官，","logicSentenceId":"7679065785802096691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如南貴之命矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785802096691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如己未壬申，戊子庚申，此乃謝左","logicSentenceId":"7679065785802113075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"承相之命，此名專食合祿之格。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785802113075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱中全無一點財官印綬，","logicSentenceId":"7679065785802129459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以戊用乙官，癸財丁印，四柱中全無矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785802129459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取戊食庚午甲申建戊","logicSentenceId":"7679065785802145843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祿，戊祿旺巳，與","logicSentenceId":"7679065785802145843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺逢正氣，官星又行旺連，必登科及弟。","logicSentenceId":"7679065785802211379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱中是飛天祿","logicSentenceId":"7679067329719697458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬，冲官合祿，乃人","logicSentenceId":"7679067329719697458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"臣極貴也，冲官者止。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有","logicSentenceId":"7679067329719697458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日，見上","logicSentenceId":"7679067329719697458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱中用作財官，見所忌，非格局有財官，此等命不","logicSentenceId":"7679067329719762994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小人命内亦有正印官星，","logicSentenceId":"7679067329719812146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬者，怕逢財氣壞印，官星者，畏見傷官必敗。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329719828530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱中雖有","logicSentenceId":"7679067329719844914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官印綬，遇其傷害不成，","logicSentenceId":"7679067329719844914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" ","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/book-ref/platform-import/7456690885183864886/1-b039f2ca56680fbb.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=uTm2Cbe%2BThm21zfnnhtgcM1F3eI%3D","uri":"read/HY1117/23/ref/1koehnhiw3k09/1-b039f2ca56680fbb.webp","fontType":1,"components":"氵匕𠃊⺝八","variants":"滇","charPicId":"7456690885183864886"},"logicSentenceId":"7679067329719844914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"各反爲凶惡，豈不爲小人哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679067329719844914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子格中也犯七殺羊刃，","logicSentenceId":"7679067329719861298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七𣏂有制，化爲官，羊刃無冲，極爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329719877682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏官發于白屋，羊刃起于","logicSentenceId":"7679067329719894066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"邊戍，爲將爲相，豈不爲君子者哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679067329719894066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刃與杀主誅戮之權，","logicSentenceId":"7679067329719910450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲人好殺，羊刃必犯于偏官。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329719926834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃者，在天爲紫暗星，專行誅戮，在地爲羊刅𣏂。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329719943218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏官者，七杀","logicSentenceId":"7679067329719959602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之暗鬼，羊刃又犯七爻，人多主凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329719959602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇貴人吉，則無大惡，","logicSentenceId":"7679067329719975986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"素食慈心，印綬遂逢於天德。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329719992370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如命中元犯凶神惡杀，若遇天月二德神救之，則凶不逞矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720008754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720025138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"綬本慈","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720025138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"善。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之神，又逢天德、月德相助，主人心慈而食齋矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720025138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生平少病，日主高强，","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720041522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日主自旺，爲恃旺杀，乃是本主得地，自恃旺鄉，其人沈病不染。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720057906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耆年齒牢髪黑，强其体骨，天元遇数，順身遠害，欣然無憂，樂天","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720074290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之命","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720074290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720090674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583005490869174291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一世安然。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720107058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財命有氣，","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720123442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此論","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720139826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，妻財馬也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720139826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財旺有氣，來助我身乘旺，必享財而用之，","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720156210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是得安然之樂矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720156210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲生於辰戌丑未之鄕，皆作財有氣，","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720172594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宮刑不犯印綬，天德同宮，","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720188978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行自得天時，名爲恃。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720205362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有印綬扶身，又帶天月二德，則一","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720221746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生不犯官刑之論，","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720221746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少樂多憂，葢因日主自弱。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720238130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言日主無氣，落於哀鄉，又失了天元氣，特鬼敗之鄉矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720254514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏多","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720270898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主奴婢之下，孤募臨於五墓，一生憂悶不足之命也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720270898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身强殺淺，假殺爲權。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720287282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如丙戌日見壬辰是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720303666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生於四五月，依此而断。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720320050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"碧玉歌云：化","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720336434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"杀爲權何取甲生寅卯之鄉，更逢亥卯未成行，何怕庚金作党。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720336434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙生己酉丑，只喜逢木局相當。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720352818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢亥卯未生殃，處世艱難","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720369202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧漢。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720385586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺重身輕，終身有損。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720401970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戌寅、壬戌、壬戌、己酉别也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720418354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月時暗有","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720434738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌士爲七殺，故傷身也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720451122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰則變官爲鬼，旺則化鬼爲官。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720467506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若曰主哀弱，縱有官星當他不得，故𦇥官爲鬼矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720483890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若日主旺成，","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720500274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有七杀，其杀自降伏，當化鬼爲官，乃主大富貴之命也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720500274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583005490869190675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月生日干，運行不喜財鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720516658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月生日干，即印綬也，印乃母也，故日生忌財破之。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720533042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若運行入財","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720549426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鄉，謂之貪財破印。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720549426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"譬如爲官者，掌印貪財，百姓之財","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720565810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不聚。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720565810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰主無依，却喜運行財地。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720582194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙生於春月，柱中若無財官，謂之無依。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720598578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若行辰戌丑未運，以","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720614962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"士爲用，方可發福。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720614962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘者作此而推。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720631346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如背運不可言福。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720647730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時歸日禄，生平不喜官星。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720664114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命中日祿居時者，最怕官星，所以强破祿，反貴爲賤矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720680498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"璧玉","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720696882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720696882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720696882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居時最妙，年提畏煞官星。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720696882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見官星，則剝祿矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720713266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰若朝陽，切忌丙丁離位。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720729650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言六辛日見戊子時也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720746034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲月若見丙丁二字，乃南方火傷了","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720762418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛所，","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720762418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以不得朝陽，以成眞格局。若不見丙丁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆主大富貴命官","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720762418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"居一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"品之尊，此爲喜忌篇云：六","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720762418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時逢戊子嫌，午欣運喜酉","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720762418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方同。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329720762418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"見丙字，露出官星，見丁字，乃七𣏂尅辛，此說非虚矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星不爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329939308553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合七殺爲正凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329939324937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行有救助之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329939341321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱煞旺運純身旺，爲官淸貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329939357705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此七殺即偏官也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329939374089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言制伏四柱，丙以殺爲宜。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329939390473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如甲忌庚爲殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329939406857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而甲生于寅地，乃身旺，其甲暗包丙長生，則不畏金爲殺，以又","logicSentenceId":"7679067329939423241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化爲官星，則甲庚合自恃旺之","logicSentenceId":"7679067329939423241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勢，而行純旺，乃爲極品之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329983938587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡見天元大弱，內有弱處復生，","logicSentenceId":"7679067329983954971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此論日主自坐官殺，乃爲人元，弱處復生，乃是胎生元命。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329983971355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如","logicSentenceId":"7679067329983987739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲胎在申中，申有庚金，與辛爲偏官，爲六合中受氣，相感氣生","logicSentenceId":"7679067329983987739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胎元，得干木長生，西上沐浴，戊土冠帶，亥上臨官，如人之","logicSentenceId":"7679067329983987739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"算日，必生木矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984004123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格只要官星旺運，方可發福，不要冲尅。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984020507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筋疼骨痛，葢因木被金傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984118811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訣曰：甲木于衰不旰運提辛酉庚申歲逢巳，𮠕丑來臨，瞽目風","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984135195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顚邪𤵁。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984135195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙曰身衰同論己𮠕丑字相刑，未逢此地，四肢寕，須作","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984151579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自矜。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984151579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼昏目暗，必是火遭水尅。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984167963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肝属木，心属火，腎属水，水尅火，無相","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984184347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之道，故有眼暗目昏之疾者矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984200731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下元冷疾，必是水值火傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984217115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水入巽而見金，名爲不絶。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984331803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬水受氣於巳水，得金","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984348187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而能生水，故曰不絶。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984364571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金木交差，刑戰，仁義俱無，水火𨓠互相傷，是非日有","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984430107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木從水養，水盛而木則漂流；","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984479259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水生木弱，用金土爲官，大旺財官失矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984495643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"訣曰：甲子生居子地，但","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984512027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984512027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一二爲竒，壬癸亥子宫干。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支則不漂流無竒。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984512027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥年提庚子，","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984528411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984528411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984528411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984528411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"支","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年逢丁酉，運","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984528411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申隨弱水之災未儗。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984544795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金以木火爲財官，若土太多，","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984577563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看命要審節氣淺深，旺相休囚，法留舒配順逆向背之理，只以","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984626715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中和爲貴，命旺相爲福，若休囚死絶，非格非局，爲下賤矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984626715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行提綱。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984659483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡㸔命排下八字，以日于爲主，取年爲根，爲上祖財產，","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984675867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290725666835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知世派之盛衰；取月爲苗，爲父母，則知親荫之有無。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984692251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日干爲己","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984708635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身，曰支爲妻妾，則知妻妾之賢淑。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984708635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時爲花實爲子息，方知嗣續","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984725019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之所歸。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984725019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法分月氣淺深，得令不得令。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984741403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年時露出財官，須要身旺。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984757787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如身衰財旺，但多反破財傷妻。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984774171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺財多，財亦旺，財多稱意。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984790555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984806939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無財官，次看印綬得何局式，吉凶斷之。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984806939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學者不可拘執，如不知","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984823323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通變也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984823323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
