{"lines":[{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫正官者，甲見辛之類，乃陰見陽爲官，陽見陰爲官，陰陽配合，成","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984856091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其道也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984856091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵要行官旺鄉，月令是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984872475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月令者，提剛也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984888859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看命先㸔提","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984905243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剛，方看其餘。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984905243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"既曰正官運，復行得官旺之鄕，成是有成局，又行不","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984921627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官之地，并金財旺之鄉，皆是作福之處。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984921627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正官乃貴氣之物，大忌","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984938011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑冲破害，及于年月時干，皆有官星隱露，恐福渺矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984938011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又須看年時","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984954395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上别有是何入格作福去處，方可斷其吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984954395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"茍一途而執取之，則","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984970779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290725683219"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不能通變，必有差毫釐，謬千里之患。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984970779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：通變以爲神者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329984987163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985003547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官或多，反不爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985003547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何以言之？","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985019931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢人之命，宜得中和之氣，太過與不","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985036315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及，固中和之氣爲福厚，偏當之尅爲災殃。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985036315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣用提綱作正官，年時","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985052699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支干位或有一偏官，便難矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985052699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不可不仔細以輕重推測也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985069083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰干月令得之是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985085467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜身旺印綬，如田辛官喜土生官，最怕刑","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985101851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲破害，羊刃七殺，爲貧命。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985101851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如時干逢殺，乃官殺混雜，葢四柱有刑","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985118235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲破害，皆未爲貴命。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985118235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看官來剋我，我去剋官，不爲害。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985134619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一位若兩官","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985151003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985151003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若月令中有正官，時干支有偏官，便難。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985167387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以正官言之，且如甲","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985183771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用辛爲官，生于八月中氣之後，金旺在西，故謂之正官。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985183771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如天干不","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985200155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"透出辛字，𨚫地支有己酉丑，雖不能於八月中氣之後，亦可吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985200155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985216539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天要身旺，時辰歸於甲木無處。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985216539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如歲時透出正官，地支又有官格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985232923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"却不拘八月中氣之後。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985232923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大率官星須得印綬，身旺則發，若無傷官","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985249307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破印，身不弱者，便爲貴命。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985249307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如命中有官星，而行傷官之運，則不吉，","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985265691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290725699603"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必待印綬官星旺運可發，必得官。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985265691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論官星太過","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985282075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如壬癸生人，四柱是辰戌、丑未、已午，天千不露官星與殺，則官殺","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985298459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暗藏於中爲多。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985298459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱元有爲好。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985314843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無制伏，須行木運，與三合木","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985331227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"局亦好。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985331227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡官星多則雜，務要除而淸之，乃可發福。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985347611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若官星多，又","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985363995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行官運，亦不濟事。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985363995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論偏官。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985380379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"即七殺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫偏官者，葢甲木見庚金之類，陽見陽，陰見陰，乃爲之偏官，不成","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985396763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"配偶。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985396763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"猶如經言二女不能同居，二男不可並處是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985413147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏官卽七煞，","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985429531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要制伏。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985429531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢偏官七煞即小人。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985445915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小人無知，多凶暴，無忌憚，乃能勞","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985462299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"力以養君子，而服役護御君子者，小人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985462299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟是不懲不戒，無術。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985478683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以控制之，則不能馴伏而爲用。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985495067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故楊子曰：御得其道，則徂詐或作","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985511451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"使；御失其道，則徂詐或作敵。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985511451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小人有徂詐也，要控御得其道矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985527835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290725715987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"失控御小人得𭬳，則禍立見矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985544219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：人有偏官，如抱虎而眠，難","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985560603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其威足以挕羣畜，稍失関防，必爲其噬臍，不可不慮也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067329985560603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇三刑","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030075913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俱全，羊刃在日，及時，又有六害，復遇魁罡相冲，如是人之凶，不可","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030075913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"具述。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030075913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制伏得位，運復經行制伏之鄉，此大貴之命也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030092297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"茍於前者囚","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030108681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神俱聚，運游煞旺之鄉，凶害有不可言者矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030108681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030125065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如有一煞而制","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030141449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏有二三，復行制伏之運，反不作福。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030141449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何以言之？","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030157833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢盡法無法，雖猛","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030174217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如狼，不能制伏矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030174217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是又不可專言制伏，要須輕重得所，不可太甚，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030190601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦不可不及。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030190601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須仔細審詳而言，則禍福如影響矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030206985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：有制伏則爲偏官，無制伏則爲七殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030223369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"譬諸小人御之，得其道","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030239753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則可使，失其道則難敵，在吾控御之道何如耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030239753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡見此殺，勿便言","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030256137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶，殊不知帶此殺者，多有貴命。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030256137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇三刑、六害，或羊刃、魁罡相冲，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030272521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如是之凶，不可謂之制伏，但運行制伏，此貴人命也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030272521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟如前凶神","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030288905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俱聚，其運復行殺旺之鄉，禍不可言。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030288905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵傷官七煞，最喜身旺，有","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030305289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290725732371"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制伏爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030305289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元有制伏，可行殺旺之方；元無制依，可行制伏之運。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030321673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030338057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺化之，得爲偏官；身弱無制伏，則爲七煞制伏，復行制伏運，謂之","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030338057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大過，則為偏官無餘者矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030338057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月中之氣，怕冲爲羊刃，其本身弱，若殺","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030354441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"强，則恐難制。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030354441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如身强淺，則是假殺爲權刃。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030370825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如或七殺，不怕與冲，宜","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030387209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詳之。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030387209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論七殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030403593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"即偏官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫七殺者，亦名偏官，喜身旺合殺，喜制伏，喜羊刃，忌身弱，忌見財。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030419977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生忌無制：身旺有氣爲偏官，身弱無制爲七殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030436361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡有此殺，不可便","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030452745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030452745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有正官，不如有偏官，多有巨富大貴之人，惟其身旺合殺爲","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030469129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030469129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲以庚爲七殺，喜丙丁制之，乙合之，謂之貪合忘殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030485513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺却","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030501897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜制伏，亦不要制之太過。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030501897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢物極則反爲禍矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030518281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺又行身旺之","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030534665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030534665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如身弱又行身弱之鄉，禍不全踵。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030551049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱中元有制伏，喜行","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030567433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺運，元無制伏，七殺出爲禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030567433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如行年旺鄉，更有羊刃，貴不可言。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030583817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290725748755"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且忌財旺，財能生殺故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030600201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲運臨之，身旺亦多災，身弱尤甚。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030616585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申、","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030632969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉、丁丑","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030632969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊寅、己卯、辛未、癸未，此七曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐殺，性急令俐，心巧聰明，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030632969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如見殺者者，主人凶夭貧薄。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030632969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月見之重，時見之輕。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030649353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何謂曰？","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030665737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺只","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030682121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一位見之。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030682121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如年時再見，殺多爲禍，却要制伏之鄉，又要身旺有制","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030698505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏爲權，最怕冲與羊刃大凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030698505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時七殺只一位，要本身旺。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030714889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如年、月將","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030731273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三處有制伏爲福，却要行殺旺運，運三合得地亦發。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030731273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無制伏，則","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030747657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要行制伏爲福，行殺旺運，無制伏則禍作。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030747657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030764041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺却不怕羊刃，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030764041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而亦不畏冲。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030764041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辛丑、乙未、乙卯、丙子，此命身旺，生于六月之臾，歲","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030780425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干透用辛丑爲七煞，喜得丙子合辛丑之殺，乃貴而有權。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030780425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如甲","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030796809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午、丙寅、庚子、丙子，此命身弱，見火局，又見月令丙寅七殺時，又見","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030796809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子，火尅庚金，金死於子，身弱殺旺，又無制伏，宜乎帶病貧薄。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030796809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030813193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳、戊申、壬子、戊申，此命身旺，见二戊爲七殺，引歸於己，丁與壬","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030813193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合，戊與癸合，金又長生於巳，戊祿在已，乃壬戌𠄠字俱旺，所以","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030813193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290725765139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030813193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論印綬，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030829577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂印生我者，即印綬也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030845961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：有官無印即非眞官，有印無官反。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030862345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成其福。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030878729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何以言之？","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030895113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大扺人生得物以相助，相生相養，使我得萬物","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030911497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之見成，豈不妙乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030911497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故主人多智慮，兼豐厚。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030927881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢叩綬畏則主人括囊，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030944265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故四柱中及運行官貴，反成其福。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030944265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢官鬼能生我，只畏其財，而財","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030960649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能反傷我。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030960649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此印綬之妙者，多是受父母之廕，承父之貲財，見成安","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030977033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"享之人者。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030977033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又以兩三命相併，當以印綬多者爲上，又主一生少病，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030993417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能飮食。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330030993417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或若財多乘旺，必多淹留。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031009801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖喜官鬼，而官鬼多或八挌，又","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031026185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不可專以印綬言之。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031026185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如甲乙日得亥子月生，丙丁日得寅卯月","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031042569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生，戊巳曰得巳午月生，庚辛日得辰戌丑未月生，壬癸日得申酉","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031042569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月生者，是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031042569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘以類言之，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031058953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最怕行印綬死絶之運，或運臨死絶，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031075337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"復有物以竊之，即入黃泉，無可疑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031075337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫印綬者，生我之謂也，亦各","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031091721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290725781523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031091721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以陽見陰，以陰見陽，謂之正印；陽見陽，陰見陰，謂之偏印。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031108105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031124489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星生印，忌財旺破印。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031124489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲人見亥子月中水爲印，忌火傷官，忌","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031140873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十破印。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031140873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要行生旺之鄉，怕行死絶，若行死絕之地，或有物以傷之，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031157257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則危矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031157257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬之人，智慮一生少病，能飽食豐厚，享見成財祿。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031173641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若兩","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031190025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命相並，當以印綬多者取之。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031190025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最忌財來乘旺，必生淹滯。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031206409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若官鬼","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031222793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多，或入别格，又不可專以印論。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031222793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡月與時上見者爲妙，而月上","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031239177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最爲𦂳要。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031239177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先論月氣之後有生氣，必得父毋之力；年下有生氣，必","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031255561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得祖宗之力；有時上見之，有生氣，必得子孫之力。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031255561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽元耐久，晚景","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031271945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"優游。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031271945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如帶印綬，須帶官星，謂之官印兩全，必爲貴命。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031288329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若官星雖見","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031304713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成，得父母力，爲福亦厚也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031304713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須行官星運便發，或行印綬運亦發若。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031321097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用官不顯，用印綬爲妙，最怕四柱中歲運臨財鄉，以傷其印。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031337481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若傷","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031353865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印，主破家離祖出妙，又臨死絶之地，若非降官失職，必夭其壽。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031353865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031370249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊戌庚申、癸酉庚申，此命癸曰生於七月中氣之後，月時門是","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031370249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290725797907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申，自坐金庫，所以印綬𦴹干，又透出戊官，謂之官印兩生，極爲","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031370249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴命。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031370249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如癸亥、癸玄、甲寅甲子，此曰用癸爲印，印却旺，緣無財星","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031386633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相助，發福不厚也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031386633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如甲寅庚午、戊戌壬子，此曰戊用丁爲印綬，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031403017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有寅午戌火局爲好，不合時上壬子水旺，財能冲印，所以失明生","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031403017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，是丙丁火屬木故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031403017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如己卯丁卯、丙辰壬辰，此命用卯爲印，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031419401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用癸爲官，年有卯日在辰，所以官印兩全，少年淸要，至四十二三","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031419401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲，癸亥運亦不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031419401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至庚申年，水七殺生於申，乃被庚申破印，故不","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031435785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031435785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論正財","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031452169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主尅母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何謂之正財，猶如正官之意，是陰見陽財，陽見陰財。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031468553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大扺正官，吾","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031484937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻之財也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031484937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之女賫財以事我，必精神康强，然後可以享用之。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031501321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031517705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吾身方且自萎懦而不振，雖妻則豊厚，但能目視，終不可一毫受","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031517705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031517705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故財要得時，不要財多。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031534089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若財多，則自家日本有力，可以勝任，當","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031550473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290725814291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化作官，天元一氣羸","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031550473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"音雷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弱，貧薄難治，是樂於身旺，不要行尅制之","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031550473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031550473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅制者，官鬼也，又怕所生之月令，正吾衰病之地。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031566857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又四柱無父","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031583241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母以生之，反則又見財，謂之財多不喜，力不任財，禍患百出，雖少","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031583241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年經休因之位，故不如意，多事頻併，或中年，或末年，復臨父母之","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031583241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鄉，或三合可以助我者，則勃然而興，不可御也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031583241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘少年乗旺，老在。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031599625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脫局不惟窮途㥢惶，兼且是非紛起。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031616009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢財者，起爭之端也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031632393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若或四","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031648777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱相生，别帶貴格，不値空亡，又行旺運，三合財生，是皆貴命。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031648777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031665161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福之淺深，皆隨入格輕重而言之。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031665161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財多生官，要須身徤。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031681545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財多盜氣，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031697929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本自身業，年運又或傷財，必生奇禍，或帶刑併七殺凶不可。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330031697929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：正財者，喜身旺印綬，忌官星，忌倒食，忌身弱，比肩刼財，不可","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084601894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言官星，恐盜財之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084601894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜印綬者，能生，主身弱故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084618278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如甲日用","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084634662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己爲正財，如身弱，其禍立至。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084634662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人命帶財下生，須出富豪，不螟蛉，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084651046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必庶出，或冲父母，身旺無刼財，無官星爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084651046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若命中有官星得地","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084667430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290725830675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行，喜財星多生官；無有財星得地運行，忌見官星，恐尅其身，怕","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084667430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身弱也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084667430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵財不論偏正，皆喜印綬，必能發福。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084683814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辛丑、丁酉、丁巳、","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084700198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未，此命，丁日身坐財之地，又見己酉丑金局，故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084700198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財旺。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084716582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢金得","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084732966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木庫居未，能生丁火，故身旺能當其身，運行東南方，宜乎巨冨。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084732966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084749350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用壬官，用庚金爲財，生壬官，身入旺鄕，必能發福。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084749350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡用財不見官","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084765734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084765734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如庚申、乙酉、丙申、丙申，此命，丙曰見三申爲財，豈不美","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084782118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"哉。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084782118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙用癸官，用辛爲財，見三申一酉爲財，故旺。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084798502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋緣日弱火病，申","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084814886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死酉，乃爲無氣，運行西方金鄉，身弱太甚，財旺生鬼，敗尅其身，故","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084814886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不能勝其財，所以貧也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084814886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如乙卯、癸未、辛酉、戊子，此命，辛日坐酉","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084831270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年，乙生卯，身與財俱旺，又得癸未食神、戊子印綬助之，宜乎臣富","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084831270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084831270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如戊子、丁巳、甲辰、丙寅，此命，甲日生于四月下旬，並透出","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084847654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁火，生其月中之戊土，時又歸祿于寅，故財旺矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084847654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然甲木身亦","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084864038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，早年行戊午巳行運，迤𨓦行辛酉運，乃見官星則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084864038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌運有","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084880422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290725847059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬尅，而傷官食神之中，失官去財，死喪合家。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084880422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"値五十九歲，入癸亥","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084896806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺運，稍可安逸，六十五歲，運壬辰年死矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084896806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初運傷官見財格，取","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084913190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊士爲財，所以戊午、己未二運大旺生土，故財厚矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084913190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及至庚申、辛","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084929574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉，西方見官，故凡事費力。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084929574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖癸亥爲甲木之印綬，然亦忌木冲火，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084945958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥中又有元土，壬辰透出壬水，運中命中元有之，辰死無疑矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084945958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084962342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官見財格，忌見官星。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084962342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若財格要見，大忌見壬水尅火，則火木能","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084978726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生甲木之士財也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084978726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論偏財","logicSentenceId":"7679067330084995110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何謂之偏財？","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085011494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢陽見陽財，陰見陰財也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085027878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然而偏財者，乃衆人之財","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085044262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也，只恐兄弟姊妹有奪之，則福不全。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085044262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有官星，禍患百出，故曰偏","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085060646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財好出，亦不懼藏，惟怕有以分奪，反空亡耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085060646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有一於此，官將不成，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085077030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財將不住，經曰：背祿逐馬，守窮途而㥢惶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085077030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財弱亦待歴叨鄕而","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085093414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"榮。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085093414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財盛無鬼，住而不妙，且恐身勢無力耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085109798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏財主人慨康，不甚文，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085126182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290725863443"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恐大旺，兄弟不止財豐，亦能官旺。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085126182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何以言之？","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085142566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢財盛自生官矣，但","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085158950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"等行官鄕便多詐。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085158950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢財能利己，亦能招誨，運行旺相，福祿俱臻，只","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085175334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"復被官之尅，必多破壊，亦不美。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085175334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財多，須看財與我之日干强弱相","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085191718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"等，行官鄉，便可發祿。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085191718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若財盛而身弱，運至官鄕，是旣被財之盗氣，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085208102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後被官之尅身，非惟不發祿，亦防禍患。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085208102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如命四杜中元帶官星，便","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085224486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作好命看。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085224486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱中兄弟輩出鄕入官鄕，發祿必渺矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085240870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰：要在","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085257254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"識其變通矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085257254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論食神","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085273638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神者，生我財神之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085290022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲屬木，丙屬火，名盜氣，故謂之食神。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085306406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085322790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知丙能生我，戊土中食丙之戊財，故以此名之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085339174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食中","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085355558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶此者，主人財厚食豐，腹量寬洪，肌體肥大，優游","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085355558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白足，有子息，有","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085371942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽考。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085388326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恒不喜見官星，忌倒食，恐傷其食神。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085404710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜財神相食，獨一位見","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085421094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，此爲福人，然終亦不淸。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085421094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"却喜身旺，不喜印綬，亦恐傷其食神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085437478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290725879827"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如運得地，方可發福，大槩與財神相似。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085453862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如巳未、己巳、丁未、辛丑，丁","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085470246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見己爲食神，有一丑一巳合起金局，得之爲財，又喜身不弱，所以","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085470246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有官亦有壽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085470246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如乙巳、乙酉、癸酉、乙卯，此命，見三乙爲食，見己酉","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085486630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉丑合金局爲印綬，于有三乙化爲傷官發用，乙爲食神，被金局","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085486630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來尅乙木，再被三乙木并卯，此尅我官，所以名利都无成也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085486630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論倒食","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085503014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫倒貪者，冲財神之謂也，一名吞陷殺，用財神大忌見之，用食神","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085519398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦忌見之。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085519398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倒食者，如甲見壬之類，如甲見丙爲食神，能生土財，然","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085535782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬尅丙火，丙火不能生甲木之土財，所謂甲用用食神大忌見之。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085535782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命中帶此二者，主福壽薄。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085552166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爻見庚爲七殺，得丙丁火制之，怕見","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085568550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木，反爲禍矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085568550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命中犯此者，猶尊長之制我身，不得自由也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085584934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作事","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085601318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進退悔懶，有始無終，財源屢成屢敗，容藐欹斜，身品矮小，膽怯必","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085601318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"慵，凡事無成也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085601318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如丁未、丁未、己亥、丁卯，此命，己","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085617702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳臨亥上，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085617702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290725896211"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身弱於亥，加以亥卯未木局尅身，年月時透出三丁食己，幼年行","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085617702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南方運，頼火生，上身猶旺，𦆵交己巳運，爲己之七殺，引出亥卯未","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085617702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木局，歲運癸亥，所以死矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085617702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此命非但倒食七殺之禍，而癸亥年與","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085634086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生殺壊印之說同義也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085634086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲戌、丙寅、甲戌壬寅，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085650470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此命甲戌月，甲見","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085650470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙食神，生于正月，甲木旺，身與食神俱旺，木是貴命，不合時上壬","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085650470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申，壬水傷其丙火，申金冲其寅木，又申中有庚七殺，所以利名无","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085650470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085650470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行己巳運，金生之地，見庚子年，庚金爲七殺，又見子時水，死於","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085666854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非命。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085666854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論傷官","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085683238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官者，其驗如神。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085699622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官務要傷盡，傷之不盡，官來乘旺，其禍不可","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085716006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勝言。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085716006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官見宮，爲禍百端。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085732390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘月令在傷官之位，及四柱次合，作事","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085748774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆在傷官之處，又行身旺鄕，眞貴人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085748774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官主人多才藝，傲物氣","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085765158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高，常以天下之人不如己，而貴人亦憚之，衆人亦惡之。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085765158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運一逢官，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085781542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290725912595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍不可言。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085781542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或有吉神可解，必生惡疾，以殘其軀。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085797926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不然運遭官事，知","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085814310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行剝官，財神不旺，皆是安享之人。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085814310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仔細推詳，萬無一失矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085830694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：傷官者，我生被之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085847078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以陽見陰，陰見陽，亦名盗氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085863462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬事","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085879846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷盡，不留一點身弱忌官星，不怕七殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085879846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲用辛官，如丁火旺能","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085896230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085896230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"十財最忌見官星，亦要身旺君","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"傷官不盡，四柱有官星，露歲運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見官星，其禍不可勝言。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085912614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若傷官傷盡，四柱不留一㸃，又行旺運","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085928998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及印綬運，却爲貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085928998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如四柱中雖傷盡官星，身雖旺，若無一點財","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085945382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，只爲貧薄。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085945382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇傷官者，須見其財爲妙，是財能生官也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085961766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用傷","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085978150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官格者，支下歲運，都要不見官星，如見官星，謂之傷官，見官爲禍","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085978150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"百端。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085978150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用傷官格局，見財方可。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330085994534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用傷官之殺，甚如傷身七殺，其驗如","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086010918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086010918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年帶傷官，父母不全；月帶傷官，兄弟不完；時帶傷官，子息爲頑；","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086027302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰帶傷官，妻妾不完。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086027302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘傷官，務要傷盡則吉，見財方可，輕則遠。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086043686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"竄之災重，则刑夭之難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官有","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086060070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戰，其命難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孷，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086060070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若月。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086060070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"在傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官之","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086060070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290725928979"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及四柱相合，皆在傷官之處。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086060070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如行身旺，卽貴人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086076454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官之人多負。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086092838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"才傲物常以他人不如己，君子惡之，小人畏之。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086109222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢官運無財救，必","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086125606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主大災，不然，主暗昧惡疾，以殘其身，或運遭官刑矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086125606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如四柱雖傷","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086141990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盡官星，身若逢財運發福，是爲傷官見財。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086141990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仔細推詳，萬無一失。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086158374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：四柱有官而被禍重，四柱無官而被禍則淺。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086174758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡四柱見官","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086191142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，或見傷官而取其財，財行得地則發，行敗財之地，必死。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086191142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如運支","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086207526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內無財，運干虚露，亦不可也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086207526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如乙亥、己丑、丁亥、庚戌，丁以壬爲官，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086223910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑、戌本爲傷官，只是丑爲金庫，又時上有庚字作財，此人行申酉","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086223910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"限，如意入金脫氣，遂死矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330086223910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵傷子官星，行官運則災，連太嵗亦","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172682278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172682278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論刼財，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172698662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如乙見甲爲刼財，乙以庚爲夫，見丙尅庚，故尅夫。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172715046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男命則尅妻，五","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172731430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽見五陰爲敗財，主尅妻害子；五陰見五陽爲刼財，主破耗防。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172731430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172747814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290725945363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人不尅妻。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172747814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙以戊巳爲財，甲見奪己壊戊；丁以庚辛爲財，丙能奪","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172764198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛破庚，類如此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172764198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄見弟，弟能此兄之財，奪兄之妻；弟見兄，兄能","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172780582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼弟之財，而不敢取弟之妻。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172780582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財者，人之所欲，方令弟兄見之，多有","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172796966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爭親。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172796966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如夷齊能幾人？","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172813350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男命見刼財多尅妻；女命見傷官多尅夫。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172829734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172846118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"極論也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172846118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論羊刃","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172862502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫羊刃者，號天上之凶星，作人間之惡殺，以祿前一位是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172878886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲祿在。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅卯歲羊刃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言偏官七殺，喜印綬，忌反伏吟，忌魁罡，忌三合。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172895270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何謂羊刃？","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172911654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲、丙、戊、庚、壬五陽有刃，乙、丁、巳、辛、癸五陰無刃，故名陽刃。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172928038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如命中","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172944422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有刃，不可便言凶大，卒與七殺相似。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172944422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡有刃者，多主富貴人，却喜","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172960806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏財七殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172960806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然殺無刃不顯，刃無殺不威，刃殺俱全，非常人有之。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172977190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172993574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要身旺運行身旺之鄊，不之見傷宫刃旺運，若命内元有殺刃，歲","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172993574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運又逄之，其過非常。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330172993574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若命有刃無殺，歲軍逢殺旺之鄕，乃轉生而","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173009958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290725961747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反成厚福。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173009958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如傷官丁旺，身弱殺旺，最可忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173026342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚申、己卯、甲寅，此","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173042726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命，甲日見卯爲刃，庚爲七殺，其殺本傷身，却藉卯中乙木以配合，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173042726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其殺有情，則殺不能傷身，正是甲以乙妹妻庚之義，其身旺南方","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173042726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運，所以爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173042726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如戊午、戊午、戊午甲寅，此命，刃殺全，而又以午火","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173059110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲印，所以爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173059110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故喜忌篇云：戊日午月勿作刃，㸔歲時火多，却爲","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173075494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173075494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及如辛酉甲午、戊午田寅，此命，殺刃全而有印綬不合，年干","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173091878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官透出，運行辛卯，犯傷官元有之，長壬爲財，是壬辰歲因事投","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173091878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水而死。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173091878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬水尅火，印曰坐甲之七殺，謂之生殺壞印。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173108262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽此命見𨐋","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173124646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲傷官，運行辛卯忌見官，午中丁火爲印綬，最忌傷官與財相見，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173124646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"緣水生木尅身也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173124646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如癸未乙卯、甲子、己巳，此命，卯刃癸印不合，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173141030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時上己巳破印，運行辛亥，亥卯木合起羊刃，辛酉年辛金又旺於","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173141030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉，冲起卯刃，二辛則太過，金多見甲，身雖貴，亦遭刑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173141030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然雖見辛","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173157414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲貴，所忌羊刃，不可一合一冲也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173157414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
