{"lines":[{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑合者，刑中有帶合者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173190182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如人命犯之，多因酒色，喪家成病，至","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173206566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於躭迷不省，乃神迷之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173206566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如十八格中，有合祿合格者，何謂也？","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173222950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173239334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃癸用戊官，戊祿在已，不見巳字，但見寅刑，但巳酉丑合，此乃見","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173239334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不見之形，所以貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173239334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此者皆見於前，所以凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173255718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如丙子辛卯、","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173272102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子辛卯，此命年月日時俱帶刑合，爲子水冲丙火，兼身又弱。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173272102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173288486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十六交甲午，三十六交丙申，年，太歲併在羊刃之上，有𠄠字冲午，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173288486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其刃刊俱合，所以因酒淫泆而亡也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173288486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如己巳、巳巳、甲寅、己巳，此","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173304870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命身旺財旺，身入長生，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173304870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"長，音掌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故爲入格不合，帶刑合大重，交奚亥","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173304870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲巳，而飮酒躭色，遂患痼疾而死。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173304870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如乙卯、癸未、戊戌、癸丑，此命","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173321254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人戊戌曰生于六月中旬，歲干透出乙字，戊曰見之爲官，地支","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173321254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未木局，生戌中之火，爲戊之印綬，官印兩全，只不合。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173321254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑時","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173337638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸水冲戊中之火，丑中之金，傷官兼刑合重，爲戊用乙官，在歲于","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173337638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290725994515"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173337638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論福德秀氣","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173354022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福德秀氣，專用其主也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173370406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如乙巳、乙酉、乙丑是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173386790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙用庚官露出","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173403174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𬆬喜制，喜印綬，不喜生於八月之中，恐露其殺，却喜行印綬官旺","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173403174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運，便能發福。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173403174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟四柱中露出辛殺，須制伏。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173419558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丁巳、丁酉、丁丑，是壬","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173435942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲官，喜金旺生水，亦不喜生於八月，故火死在酉，却喜行官旺運，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173435942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"便可發福。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173435942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦不要露雜其官爲壽而不耐久。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173452326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳、巳西、己丑，是用","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173468710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲木爲官，己酉丑金局皆傷其官，亦名盜氣，何以爲吉？","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173468710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然喜得","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173485094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金局，能生水財，亦不要四柱見火，恐傷金局，却喜行財運，便發。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173485094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173501478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳、癸酉、癸丑，是用金神爲印，見己酉丑金局，能生癸水，不喜生於","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173501478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四月，水絕於巳。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173501478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然金生在巳，以金生爲水，亦不能絶，得官印運，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173517862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"便能發福。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173517862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最不喜火財，恐傷金也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173534246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵與印綬相似，各有例于後。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173550630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論雜氣","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173567014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰戌丑未也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726010899"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雜氣者，葢謂辰戌丑未之位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173583398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰中有乙、癸、戊字，戌中有辛、丁戊","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173599782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"字，丑中有癸辛巳字，未中有丁巳乙字。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173599782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此四者，天地不正之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173616166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如甲則鎭於寅位陽木之垣，乙專鎭於卯，皆司春令，而奪東方","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173632550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173632550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰爲東南之隅，及春夏交接之界，受氣不純，禀命不一，故名","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173648934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雜氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173648934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑、未戌亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173665318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖看六甲何如，以論之，假日干是甲，而得丑，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173681702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月貴旣在中，辛則正官，癸爲之印綬，己則爲正財，不知用何如福。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173681702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要在四柱中看透出是何字，隨其所出而言，其吉凶有如前說法。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173698086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但庫中物皆閉床，須待有以開其局鑰，方言發福。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173714470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以開局鑰者","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173730854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何物也？","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173730854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃刑冲破害耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173747238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如四桂中元有刑冲破害，復行此等運","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173763622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，則刑冲破害多，反傷其福。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173763622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵雜氣要財多，便是貴命。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173780006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若年時","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173796390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"别入他格，當以他格例斷之。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173796390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢此乃天地之雜，不能純一，故少力","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173812774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173812774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"别格專於時年，乃重事。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173829158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㸔命須審輕重，以取禍福，先論重者，次","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173845542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言輕者，百發百中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173845542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其他當以言類之。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173861926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日胃者，又卽甲、戊、庚、牛、羊之類，正有四日，丁酉、丁亥、癸巳、癸卯耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173894694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最怕刑冲破害。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173911078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：崇爲寳也，命爲貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173927462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以貴人怕三刑六害","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173943846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173943846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴神要聚於日，運行怕空亡，及運行大歲加會，不要魁罡，主人","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173960230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純粹，有仁德，有姿色，不傲物，或犯前刑，則貧賤，刑冲大甚，貴人生","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173960230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"怒，反成其禍，不可不察。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173960230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰貴有旺法，類同，須分書夜貴，日要日貴，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173976614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夜要夜貴矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173976614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論曰德，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330173992998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日德有五，甲宙、戊辰、丙辰、庚辰、壬戌日是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174009382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其福要多，而忌刑冲","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174025766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破害，惡官星，憎財旺，加臨會合，但空亡而忌魁罡。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174025766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此數者，乃格之","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174042150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174042150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大扺日德主人性格慈善，日德俱多，福必豐厚，運行身旺。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174058534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大是竒絶。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174074918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有財官加臨，别尋他格，正能免非橫之禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174091302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若旺氣已","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174107686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰，運主魁罡，其死必矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174107686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或未發福，運至魁罡，体格旣好，妨生祸患，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174124070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726043667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一脫于此，必能再發，終力微矣，不可不知也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174124070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論日刃","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174140454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日刃與陽刃同日刃有戊午、丙午、壬子也，與陽刃同法，不喜刑冲","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174156838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破害，不喜會合，兼愛七殺，要行官鄕，便爲貴命。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174156838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱中一來會","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174173222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合，必主奇禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174173222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其人且大鬚長，性剛果毅，無恻隱惠慈之心，有刻剝","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174189606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不恤之意。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174189606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三刑自刑，魁罡全發跡疆塲。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174205990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如或無情，或財旺，則主其","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174222374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174222374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或有救神，要先審察。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174238758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如刑害俱全，類皆得地，貴不可言也，安得","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174255142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不舉。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174255142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨陽刃以時言之，四柱中不要入財鄕，怕冲陽刃。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174271526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如戊日","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174287910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刃在午，忌行子正財運；午刃在子，忌行午正財運；庚刃在酉，忌行","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174287910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯正財運。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174287910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲日行巳午并辰戌丑未財運不妨，忌酉運。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330174304294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙日刃在","logicSentenceId":"7679067330436923418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午，行申酉庚、辛丑不妨，忌子運。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330436923418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵陽刃要身旺，喜有物以去之。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330436939802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：人有鬼人，物有鬼物，逄之不安，去之爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330436956186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如葛參政命，壬","logicSentenceId":"7679067330436972570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申、壬子、戊午、乙卯，戊日刃在午，喜得乙卯時正官制伏去了，所以","logicSentenceId":"7679067330436972570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726060051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲福也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330436972570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論魁罡，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330436988954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫魁罡者有四，壬辰、庚戌、戊戊、庚辰曰是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437005338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如日位加臨者衆，必","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437021722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是福。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437021722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行身旺，發福百端，一見財官，禍患立至。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437038106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主人性格聰明，文","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437054490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"章輟發，臨事有斷，惟是好殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437054490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱有財及官，或帶刑殺，禍不可","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437070874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"測。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437070874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘日獨處冲者大衆，必是小人，刑責不已，窮必徹骨。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437087258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運臨財官","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437103642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺處，亦妨奇禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437103642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論金神，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437120026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫金神者，止有三時，癸酉、己巳、乙丑，金神乃破敗之神，要制伏入。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437136410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火鄕爲勝，如四柱中更帶七殺陽刃，真貴人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437152794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵威猛者，以入","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437169178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暴爲能，威茍不專，人得以悔，故必狼暴如虎動，羣獸旣攝，威德行","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437169178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437169178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然大剛必折，不有以制之，則寬猛不濟，何以上履中和之道？","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437185562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437201946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：有剛者在馴伏，調致其和，福祿踵至。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437201946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然其人有剛斷明敏之","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437218330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726076435"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"才，屆强不可馴伏之志。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437218330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行火鄉，四柱有火局，便爲貴命，懼水鄉，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437234714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則非福矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437234714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論時墓","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437251098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫時墓之論，謂財官之墓時論之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437267482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要刑冲破害，以開局鑰，其人","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437283866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必難發於少年。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437283866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：少年不發庫中人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437300250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"怕有物以壓之。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437316634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丁用","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437333018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰爲庫官，别有戊辰之類制之，則丁不能官矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437333018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此難作好命，必","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437349402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃有物以破其戊，雖得之，發福也淺。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437349402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：鬼入墓中，危疑者甚。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437365786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437382170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獨類而長才亦如之。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437382170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此是秘言而不輕泄之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437398554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星宜露，豈可藏之。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437414938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似乎爲宜者，顯揚威德，則用之國家者，方","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437431322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲大丈夫，豈受人之壓伏者，則爲臣下之臣，豈非小人？","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437431322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"内十八格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正官格：","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437447706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月內有官星者是也。時上兼有財星者，眞貴人也。怕冲，忌見傷官七殺，大運亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726092819"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王知府相公薛乙甲丙壬甲酉子寅申乙戊子官金。辛丞相庚官大己寅范戊傳丁子丙庚千寅巳丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437480474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官癸子寅申，官巳寅李金、丁狀丁元、知府丁亥、未庚、丙壬、甲酉，官戌午、巳、寅辰、印𨐋王官周、陳侍郎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"郞中","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437480474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳乙卯、戊壬、癸、甲丙卯官乙寅子酉𨐋官辰寅施巳、辛同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知戊","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437480474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬寅卯壬酉甲戊寅官陳用寺丞申辛多官一辰官辰今事切露正辛氣戊位藏忌辛則殺，則恐官，巳未名殺刑子論官爲不冲星丙官殺眞淺升破成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雜氣財官格辰戊丑未是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437496858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"柳戊李帝乙子丁辛丑、癸未、亥財，黄狀元。壬子、甲辰、己卯、壬申、壬財和。壬子、楊。丁未、丁庚戌、王壬午、乙官財戌子壬戌戊。乙卯、丁丑財林郎侍。丁丑、癸丑、癸巳酉戊辰財政恭。丙寅、丙官張。甲財。戊戌、辛酉，即戊子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅、己卯、己卯、癸巳、庚午、甲子、","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437513242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726109203"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437529626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王太尉義之乙甲丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437529626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸壬、辛卯辰戊宣、秦，丁丑辛鄧財。辛未已官財。丙辰秦，己丑馮。戊辰、戊叅財、龍丙太殿酉壬寅寅知。丙午乙卯、政。乙卯岡、府師、師子。辛亥、庚寅、癸巳、壬午、丙子、未已官、丁財，子丑辛印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：財官印綬全備，藏蓄於四季之中，辰戌丑未是","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437546010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲之。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437546010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如官露、印露、財露則不妨也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437562394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰宮則有乙木、","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437578778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸水、戊土，戌宮則有辛金、丁水、戊土，丑宮則有癸水、","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437578778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛金、己土，未宮則有乙木、丁火、己土也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437578778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜身聇，怕冲多，爲人性重，剛執不屈。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437611546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時偏官多者亦然，喜見陽刃","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437627930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437627930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月上偏官用地支只要一位，要行偏官運。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437644314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有申子年，時上又","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437660698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有之，却要行偏官旺運，亦不要行官鄕歲君亦然，爲太過而反成。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437660698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其禍須要行制伏得地之運，方癸與時偏官相似。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437677082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726125587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"沈郎中辛甲午、辛亥，丁火何偏官。戊参政卯辛、壬戌丑戌，戊土馬偏官，將仕戊庚寅、庚申辰，甲木偏官，制岳總壬丁、甲寅、己辰，偏戊土官。蒋狀元乙巳卯、乙巳，乙木王偏官，鎭撫。丑丙、癸亥、戊申，壬水偏官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437709850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王鎭撫此格殺神太重，喜行東方運，身衰八字，火多水微，獨喜寅","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437709850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宫火旺，乃是一年之火，運行卯合戌火局何亦又係濕木不生，無","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437709850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"","charPic":{"unicode":" {"lines":[{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙辰濮癸巳壬戌，王壬寅，偏戊土官趙郎侍。丙午丙申甲寅下卯偏丙庚食火官金劉神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"司","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437759002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"運甲申、乙亥、丙戌，食，庚寅、戊壬偏水神土官，黄郎侍。丁亥、辛亥、丙申、庚寅官，壬丞帖。戊申木。辛酉辛丙申相，庚寅，偏金官，樊命使。戊辰、辛酉，乙巳、丁丑，偏辛官金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

1377","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437808154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1379","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊酉，子甲癸令財司邢丁財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437808154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1381","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑癸未酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如時上偏財與時上偏官相似，只要時上一位不要多，而三處不","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437824538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要再見財，𨚫怕冲與月上偏官一同。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437824538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏財要財旺，運","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437840922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"郞侍","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437857306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1386","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬午高侯。壬寅庚子府。甲申壬食神知。乙酉己卯旺，辛卯辛卯財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437857306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1388","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁亥劉戊申，壬申，書財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午步","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437873690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1390","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚午王戊子，癸卯師丁巳月怕逢星，時偏干財破，不尋足旺正則支見此爲皆財是兄爲害財格災中與衆多。福與官，正人來，若相冲殺，官財身歸柱防同最强，官中注來下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫一位貴者，惟只時上只見一位方爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437906458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或年月日又有，反爲辛","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437922842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苦劳役之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437922842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如時上一位七殺，要本身自旺，而三處有制伏，多","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437939226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則行七殺肚運，或三合得地可發。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437939226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若無制伏，則要行制伏之運以","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437955610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1398","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726158355"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發，或遇殺旺而無以制之，則禍生矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437955610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月上偏官却怕冲，與陽刃同。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437971994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時上偏官不怕鳴，與陽以同，又要本身生日自旺，如甲乙日在正","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437988378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二月生是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330437988378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時偏官爲人性重，剛執不屈，月偏官多者亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438004762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1404","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"詹相丞壬庚甲午庚午時，戌上庚午貴。金史爲魏甲丙寅、乙壬辛卯申巳金，辛時上爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丞","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438021146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1406","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"李巳丁相壬，丙午己卯辰水時上壬爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尚","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438021146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1408","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鄭書甲戊庚壬寅寅午上寅木時甲爲貴。尚未書戊庚辰時丙戌上，戌爲甲寅貴木甲莊尚辛巳時，辛丑己卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438021146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1410","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲乙亥，木上貴乙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"侍","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438021146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1412","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬俞郎癸寅巳乙丑丑亥木時上爲貴。乙劉統都丁辛乙亥時，未乙己巳辛上爲貴。金婁叅己巳時，壬子癸卯，政爲己未土，巳上貴。判庚辰何時丁亥上癸亥局巳未土巳偏印若爲貴，切一加運偏官忌生逢助官妙殺身見身，身災有死喜正强弱病印强絶官伊化食，福禍禍神。福并祿刑連，爲祿枭重遂權重豐用全害綿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
