{"lines":[{"lineId":"1414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格以庚、壬二日用子字，多冲午中丁巳爲官星，要四桂中有寅","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438053914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1415","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726174739"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"字并未字或戌字得一字可合爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438053914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如六庚日、六壬日以子冲","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438070298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1418","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚，曰以子冲午中丁火爲官星，若四柱中有丁字并午字，則减分","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438070298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數，歲君亦忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438070298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如六壬日以子冲午中己土爲官星，若四柱中有巳","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438086682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"字并午字，則减分數，歲君大運亦須忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438086682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1423","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"喬丞丙丁庚相，丙酉子午子丁子火午冲，蔡貴。巳未丙子冲庚子𡚱官丙子子爲壬子正，壬子冲壬子使，壬寅午子巳以土爲官，尚壬子曾壬子冲壬子書，壬寅巳爲壬子，此乞午壬子官，壬子貧。丙午星官乞丙所，旣午宫，又丐時之，以以已不重，子爲冲，土爲合，合官見極也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又格","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438103066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1425","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"梁丞丁相癸未癸癸卯亥冲己亥土丑官爲戊曹中官郞。壬申以𨐋癸日用亥字冲巳中丙戊爲官星，要同辛亥。四柱有申字并酉字或丑字，得一字，可合癸亥爲妙。假令六癸日以亥冲已，若四桂有戌上壬子字，則亥不能去冲矣。歲君大運亦忌如六。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1426","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726191123"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日以辛冲巳中丙字爲官星，若四柱中有丙字并巳字，則減分","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438119450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數，歲君大運亦忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438119450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運連太歲輕，再見巳字，有禍矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438135834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倒冲格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438152218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡四柱中元無官星方用。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438168602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格以丙曰爲主，用午字冲子中癸水，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438184986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙日得官星，不論合。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438184986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱有未字，則午不能去冲矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438201370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大忌癸字","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438217754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"并子字，則减分數，歲君大運亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438217754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1437","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"喻學提：庚寅冲壬午子丙戌戊戌癸水午爲丙官知丙午同趙上庚寅丙午府减癸己分矣透時官，丙日須逢午字冲。午能冲子，吉不須論。合干嫌水，子癸相逢，午冲子癸是官星，功名榮逹。最忌未宮相伴合，平生虛利𩔰。再又虛神相逢，見京凶名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438234138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此以丁曰爲主，用巳冲亥宮，王水爲丁之官星，不論合。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438250522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱中","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438266906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有辰字，則已不能冲矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438266906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大忌四柱中有壬字并亥字，則减分數，歲","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438283290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1443","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726207507"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君大運亦同。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438283290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運重歲君輕，再見亥辛，則禍作矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438299674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1446","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"判辛酉施癸巳丁巳院乙巳亥壬以巳冲水爲官總。辛巳岳同甲午，丁未管上乙巳偏。癸卯巧同丁巳，丁巳修上乙巳。丁日多逢巳字遲，局中無水貴和同。傷官此格宜傷，見亥刑冲，數必盡空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1447","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙巳鼠貴格冲柱，此之有四中格庚辛柱中有，如月丙子金庚内時元字有則無。辛丙成官星字，官字分并星爲數，方申則妙，歲用字不謂君。此酉用之之大格，字大聚，運丑貴，亦字怕也。然內午字或又有曰曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1448","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"哀院判甲寅蘇，戊辰乙亥丙子貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438316058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1450","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人御戊子。癸亥，乙未、丙子，貴人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六乙鼠貴格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438332442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格以子暗合己，巳動合申，庚祿居申，則用庚官得引出庚金用","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438348826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1453","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726223891"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事，喜于亥卯时爲妙，忌日生寅無冲害傷破子乙二字，及無財官，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438348826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"即六乙日子時元有官星論，忌寅午戌冲見庚辛申酉丑字，有一","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438348826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位，則减分數，歲君同。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438348826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦忌月通財官，六格不用，大運同。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438365210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合祿格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438381594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格以六戊日爲主，以庚申時合卯中乙木爲戊官，四桂有甲乙","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438397978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"字、丙字、己字刑壞了申丙傷庚字，則减分數，歲君大運亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438397978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坊春","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438414362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1462","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬午，以庚黃合己酉戊午庚申卯木爲戊官，乙黃侍巳未同鄭，丙子戊戌，郞上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438414362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1464","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"申知，壬申甘，辛亥戊寅府，庚申太，庚午李，己丑戊午尉，庚申武，庚翼。戊丙申庚申申子戊時甲貴，日上如無忌，因怕丙無秋庚營回宮冬逢害，歲卯申官印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438414362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1466","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又合六格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438430746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸日爲主，喜逢庚申時，用申時合己中戊土，癸日得官星，若四","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438447130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中有戌字并巳字，刑壞了申時或丙字，及傷庚申時，則减分數，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438447130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲君大運亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438447130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1471","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726240275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知同","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438463514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1473","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸酉程乙丑癸丑庚申殿，癸酉徐乙卯癸酉院，庚申丞。乙酉趙，楊。癸未癸未相，庚申安。壬午日壬癸水時庚申庚戌，生在秋冬富貴人。癸丑大忌寅來傷秀撫氣庚甲，若生春夏意災迍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子遥巳格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438479898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格以二甲子子中癸水，逢合己中戊土，戊來合丙，丙來合酉中","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438496282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛金，甲子日得官星，則己酉丑三合官祿，要行官旺鄉運，忌四柱","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438496282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中有庚申七殺、辛字官星并申酉丑字絆住，則子不能去揺矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438496282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438512666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有午字冲子財，减分數，歲君大運赤然。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438512666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1480","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丞。己巳錢。乙亥甲子相，甲子知。丙寅趙同。壬辰甲子府上人。甲子常。己丑平。甲戌甲子動。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438529050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1482","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438529050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1484","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無不以合遥絆，辛己丑住，丙能子貴。戊甲甲不子互更，運喜子來，能來入得無辛庚生揺動，相午官。辛官逢甲合，丙絆子鄉貴相申子巳中丙亦非冲。運可酉合必知時，戊酉宜出害竒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1485","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726256659"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑遥巳格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330438545434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制統","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504032307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1488","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛丑章辛丑中。辛丑庚寅戊以官癸遥巳星之丙爲丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宻樞","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504032307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"癸丑郁葉乙丑𨐋丑郞，戊子侍。乙丑己丑癸丑官。乙卯己摇戊丑有也，中癸合爲宫。此格只有辛丑、癸丑二日用丑字多揺巳中丙戊辛是癸日，得官星丑字多爲妙。若四柱中有子字絆住，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑不能去遥矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504032307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要四柱中有申字并酉字，得一字爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504048691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辛丑日，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504065075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱中有丙丁字并巳子午字，則减分數。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504065075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲君大運同。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504081459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑日","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504097843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦不要見戊字、巳字、巳字、丁字。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504097843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬騎龍背格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504114227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格以辰多者貴，寅多者富。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504130611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日坐辰，土上丁爲財，以己爲官；壬","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504146995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日以辰冲戌中丁戊，壬辰日得財官，而寅午戌三合，或壬日至寅，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504146995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"却要年月時上多聚辰字，方可用。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504146995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若壬辰日有年月時上皆在寅","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504163379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"字，只爲富命，以有午戌爲財得地。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504163379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若年月時上辰字多，則冲出財","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504179763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1506","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726273043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來，所以貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504179763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"樞","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504196147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1509","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬辰王諸，甲辰壬辰判密院。丁寅葛。戊寅庚申壬辰富。甲辰巨。壬寅王。壬寅壬辰壬寅壬發見富王，也有壬比巨騎騎壽餘陽陶龍龍大富，假背元朱。若命背，忌傷寅，喜正怕官多官非常星謂辰寅居，來破多字，寅重故少少格叠辰刑多，須逢多冲發辰應轉貴須高財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"井欄又格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504212531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格庚申、庚子、庚辰三處，須要四柱中申子辰三位全，不必三箇","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504228915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚字。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504228915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有三庚尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504245299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只要庚日生申年月時或戊子、戊辰不妨，但","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504261683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得支是申子辰全也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504261683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若時遇丙子，則是偏官，若時是申時，則是歸","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504278067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祿格，而非井欄義矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504278067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格四柱怕見寅午戌三字，則冲壊矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504294451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申用","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504310835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁爲官，以申子辰三合冲寅午戊火局，庚日得官星，行運如正氣，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504310835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若行東方財地或南方，皆好。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504310835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱中有巳字、丙丁字，則或分數。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504327219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲君大運亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504343603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726289427"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"郭統戊申癸巳，待宋庚申庚申，庚甲庚子制。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詔","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504359987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辰庚辰，大庚。庚子官庚辰庚甲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504359987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"宮壬午庚宋有欄，日星𠝾過叉金大。午日全局亦夫丙，故喜乃逢逢中臨丁申佳命失金，巳子無因職潤火，午辰行䘮下方休。并爲歲妻相貴欄，運遇貴神，午申義破字名動，子格日提，原辰并制。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乎","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504359987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸祿格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504376371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丙午，戊子，叅樞。癸巳。甲寅，甲子亥政。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宻","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504392755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1534","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙、丙寅、己卯，甲常、甲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"侍丁","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504392755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午，此格戊之歸未，四柱丙午，喜行身亦可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"全","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504392755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假令六祿葢甲，不旺運發福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504392755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲日生人得寅時，祿在寅，餘皆倣此。官殺見之則難，兼行食神傷官，財怕冲破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504392755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"謂伹運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504392755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六陰朝陽格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504409139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"喜行酉方，東南次之，最忌北方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊知宪，辛辰、辛酉，太酉尉。辛戊、辛酉，辰丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格以六辛曰爲主，用丙火爲正官，喜","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504425523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢戊土戌來動，丙辛曰得官。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504425523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛字字則","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504441907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要一位，多則不中。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504441907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱中有丙字、丁","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504458291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726305811"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子、戊子字、午字，則冲子不中，减分數，大運亦同。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504474675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑合格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504491059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格以六癸日生人爲主，用戊土爲正氣，官星，喜逢甲寅時，用寅","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504507443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑巳中戊土，癸曰得官星，如庚寅刑不成，惟甲寅時是行運，與飛","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504507443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天祿馬同。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504507443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱中有戊","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504523827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1559","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"字己字則减分數，又怕庚寅傷甲字刑身，于忌中字則减分數，藏君大運亦忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1560","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"節使度。乙未，沈。癸未。癸亥。甲寅路。丁亥陳。癸卯。癸卯，分。甲寅侍甲郞。甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504523827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1562","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戌甲戌寅酉方幹庚辦癸午年有甲申庚卯甲寅傷上甲，陰水寅時格正淸，又愁庚尅不能刑不運行，若不逢蛇地能州故，方得淸髙有利名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱祿格。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504540211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格只有五日，忌塡實，最怕冲了日時拱位，又怕四柱中有傷，曰","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504556595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子七殺皆拱，不住則减分數。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504556595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲君大運同。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504572979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504589363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1568","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"拱祿拱寶，塡實則凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504605747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504605747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𠃌祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格有五日丁巳，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504605747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1574","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1575","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726322195"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1576","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"知劉府戊癸亥戊午辰拱午在之辰白巳丁衣人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504622131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁巳未未拱之好，已在午未破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見巳","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504638515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"見丁癸戌未亥辰巳癸見未亥戊午，日見，見癸癸丑己丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掑貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504654899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以日干甲寅取貴人，甲戊、庚牛、羊是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中郞","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504671283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1584","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁巳，熊寅，丙午、子甲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅甲子","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504671283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1586","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑拱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事都","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504671283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1588","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛丑范辛丑甲寅上，甲子同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1589","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貴人大忌塡實，貴位相刑，冲了日時拱位，又怕四柱有官、冲身、七殺之類，皆拱不住，則减分數。歲君大運亦然。范","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"都","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504687667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1591","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"事命不合年月丑字塡實，只爲白衣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1592","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此格有六日：田寅日見甲子時，壬子日見壬寅時，甲申日見甲戌時，戊申日見戊午時，乙未日見乙酉時，辛丑日見辛卯時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504704051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1594","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙知府，甲戊子亥寅印。癸辛，侍郎，丙壬申酉金寅。甲庚監簿，乙癸酉寅亥金印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最柱","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504720435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1596","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此𦂳中格，大行有官，官要印星生旺運爲忌，便妙。發月死見上絶印，要四財運綬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1597","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726338579"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子、辛亥、丙辰破印，反爲貪財壞印，不利也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504736819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尚","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504753203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1600","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛未沈，壬辰癸，甲辰書。乙亥甲，黃使運。壬庚申戌。庚戌戊寅，印土，鄭府安。丁辛、癸丑、丑卯戊子印巳宗。丙寅周，己丑金，壬寅簿，辛丑印丞。丙寅呂，辛丑金。癸巳相，癸亥印葛待。庚寅、丙戌、戊子詔，癸丑印火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雜氣印綬格","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504769587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1602","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰戌丑未也，亦忌財，要行官運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1603","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乃印葛待年而是綬貪只詔係不遂財是賣音壞不時印因職七曰𤦛也。時梳年不下鬼嵗可有此在不癸命戊仔水是子細爲雜年，推之財氣二記，行之中月之亥，二十子月。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以爲","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504785971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1605","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"八令丑透日運壬術八岀者，於丙戌日鑒王丁不辰火，乃祿運正六爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外十八格。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504802355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬趨艮，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504818739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如壬水日主，多見寅字，則用寅中甲木，暗邀己土爲壬日之官","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504835123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星，丙火邀辛金爲壬日印綬，怕午字、甲字冲之，忌財官塡實，喜身","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504835123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺地，歲運同。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504835123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅爲艮土之方，故曰趨艮。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504851507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂壬祿在亥，寅與亥合，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504867891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1613","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726354963"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又謂之合祿，亦忌破害，運行申則壞寅字不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504867891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六甲趨乾格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504884275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1616","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乾爲亥宮，六甲日生亥多者，見有官𣏂，非此格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如六甲日生，柱中要亥字多，乃爲天門之位，北極","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504900659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之垣，甲木頼之以長。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504900659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如人以甲日生亥字多者，自然","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504917043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504917043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌巳字冲之。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504933427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此論甲祿在寅，寅與亥合，謂","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504949811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之合祿，忌見財星及寅、巳二字，歲運亦同。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504949811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1624","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"新安。戊辰癸亥，甲子伯。乙丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳得位格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504966195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格以戊巳曰爲勾陳，遇亥卯未木局爲官，申子辰","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504982579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水局爲財地是也，正是戊寅、戊子、戊申、己卯、己亥、己","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504982579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未日是也，忌刑冲殺旺則反生灾矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504982579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲君大運亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330504998963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1630","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁督都。丁亥。丁亥。己卯。戊辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武當權格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505015347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如壬、癸二日，生直寅午戌火同爲財，辰戌丑未爲官是也，正是","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505031731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1633","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726371347"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅、壬午、壬戌、癸巳、癸未、癸巳是也，忌冲破，身弱則不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505031731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸屬","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505048115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水，故爲玄武，但得火局，故曰當權。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505064499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無非水火旣濟之","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505080883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"功，理而巳矣，夫何異哉！","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505080883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得斯道者，主人性格温和，有","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505097267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"智慧，有禮貌，靣帶赤黑，威而不猛，遇刑冲或歲運見","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505097267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，則不利矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505097267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1642","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"都。庚戌，李。壬午。壬寅，督。辛亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"炎上格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505113651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1644","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卽火有𦦨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如丙丁二日，見寅午戌全，或巳午未全，亦是，但忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505130035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水鄕金地𡔦行東方運，怕冲，要身旺歲運同。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505146419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"炎上者，火之勢急，又得火局，渾然戌勢，火爲文明之","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505162803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"象，直之者，當爲朱紫之貴，豈非尋常之命也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505162803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1649","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"張太乙未辛巳，丙午。保甲午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"潤下格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505179187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如壬癸日，要申子辰全，或亥子丑全是也，忌辰戌丑未宮鄉，喜","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505195571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"西方運，不宜東南，怕冲尅歲運。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505195571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1653","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1654","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726387731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此命得申子辰全，亥子丑，水鄉渾然，庚辛又生，湛然","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505211955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福量，福量廣濶，眞富貴之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505211955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"潤下者，天千地支渾","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505228339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是水，如湖海汪洋，翫以無際，主人淸秀量洪，倘遇土","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505228339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運，必主淹滯。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505228339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生冬月者，又爲奇特者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505244723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1661","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"萬人宗庚子水，庚辰壬申局，辛亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從革格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505261107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1663","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又名隂從上格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格以庚辛日見己酉丑金局全，或申酉戌全者是","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505277491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也，忌南方火運，喜庚辛旺運，見亥卯未者，爲之金水","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505277491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間革也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505277491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌冲刑庫破運，歲運同〇。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505293875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此命得申酉戌全，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505310259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"令戊生生金，得從其類，主義權衡之職。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505326643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉、戊戌、庚申辛巳。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505343027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"稼穡格","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505359411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"張","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505375795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1673","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊戌、巳未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以戊巳日生，値辰戌丑未全者是也，必東方運及北方財運。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505392179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此命辰戌丑未俱全，得水爲財，又無木尅，是以爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505408563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格喜行西南，惟忌東北。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505424947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂稼穡者，俱從於土，支","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505441331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1678","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726404115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"于重見，則爲土之一類，深有培養之功，主人多信，人","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505441331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"品重厚豊肥，生財有道，斯爲富貴人矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505441331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1681","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"眞，戊辰人。癸丑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曲直格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505457715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1683","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一日仁壽，二日靑龍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格以甲乙日干取地支寅卯辰或亥卯未木局，要","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505474099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不見辛庚之氣，見庚辛卽官殺，非此格也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505474099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只要木運","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505490483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論，故曰曲直。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505490483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運喜東北，北方有水，木頼水生，故從其","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505506867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"類，主人多仁，忌四方運。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505506867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1690","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"總甲寅李丁卯乙未，兵丙子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰德秀氣格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505523251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要天干三箇乙字，地支己酉丑全，更有丙子、壬子、辛卯、丁酉日，亦","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505539635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1693","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莠氣，怕冲尅，大運同","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505539635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福德格。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505556019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格只要己丑曰主，地支己酉丑全者是。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505572403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌穴鄕、官鄕，嫌丱破","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505588787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1698","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"福德非獨巳至，五陰皆有陰土。己丑、己巳、巳酉陰火，子丑、丁酉、丁丑陰水，癸巳、癸酉、癸丑陰金，辛巳、𨐋酉、辛丑陰木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1699","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726420499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1700","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乙巳乙酉刑冲破害，歲乙丑，忌運同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"棄命從財格。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505605171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如乙日見辰戌丑未，財神極旺，乙木四柱無依，則舍而從之支，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505621555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其人平生懼內，爲真房贅繼之人。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505621555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財者，妻也，身無所托，倚妻成立，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505637939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故爲此論。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505637939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官生財格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330505654323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1707","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"且","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如乙日生地，支見寅午戌，局全，則自能戊巳爲財，要行火鄉財","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730524718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運，身旺運，怕官鄕，忌刑冲，倒則不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730524718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"棄命從殺格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730541102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如乙日干見己酉丑，金局大盛，又無制殺，身主無氣，只得捨身","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730557486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而從之，要行殺旺及財鄕，忌日主有根及北肩之地。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730557486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官帶殺格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730573870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如甲乙日生寅午戌，地支全，若干頭有庚辛，則藉庚辛爲權，火","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730590254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1715","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726436883"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制之爲福，最要行旺運，忌見財，得中和爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730590254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲德扶殺，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730606638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如甲日見庚年是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730623022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正如年爲君位，日爲臣位，臣得君權。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730639406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然又","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730655790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以年爲祖，日爲己身，七殺有制，則祖上曾有要𥋏也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730655790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲德扶財，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730672174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如甲日見戊巳年是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730688558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若財命有氣，則主其人得祖上物業，身","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730704942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弱强者，則不僅業也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730704942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夾邱格，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730721326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1727","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亦名拱財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1728","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金相丞庚戌戊子，癸酉丁，癸亥爲則。戊酉亥夾以張書尚。丙辰幸卯，癸酉癸亥戌拱酉亥，甲子夾同。癸酉火，癸酉爲上財。癸亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此格用日支與時支共拱其財，","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730737710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如甲寅日甲子時，虚拱丑宮","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730737710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己土爲財庫，又如乙卯日丁巳","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730737710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時，甲午日壬出時，癸酉日癸亥","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730737710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730754094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要虛拱，不要塡實，及酉惹絆，則拱不得。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730770478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更要曰主自旺，或","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730786862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1736","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583006290726453267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財旺運，皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730786862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：","logicSentenceId":"7679067330730803246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1739","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夾丘之格少人知，不犯柱中官殺位，拱夾休填墓庫中，一生淸貴𩔰當時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫六親者，父母、兄弟、妻財、子孫是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207011840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用日千爲主，正印、正母、偏印、","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207028224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏母及祖父也。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207028224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏財是父，乃母之夫星也，亦爲偏妻，正財爲其偏","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207044608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財，爲妾、爲父是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207044608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"比肩爲兄弟、姊妹也。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207060992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十殺是男，正官是女，","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207077376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陽爲男陰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲女。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神是男孫，傷官是女孫及祖母也。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207077376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以上有圖，必詳其圖說，方可知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人命取","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207093760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六親與男命不同，取官星爲夫星，七殺是偏夫，食神是男，傷官是","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207093760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207093760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：男取尅干爲嗣，女取干生爲子息及奴婢也。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207110144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年爲祖七，月","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207126528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲父母、伯叔、兄弟門戸，日爲妻妾巳夏。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207126528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如六親受尅，何如？","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207142912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印殺","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207159296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見財，尅母及祖母也；見比刼、羊刃，尅妻妾及父也。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207159296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官殺多者，難爲","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207175680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟；傷官、食神多，難爲子息。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207175680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"梟印傷孫，尅祖母也。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207192064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"譬如正印作合","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207208448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母不正，財作合妻不正；官作合女不正，偏財作合，妾不正；比肩作","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207208448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合，姊妹不正；傷官作合，祖母不正；食神作合，孫女不正。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207208448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如印日","logicSentenceId":"7679062944207224832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583005997110640703"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList" {"lines":[{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏財是父乃印綬之官星也。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415612968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲日以戊爲父，再見甲寅字，或木","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415629352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"局全，或臨死絶冲刑之地，主尅父也。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415629352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不然，主離異不睦，或疾病殘","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415645736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415645736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得庚字、甲字救，庶無大害。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415662120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲旺戊衰，亦主有疾少靠。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415678504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415694888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨生旺貴人，天月德地，亦主有貴，更得丙丁生助，享父之福無窮。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415694888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如臨殺地，父死他姐，居衰敗受制之處，墓絶之地，生父平常，不得","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415711272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583005997110689855"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父力也。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415711272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"論母正印者，乃生甲之身也。如甲日以癸爲母，遇己丑未，主尅毋癸印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415727656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己丑未乃是土尅水，故云尅母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見多，主母嫁二夫。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415727656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一戊失地，","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415744040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戊乃癸之夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或被尅，主母","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415744040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷前夫。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415744040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊字受生，或印臨桃花沐浴，母有外情。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415760424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如印長生，主母慈","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415776808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淑，壽長，益和子母。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415776808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如臨羊刃殺地，或直絕墓孤寡，主母不賢，或有","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415793192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殘疾不睦，雖以理推，無不驗矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415793192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論妻妾","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415809576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正財爲正妻偏財，妾也。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415825960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲木見己上爲正財，戊上爲偏財，又見乙","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415842344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木局","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415842344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥卯未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷妻，甲寅尅妻也，更主妻不正。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415842344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不正，謂淫賤也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財衰敗墓絶，主","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415858728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻有疾不賢，否則年高再嫁。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415858728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見癸字，則妾不正之。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415875112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乃戊妻也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見己土丑","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415891496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未字，則主自安。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415891496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"比肩分奪，財臨沐浴桃花，主妻妾私通。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415907880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日下月下","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415924264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐財者，主妻多内助，更得妻財，偏財得位，妄勝於妻，主財自旺，妻","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415924264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583005997110706239"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不容妾。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415924264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官殺重見，妻招幹蠱可畏。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415940648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官並美，爲人怕妻，見殺尤忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415957032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財多身弱，妻反勝夫。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415973416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財命有氣，妻妾和順，是得妻力。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944415989800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日坐空亡，難","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416006184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲妻妾。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416006184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又看孤鸞之日，陽錯陰錯，主尅妻，或因親致眷，寒房冷娶，","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416022568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入贅塡房。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416022568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人犯此，主父母家凌替，或致訟事。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416038952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此例。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416055336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"比肩者，兄弟也。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416088104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如甲見甲爲兄，乙爲弟妹，寅卯亦然，見庚則尅","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416104488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄，見辛則傷弟。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416104488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲木旺，主兄姐爭財；甲乙寅卯旣多，則兄弟姐妺。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416120872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奪財不和，爭闘是非。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416137256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見巳合甲，兄姐不正，𧠆庚弟妹不正。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416153640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如見殺","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416170024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多乙木得局，是殺合會乙木而傷甲，此兄不若弟之福，借弟之力，","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416170024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而加恃甲木。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416170024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅月乙木受制，主兄旺弟衰，其餘和順不睦，但以八","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416186408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"字休旺死絶斷之，何不應驗矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416186408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
