{"lines":[{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺者，子也。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416219176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲見庚申是子，辛酉是女，若見丙火午寅，或殺臨","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416235560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583005997110722623"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃殺宮，主尅子，不然躬疾病不肖。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416235560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇戊巳土得令，則子得力和順。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416251944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見丙己字女不正，官臨沐浴桃花，更兼暗合，食神多者，其女私通。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416268328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若殺臨長生月德、天德所臨之地，貴人祿馬、食神、財鄕，言有强父","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416284712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴子，要禀中和。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416284712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽日陽時，男見重，陽日陰時，先男後女；陰日陰時，","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416301096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女見重，陰日陽時，先女後男。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416301096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官見官，子孫兇頑；時土傷官反空","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416317480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡，難爲子息。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416317480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命取傷官是子，食神是女，若見印綬梟神，難得","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416333864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子也。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416333864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇男命官殺得地而禀中和者，言其有子將生成之數断之，","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416350248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺倍加，死絶减半，太過不及，不以此断。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416350248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太過有子，而多尅天，或","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416366632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兇頑，不及則少生養；官殺得地，而有扶助，吉曜多者，其子忠孝賢","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416366632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明，居休囚死絶、破敗衰病、勾絞元凶空虛之地，則子當不肖貧賤","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416366632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疾病之子，更兼孤神寡宿，主孤苦伶仃。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416366632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如甲子之日，甲子之時，","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416383016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚死于子，死中至老沒皃郎入墓之時，難保雙受氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416383016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"絶中一箇子，","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416399400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胎中頭女有孤娘，養中三子，只留二長生之位。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416399400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旬中牛合，主七箇","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416415784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583005997110739007"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之子也。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416415784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"沐浴一","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416432168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雙保吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"康，冠𢃄臨官三子位，旺中五子自成行，衰","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416432168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中二子，病中一，自","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416432168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數至亥，病中午。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416432168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"依此推之，且如八字中若無。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416448552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子星時上又不生旺，運，行官殺旺鄉，主有子，運過𨚫無。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416464936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如柱中有","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416481320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官殺，而行傷食休衰絶弱之運，傷損其子，運過方存。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416481320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八字育一殺","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416497704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一子，二殺二子，無殺無子。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416497704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如柱中身殺兩停，而殺逢旺鄉，就作多","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416514088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子断之，亦看財神何如，逐時增减多寡推之，無不驗矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416514088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論婦人總訣","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416530472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推婦人之命，與男命大不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416546856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"草堂丁進士先生作元神趣人法，照","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416563240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"返鬼伏屬類從化。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416563240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命八法：純和淸貴，濁亂娼淫，取官爲夫，爲福","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416579624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星，財旺生官，則夫納福；印綬食神爲名，貴有稱呼，生氣印綬，難爲","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416579624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子息，印綬財官，必生於富貴之家，才貌賢淑。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416579624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲日見辛酉是正夫，","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416596008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁午字傷正夫，庚申是偏夫。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416596008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚申、辛酉重見，乃傷夫再嫁。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416612392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若財","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416628776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太多，官殺太旺，乃明暗夫集，多淫而且濫，財多而淫，故女人要財","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416628776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583005997110755391"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"薄，旺夫益子。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416628776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如官得地，七殺受傷，食神干旺，印綬天月二德，夫榮","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416645160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子貴，封贈之命。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416645160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人八字傷官，官殺混雜，食神則旺身衰，爲人妬","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416661544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"害，好色貪屢，兇頑可畏。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416661544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官見官，尅夫再嫁，身心勞役，雖不傷夫，","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416677928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有病患。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416677928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平生欠祈，多主不安。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416694312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大忌年上復官，主産厄帶疾，否則","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416710696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷壽。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416710696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官，主人聰明美貌秀氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416727080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官見殺者富，無財者貧，刼財敗","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416743464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財，傷官，身五貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416743464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下格以上十五格，皆是冲官逢合，俱有傷宮之","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416759848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌，雖是富貴，不免淫濫之風。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416759848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺正官，只要一位者良，殺多則夫","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416776232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多，官殺被合，乃婢妾姊妹爭權。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416776232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如甲用辛官，丙合是也，乙庚官","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416792616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見丁是也；戊用乙官見辛是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416792616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此是被合取之，餘皆倣此，主婦人。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416809000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"招嫁不定，八字中傷官及官星死絶，孤神寡宿，日時空亡，乃孤尅","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416825384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之命。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416825384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或天干透出官殺，地支無官殺，更臨休囚死絶退氣之地，乃","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416841768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女絶其夫之氣，當作偏房婢妾推之。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416841768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命若有天月德，無産厄、血光","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416858152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之患，亦無淫濫之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416858152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命只要身弱，主性純粹而温柔，能奉公姑，","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416874536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583005997110771775"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"助益夫主。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416874536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身强欺夫，不孝公姑，是非生事，性多躁，雖身弱爲病，身","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416890920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"强亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416890920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八字喜貴，不宜驛馬咸池，要純和柔弱，不宜剛健大强。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416907304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416923688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運亦同。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416923688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外有陰差陽錯。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416940072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤鸞之日，不利嫁娶皆無。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416956456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"花燭成親，因親","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416972840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至眷。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416972840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寒房孝娶，婚姻轉摺。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944416989224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤鸞殺云：木虎孀無壻，金猪豈有郞。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944417005608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赤","logicSentenceId":"7679062944417021992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃馬獨卧，黑鼠守空房。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944417021992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主女寡而男孤。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944417038376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時中併冲，女則難爲夫嗣。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944417054760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加以空亡，時曰孤尅，不待言而可知。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944417071144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八字官殺俱皆，𨚫行官殺財","logicSentenceId":"7679062944417087528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運，乃夫星得地不孤；八字財官俱有，運行偒官刼財之地，難爲。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944417087528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫","logicSentenceId":"7679062944417103912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宮運過方嫁。","logicSentenceId":"7679062944417103912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細推甚驗。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785736227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡觀陰命，先𮗚夫主之盛衰，次論身榮，要見子自之强弱。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785768995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫榮子","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785785379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，定知富貴荣華；子死夫哀，只是孤窮下賤。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785785379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有夫有子而貧寒者，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785801763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢因身在衰鄕，無夫無子而昌盛者，亦是身居旺地。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785801763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若貴人少者，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785818147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不富亦昌，合貴神，非妓卽妮。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785818147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論淫賤者，四柱傷官，暗招財損。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785834531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"招壻","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785850915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038221844521"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，夫顯于門戸之中；偏夫者，夫旺于日時之上。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785850915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫衰身旺，主爲廉","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785867299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"潔之人；鬼旺身衰，必作孤寒之婦。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785867299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡觀陰命之五行，要精詳于明","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785883683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785883683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲推女命，先㸔官星。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785916451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官帶殺而貧賤，官得令以安榮。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785932835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官太重必","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785949219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"防夫，且是爲人性重，倒食重逢須减福；那堪更犯孤神，殺重須奔。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785949219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴室合多，定損貞名。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785965603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐祿乘輿而隱厚，冲身動步以輕浮。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785981987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若乃桃","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785998371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"花浪滾，淫奔之耻不堪言；日祿歸時，貴重爲人所敬；天月一德以","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785998371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲本命，如逢印綬，貴當兩國之封。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715785998371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時曰羊刃，本是凶神，旣不利於","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786014755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫主之宮，兼損壞乎生平之性。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786014755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身于主禎祥，時犯金神健旺，要觀","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786031139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八字之强。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786031139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專食子𣓳忌，偏","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786047523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"印𥩓身之勝，守閏門而正靜，必有陰日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"守中和，待夫壻以經營。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786047523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃陽十支財甚，大抵欣逢正祿，怕犯咸","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786063907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"池。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786063907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑貴得長生之輔，雜濁以敗氣之歸。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786080291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱敗多，大忌冲身而犯","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786096675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038221860905"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合，一生忙甚，若非娼妓郎爲媒，印壞與公姑相妬，食專得子嗣之","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786096675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786096675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官殺重逢，須防淫亂；姊妹透出，便見爭夫。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786113059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魁罡有靈變之機，日","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786129443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴有安當之福。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786129443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卽以干支分定，官殺勝而無制伏，不爲娼妓，定作","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786145827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType" {"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官殺混雜，官殺無制，殺星太重，傷官太重，貪財破印，比肩犯重，無","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786211363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官見合，無印見殺，傷官帶殺帶合，桃花八字刑冲，財多身弱，羊刃","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786211363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"冲刑金神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"带","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786211363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786211363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"官多合倒揰桃花身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺無","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786211363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"依傷官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見官，財官遇","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786211363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038221877289"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印，印綬遇刼，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786211363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命用官爲夫，或殺只喜一位多者尅夫。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786244131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如命滿盤官星爲忌，滿","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786260515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱殺星爲福，成吉傷宫不爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786260515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官運後行尅夫，傷官有制，身绝。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786276899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命，傷官刑子，尅夫爲次。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786293283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命，官星多者，傷夫，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786309667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主賤傷官。桃花爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𢻉女命，或主尅子息。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786309667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見貴人一位，或帶榮神，或犯絶地，多富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786326051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貞潔祿馬相隨，桃花帶貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786342435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池遇馬多淫，防大破家。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786358819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有反無戌，命","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786375203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤，晚景寂寞。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786375203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌多無辰，初年勞碌。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786391587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中主好，不防不尅子，風流而淫。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786407971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌全，則淫亂破家，傷夫尅子，夭壽殘疾。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786424355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"擇婦須沉靜，細說與君聽。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786457123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫主要强宮，身主要强甚。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786473507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星若不合，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786489891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫主無所依。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786489891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合絶莫合貴，此法少人推。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786506275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專以日爲年，此法少人傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786522659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶緣曰：生旺産死教人謗。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786539043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬帶貴人，終久落風塵。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786555427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有辰休見戌，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786571811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038221893673"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有戌休見辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786571811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌若相見，多是淫破人。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786588195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有殺不怕合，無殺却怕合。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786604579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合神若是多，非妓亦謳歌。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786620963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人一座正，兩三作寵定。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786637347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃帶傷官，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786653731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"駁雑事多端。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786653731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滿盤多是印，損子必須定。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786670115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二德坐正財，富貴自然來。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786686499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱帶休囚，封贈福壽增。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786702883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金水若相逢，必招美麗容。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786719267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申己亥全，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786735651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤淫復便便。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786735651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午逢卯酉，定是隨人走。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786752035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戊逢丑未，婦道之大忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786768419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雨貴一位殺，權家富貴說。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786784803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官若藏庫，冲刑豈不富。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786801187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天干一字連，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786817571","marginNo {"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡小兒命見財多，必庶出螟蛉，尅父母也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786850339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若幼年行運於財旺之","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786866723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鄕亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786866723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲側生，頂不正，有胎衣遮。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786883107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁偏生䨇頂，乾生有依，應有尅","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786899491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786899491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰復生背父，易生易養便有聲。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786915875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅遲滯，未吉辰，有胎衣包仰生","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786932259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有驚哭。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786932259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小見命大要身旺，最喜印綬生之，無財剋之，則易生災。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786948643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786965027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不要官星七殺、羊刃傷官太旺，身旺亦多灾，身弱則難養。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786965027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如見所","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786981411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038221910057"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"畏之辰，切不要行運，歲君助之，大畏財耻，不庶出，必瞑蛉尅父母","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786981411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786981411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更不要行運早，葢氣難敵也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715786997795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子戊寅戊子丁巳生，月中之後。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787014179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月逢七殺，頼有丁火爲印綬，寅爲長生之地，能生戊土，不合見庚","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787030563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子巳字金長生，其二子之水爲財，剋丁火生氣，反生月中七殺，七","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787030563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"煞來尅身，身弱難敵，故當年十一月，其子死矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787030563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此爲生殺壊印之","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787046947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787046947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如癸酉、癸亥、己丑、乙亥，此命四柱財重，自分免，幾乎俱亡。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787063331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱歲餘，父母亦亡，乃過房繼養。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787079715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其他倣此無疑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787096099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小兒之命，當論時辰爲主，先有官殺，次有格局。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787128867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰主強財官旺，有","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787145251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"関無殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787145251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日干弱，財官少，常病可養；日干弱，財官多，有関有殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787161635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787178019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合聚殺者，難養，不見刑冲者，聲音響亮，夜啼急性。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787178019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八字有財官","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787194403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生於富貴之家，偏官生於平常之家，傷官刼財，生於貧賤之家。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787194403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787210787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官、偏印偏財，主偏生庶出，不然。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787210787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第三四胎子平之法，偏官爲開，偏","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787227171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038221926441"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財爲殺，取生辰之數斷之，水一、火二，木三、金四、土五。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787227171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如甲日庚","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787243555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺，乃四九歲于丙見壬殺，一六歲，于戊日甲殺，三八歲庚日丙殺，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787243555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二七歲壬見戊殺，五十歲見之。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787243555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於陰干亦如此，無不驗矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787259939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論情性","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787276323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性情者，乃喜怒、哀樂、愛惡欲之所發，仁義、禮智、信之所布，父精母","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787292707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"血而成形，皆金木、水火、土之関係也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787292707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如木曰曲直，味酸，主仁惻","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787309091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隱之心，慈祥愷悌，濟物利民，恤孤念寡，恬静淸高，人物淸秀體長，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787309091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"回色靑白。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787309091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故云木盛多仁，太過則折執物性偏，不及少仁，心生姤","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787325475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"意〇。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787325475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火曰炎上，味苦，主禮辭讓之心，恭敬威儀，質重淳朴。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787341859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人物，靣","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787358243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上尖下員，印堂窄鼻露竅，情神明爍，言語辭急意速，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787358243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心焦，靣色或","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787358243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靑赤，坐則摇膝，太過則鞠恭聦明，性燥須赤，不及則黃痩，尖楞姤","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787358243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"毒，有始無終。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715787358243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金日從革，味辛辣也，主義羞惡不心仗義踈則敢","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878010895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勇豪傑，知廉耻，卞人中庸，骨肉相應。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878010895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方靣曰色，眉高眼深，鼻向耳","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878027279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038221942825"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仰，聲音淸響，剛毅何决，太過則自無仁心，好貪兼欲，不及則多三","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878027279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"思，少果决，慳吝，作事挫志。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878027279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水曰濶下，味醎，主智是非之心，志足","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878043663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多謀，機関深遠，文學聰明，譎詐飄蕩無力，傾覆陰謀好惡。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878043663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不及則","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878060047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"膽小無謀反，主人物痩小。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878060047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土曰稼穡，勾陳，味甘，主信誠實之心，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878076431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"敦厚至誠，言行相顧，好敬神佛，主人背圓腰澗，鼻大口方，眉目淸","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878076431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秀，向如墻壁。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878076431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靣色黄，處事不䡖，度量寬厚，太過則愚朴古執如痴；","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878092815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不及則顔色似憂，鼻低靣偏，聲重濁，朴實執抅；太過則孤介硬吝，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878092815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不得衆情，沉毒狠房，失信顚倒。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878092815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如日千：弱則退縮怕羞。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878109199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰干，强","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878125583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則妄誕執一，自做以上，自以輕重之，萬無一失。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878125583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫疾病者，乃精神氣血之所王，各有感傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878158351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙曰臟腑，外曰肢體。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878174735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878191119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"字干支五行生尅之義，取傷內者而斷之。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878191119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行干支太旺，不反俱","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878207503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878207503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金主刀刀刑傷，未乃溺卅而死，木乃懸梁自縊，虎啖蛇嗔，火則","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878223887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038221959209"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夜眠顚倒，蛇傷燒焚。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878223887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"士乃山崩石壓，泥陷墻崩。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878240271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如生命天干内","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878256655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"府所屬，詩曰：甲肝乙膽丙小腸，丁心戊胃己脾鄕。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878256655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚是大膓辛用","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878273039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肺，工是膀肬。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878273039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸腎藏。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878289423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天干外支所屬用頭乙項丙肩求，丁心戊","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878305807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脇己屬腹，庚係人臍辛爲股，壬脛癸足自來求。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878305807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子疝二丑肚箙，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878322191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅臂肢，卯目手，辰背胃，巳靣齒，午心腹，未脾胷，申咳疾，酉肝肺戌。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878322191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆肺亥頭肝，肝乃腎家苗，腎乃肝之主，腎通於眼，膽藏魂，肝藏師，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878338575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賢藏精，心藏神，脾藏氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878338575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木命見庚辛申酉多者，肝膽病。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878354959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内則驚精虚怯，癆瘵嘔血，頭眩目","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878371343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暉疾喘，頭風脚氣，左癱右痪，口眼歪斜，風症筋骨疼痛。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878371343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外則皮膚","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878387727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾燥，眼目之疾，髪須疎少，顛撲手足損傷之患。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878387727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女主隋胎血氣不","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878404111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"調，小兒急慢驚嵐，夜啼咳喇。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878404111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：筋骨疼痛。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878420495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢因木被金傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878436879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土命見木及寅卯旺鄕，主胆胃經受傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878551567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内主膈食番胃，氣噎蠱張，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878567951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"泄瀉黄腫，不能飮食，吃物揀擇，嘔吐𦜉傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878567951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外則左手口腹有疾，皮","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878584335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"膚燥澁，小見疳病脾黃。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878584335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土主濕多湌滯，靣色痿黄。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878600719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：土虛乘木","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878617103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺之鄕，脾傷定論。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878617103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金命見火及己午旺處，主大腸肺經受病，咳嗽喘吐，腸風痔漏，魑","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878633487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魁失魂勞怯之症，外則皮膚枯燥，瘋鼻赤疽癰，皆膿血之咎。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878633487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878649871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金弱遇火炎之地，血疾無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878649871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水命見土及四季旺月，主膀胱腎經受病，内則遺精白濁，盜汗鬼","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878666255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交，虛損耳聾，傷寒感冒。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878666255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外則牙痛病氣，偏墜腰疼，賢氣淋瀝，吐瀉","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878682639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疼痛之病。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878682639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人主胎崩漏白帶。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878699023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水主寒，靣赤黧黑。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878715407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：下元冷疾，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878731791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只緣水値土傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878731791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫大運者，以天千曰五運，地支曰六氣，故名範氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878764559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子平之法，大運","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878780943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看支，歲君看于交運同接木，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878780943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且干支二字，六十甲子之說用。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878797327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"花字若天干地支得其時到，自然開花結子盛矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878813711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月令者，天元也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878830095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人運就月上起，譬之樹苗，樹之見苗，則知各月之用神，則知其格。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878846479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故謂交運如同接木。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878862863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然命有根苗花實者何，正合此意也，豈不宜","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878879247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣？","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878879247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出癸入甲，如返汗之人。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878895631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如甲戊接癸亥，此乃干支接木，丑運","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878912015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交寅，辰交巳，末交申，戌交亥，此乃轉角接木，東南西北，四方轉角，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878912015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之接木。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878912015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格局凶者死，格局善者災。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878928399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯辰一氣，申西戌一氣，亥","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878944783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子丑一氣，氣之相運，皆非接木之說。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878944783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如甲乙得寅卯運，名曰刼","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878961167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財敗財，主尅父母，及尅妻破財、爭問之事。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878961167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行丙丁巳午運，名傷官，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878977551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主尅子女，訟事囚繫。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878977551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛申酉七殺官鄕，主得名發越；太過則災","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878993935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病惡疾。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715878993935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行壬癸亥子生氣印綬運，主吉慶增產；辰戌丑未戊巳財","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879010319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222008361"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運，主名利皆通。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879010319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃死法譬喻，須隨格局喜忌推之，不可執一，妙","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879026703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在識其通變。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879026703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拙說如神","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879043087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干旺宜行衰運，干弱宜旺運正乃干弱則","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879059471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求氣旺之籍，有餘則不足之營，須要通變。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879059471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更兼孤害、空亡、勾絞、喪","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879075855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門、吊客、宅墓、病死、官符、白虎諸殺推之，其驗如神。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879075855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇又一法：羊刃、","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879092239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花、伏吟、返吟、休囚死絶，歲敗者凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879092239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運帝旺臨官、祿馬、貴人生養、","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879108623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冠帶庫者吉，如空者凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879108623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空者返吉，吉者返凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879125007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大運不宜與木歲相","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879141391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅相冲者凶，更刑冲相尅者亦忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879141391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲冲尅運者吉，運尅歲者凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879157775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879174159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"局不吉者死，歲運相生者吉，祿馬貴人合交互者亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879174159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜審細推","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879190543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，無有不應驗者矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879190543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
