{"lines":[{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲乃年中天干，故不可犯，犯之則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879223311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：日犯歲君，災殃必重。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879239695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行有救，其年反必招財。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879256079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如甲日見戊土，太歲是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879272463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅重者死。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879288847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙者，寅卯亥未日時者，犯尅歲君，决死無疑，有救則吉，乃八字","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879305231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222024745"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛、巳酉丑金局也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879305231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：戊巳愁逢甲乙，干頭須要庚辛，或丙丁","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879321615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火局，焚木，有災勿咎。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879321615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"効此推之，或得巳合甲亦解之。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879337999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵太歲不","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879354383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可傷之，相生者吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879354383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃五行有救，其年反必爲財。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879370767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"犯歲君者，其年必","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879387151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主凶䘮，尅妻妾及破財、是非犯上之悔。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879387151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加以勾絞、空亡、咸池、宅墓、","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879403535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病符、死符、巳虎、羊刃諸殺併臨，禍患百出，神殺加臨，輕重推之。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879403535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879419919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干雖不尅歲，猶恐運尅歲君，若加歲運冲刑，羊刃冲合，主破耗䘮","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879419919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879419919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘有貴人祿馬，釋之稍吉，八字有救無處。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879436303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故云太歲乃衆殺之","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879452687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主，八命未必爲災，若遇戰闘之鄕，必主刑於本命。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879452687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論運化氣","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879469071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫五運化氣者，甲己化土乙庚金，丁壬化木盡成林，丙辛化水分","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879485455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淸濁，戊癸南方火𦦨侵。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879485455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲己化士，中正之合，辰戌丑未全曰稼穡，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879501839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳得位。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879501839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879518223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚化金，仁義之合，己酉丑全曰曲直從革。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879534607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊癸化","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879550991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火，無情之合，得火局，曰炎上。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879550991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879567375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛化水，得申子辰水局，曰潤下。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879583759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222041129"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879600143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁壬化木，得亥卯未全曰仁壽。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879616527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天干化合者秀氣，地支合局者","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879632911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福德。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715879632911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化之眞者，名公目卿，化之假者，孤兒異姓，逢龍卽化，變作龍","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978674211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飛在天，利見大人。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978674211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月令生旺，養庫臨官之地，方化。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978690595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽得合，夫婦","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978706979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"匹配，中和之氣而化。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978706979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太過不及，皆不能化。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978723363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有夫從妻化，妻從夫化，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978739747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正化、偏化，曰下目化、轉角化，乃未坤申丑艮寅。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978739747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：東北丧朋，西","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978756131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"北得朋。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978756131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲日見己字化土，己見甲亦然，乃化之眞，謂之正化化之。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978772515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眞者各公巨卿，乃冨旹之格。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978788899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化之假者，孤見異姓，或爲僧道之類。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978805283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十干効此推之。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978821667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但戊癸化火，南不化午，北不化子午乃少陰君火，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978838051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以不化；寅申乃少陽火，乃化。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978838051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：化之格局，玄中又玄，妙中又","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978854435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妙，不可俱述。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978854435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常觀天元神趣人法，返照鬼㐲，𩓈屬從化。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978870819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仔細推詳，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978887203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化氣十叚錦其一","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978903587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲從己合，頼士所生。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978919971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇乙兮妻財暗損，逢丁兮衣祿成空。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978936355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴顯高","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978952739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門，葢復辛金之力；家殷大富，皆因戊土之功。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978952739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見癸今平生發福，逢","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978969123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222057513"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬兮一世風蓬。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978969123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇庚金家徒四壁；時逢丙火，祿享千鐘。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715978985507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已能化","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979001891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲，秀在於寅。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979001891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢丁兮他人凌辱，遇乙兮自己遭迍。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979018275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽水重","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979034659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"重奔走。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紅塵之客，庚金銳銳，孤寒白屋之人。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979034659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙内藏辛，必得其貴；戊中隱","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979051043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸，不至于貧。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979051043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若要官職遷榮，先須見癸；家殷巨富，務要逢辛。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979067427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙從庚化，氣禀西方，蹇難兮生逢丙位，榮華兮長生壬鄕。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979083811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁火當","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979100195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"權，似春花之笑曰；辛金指世，若秋草之逢霜。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979100195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晨喜巳臨，滿堂金玉；","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979116579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏宜甲向，麻麥盈倉，日日勞神，葢爲勾陳作亂，時時費力，玄武爲","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979116579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殃。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979116579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚從乙化，金質彌堅。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979132963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最忌辛金暗損，偏嫌丙火相煎。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979149347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遭丁官兮，似","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979165731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛟龍之得雲雨；逢己卯兮，若鵬鶚之在秋天。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979165731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸水旺兮田園漂蕩，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979182115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬水盛兮財祿增遷。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979182115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇戊相侵兮不成巨富；逢壬助九兮永保長","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979198499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979198499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙爲陽火，化水逢辛，有福兮戊土在位，成名兮，己木臨身，官爵遷","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979214883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222073897"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"榮。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979214883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生逢癸曰，家門顯逹，長在庚難。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979231267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"强横起於甲午，禍敗發於𡈼辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979247651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屢遇陰丁，縱冨霣能有幾日；重送己土，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979264035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖荣華一似浮雲","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979264035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水以火爲財，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"土爲官，如重見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979264035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"必有傷害矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛能化水，得丙方成。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979280419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四枉最宜見戌，一生只喜逢庚。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979296803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見巳兮何年","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979313187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發福，逢𡈼兮何日成名。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979313187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸水旺兮，縱困而不困，甲木旺兮，須榮而","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979329571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不榮。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979329571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴榮華，重重見乙；傷殘窮迫，疊疊逢丁。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979345955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁陽陰火，喜遇陽壬。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979362339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見丙兮百年安逸；逢辛能一世優游。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979378723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴雙","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979395107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"全。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979395107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜甲臨於天秤，祿封雙美，欣己共於金牛。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979411491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"活計消疎，皆因戊敗，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979427875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生涯寂寞，益爲癸因。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979427875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙木重重，財祿决無成就；庚金燦燦，功名切","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979444259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫妄求。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979444259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬從丁化，秀在東方。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979460643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇甲兮多招僕馬，逢辛兮廣置田庄。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979477027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙火相","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979493411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢，乃英雄之豪傑；癸水相會，爲辛苦之經商。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979493411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"佩印乘軒，巳臨官位，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979509795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飃逢落洎，戊帶殺官，皓首無成。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979509795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆爲庚金乗旺，靑年不遇，葢因乙","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979526179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222090281"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木爲殃。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979526179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌從癸合，火化成功。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979542563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見乙兮終能顯達，逢壬仍亦自豐隆。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979558947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衆祿供","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979575331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"持。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979575331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜丁臨於巳位，六親不睦，緣甲世於寅宮。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979591715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙火炎炎，難尋福祿；","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979608099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚金燦燦，易見亨通。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979608099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻子損兮皆因己旺，謀爲拙兮葢爲辛雄。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979624483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸從戌合，化火當臨。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979640867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙内藏辛，一世多成多敗；甲中隱己，百年勞","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979657251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"力勞心。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979657251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倉庫豐肥。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979673635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欣逢丅火田","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979690019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"股實，喜得庚金官爵陞榮。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979690019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"連綿","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979706403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見乙，貲財富貴；上下逢壬，財源得失兮，緣辛金之火旺；仕途蹭蹬","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979706403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兮，葢己土之相侵。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979706403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神趣八法，有類屬從化、返照、鬼伏","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979722787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"類象者，乃天地一類也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979739171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如春生人甲乙，天干地支寅卯辰，全無間","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979755555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斷破壞，謂之奪東方一片秀氣，最怕引至時爲死絶之鄉，謂之破","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979755555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子秀氣，運至死絶則不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979755555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或時上年上引生旺，爲之秀氣加臨，十","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979771939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分大美。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979771939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222106665"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屬象乃天干甲乙木，地支亥卯未全者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979788323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從象者，如甲乙曰主無根，地支全金，謂之從金，四柱純土，謂之從","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979804707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土，四柱純水，謂之從水，四柱純木，謂之從大。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979804707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只有秀氣者吉，無秀","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979821091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣者不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979821091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或天干有甲己字，或有根者，不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979837475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其從火者，大旺運吉，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979853859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死絶地凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979853859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化象者，乃甲乙日生人，在辰戌丑未月，天干有一己字合甲字，謂","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979870243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之甲己化土，喜行火運，如逢甲乙木生旺，運化不成，反爲不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979870243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979886627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"字中露出二甲字，謂之爭合；有一个乙字露出，謂之妒合，爲破格。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979886627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不戊。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979903011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"照象者，如丙日巳午未年月日，遇時上一位卯木，謂之木火相照，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979919395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甚吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979919395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如壬癸日中子辰全屬象者，遇時上一位金，謂之金水相照，","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979935779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大吉；年干有照者，亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979935779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"迹","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979952163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"返象者，乃所謂値月令，用神引至時上一位，爲絶之鄕，謂之用之","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979968547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222123049"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不用，皆爲返運。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979968547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又遇返之太甚，則不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715979984931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼象者，乃秋金生甲亡曰地文四位純金，謂之鬼象，只要鬼生旺","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980001315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運皆吉，怕見至死絶之鄕，而支身旺則不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980001315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏象者，乃寅午戌三合全，又値五月生蓬𡈼日，而天干無丁字透","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980017699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露壬水又無根，乃取午中有丁火合壬水而伏之，所謂伏象。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980017699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運至","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980034083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木火之鄉皆吉，只愁水旺之鄕則不利也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980034083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論格局生死引用","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980050467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫格局者，自有定論，今畧而述之：印綬見財，行財運，支兼死絶，必","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980066851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入黄泉。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980066851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如有比肩，庶幾有解。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980083235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正官見殺，及傷官刑冲破害，歲運相","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980099619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"併，必死。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980099619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正財偏財見比肩分奪，刼財羊刀，又見歲運冲合，必死。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980116003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980132387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官之格，財旺身弱，官殺重見，混雜冲刃，歳運又見必死，活則殘傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980132387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱祿、拱貴塡寶，又見官空亡冲刃，歲運重見卽死，日祿歸時刑冲。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980148771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破害見七煞，官星空亡冲刃必死。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980165155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺官大忌，歲運相併，必死。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980181539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980197923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222139433"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸格並忌殺及填實，歲運倂臨，必死。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980197923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"會諸凶神惡勾絞、空亡、吊客、","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980214307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓病、死官諸殺，十死九生。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980214307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星太歲，用多身弱，元犯七殺，身輕，有","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980230691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"救則吉，無救則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980230691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金多夭折，水盛飄流，木旺則夭，土多痴呆，火多","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980247075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頑愚，木過不及。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980247075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作此論，一不可拘，二須敢斷，必須理會推之，求其","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980263459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生死决矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980263459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"征者，戰也，如臣觸其君，乃下犯上之意。","logicSentenceId":"7679063715980296227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日干支冲尅太嵗曰征；運","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066754612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支干傷冲太歲，亦曰征。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066754612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲干支冲日干支者，亦曰征。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066770996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但看八字","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066787380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有無救助，仔細推詳，百發百中。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066787380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：干支合太歲，干支曰晦。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066803764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲運合","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066820148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲干亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066820148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇此者主悔氣，一年反覆，欲速不逹。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066836532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如乙丑、乙亥、壬","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066852916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申、乙巳，運行辛未丙寅年，日干之壬剋太歲之丙，日支申庚尅太","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066852916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲之寅甲，又且寅刑己，巳刑申，申刑寅，行辛未運，合太歲之木局","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066852916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官，皆不爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066852916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其年甲干月火旺，戰尅己土，乙木生所爲戰，故死","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066869300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222155817"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於非命矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066869300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看子平之法，專論財官，以月上財官爲𦂳要。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066902068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發覺在於日時，要消","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066918452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詳於强弱。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066918452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論官星不論格局，論格局不論官星。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066934836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入格者，非富卽貴；","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066951220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不入格者，非夭卽貧。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066951220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官怕傷財，怕刼印綬見財，愈多愈灾。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066967604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官見","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066983988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官，爲禍百端，若非疾病傷軀，必當官訟囚繫，子𭈬妻傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716066983988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官見官，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067000372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元有者重，元無者輕。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067000372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官見官，重則遷徙，輕則刑責。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067016756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官見官，心","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067033140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地勾曲，詭譎多詐，傲物氣高，常以天下之人不如己，貴人憚之，小","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067033140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人惡之。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067033140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官用財者富，傷官刼財者貧。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067049524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年上傷官，富貴不久。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067065908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月上","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067082292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官，父母不完。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067082292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰上傷官，難爲妻妾；時上傷官，子孫無傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067098676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲月傷","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067115060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官刧財，生於貧賤之家；日下時中有財官，先貧後富；歲月財官印","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067115060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"綬，生於富貴之家，故日時傷官切財，先富後貧，傷損子息，無晚福。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067115060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故傷官見官，官殺混雜，爲人好色多淫，作事小巧寒賤。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067131444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙木巳上","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067147828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222172201"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲太乙","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067147828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上登明，男好色，女淫濫，官殺混雜，有財者吉，無財印者","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067147828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067147828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但看財命有氣，縱背祿而不貧；財絶命衰，縱建祿而不富。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067164212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼財","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067180596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"敗財，心高下賤，見者主貧樊鬼中逢，官須逼追。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067180596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼克我兮貴，我尅","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067196980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼兮富。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067196980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彼兮我生，以仗母力，長我精神；我生彼兮，常懷逼追。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067213364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財入","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067229748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月今，勤儉慳吝。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067229748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱有刼財，比刃多者，刑父傷妻，不聚財也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067246132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"路伎商","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067262516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賈，須觀落地之財；辛相須看得時正祿。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067262516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺梟重，走偏他鄕之客；","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067278900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官刼財，瞞心負頼之徒。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067278900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重犯財官者貴，重犯亡神者夭。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067295284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺宜","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067311668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制，獨立爲强。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067311668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明殺合去，五行和氣春風；暗殺合來，刑傷害巳。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067328052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時殺","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067344436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壹冲，喜刃無制，女多產厄，男犯刑名；二德無破，女必腎良，男多思","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067344436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孝。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067344436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官用印，去財方可馳名；傷官用財，傷官處須當發福。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067360820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入格淸","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067377204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奇者富，入格不成者貧。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067377204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一格二格，非卿卽相；三格四格，財宫不純，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067393588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非𨽾卒，多是九流。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067393588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六陰朝陽李月，只作印看，吉神惟怕破害，凶神","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067409972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不喜刑冲。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067409972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官印食，定顯慈祥之德；傷官刧刃，難逃寡惡之名。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067426356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067442740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222188585"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天無合，乃飄流之徒。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067442740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬趨艮，逢亥月者貧。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067459124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬落空亡，操心落魄","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067475508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之人。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716 {"lines":[{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑多者，爲人不義；合多者，疎皆亦親。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067524660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合多主晦，沖多主凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067541044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰多好闘，戍多好訟，辰戍魁罡，多凶少吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067557428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時曰空亡，難爲妻干，交","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067573812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馳驛馬，别土離鄕，食神干聇，勝似財官。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067573812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順食者，食前方丈，倒食者，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067590196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"簞食豆羹。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067590196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食衰梟旺，不死也灾。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067606580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水潤下分文學𩔰逹，上稼穡兮，富","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067622964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴經商。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067622964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金水雙淸而爲道，火土混濁而爲僧。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067639348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子平最嫌己亥卯酉，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067655732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"切忌寅申，巳入亥宮，見陰木，終爲損壽。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067655732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時逢丙寅，則冠帶簪纓；","logicSentenceId":"76790637 {"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分三，前賢不載。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067737652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且夫論格局者，明有定例，撮口訣者，畧舉一二，當","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067754036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂諸賢經旨，無合取用，庶可易通。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067754036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道合無窮，學無止法。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067770420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：更能","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067786804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"絶慮忘思，鑑命無差無誤矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067786804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羣興論","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067803188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一、當興，二掘起，三聚興，四中興，五未興。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人生有秉富貢之榮，而當興富貴，而且享，享福而保其終身。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067819572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067835956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何故也？","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067835956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢四柱中身主專莊，而其所用吉神，或爲財，或爲官，或爲","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067852340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬，或爲食神，俱各帶祿權得令，不偏不雜，又無刑冲傷損尅害，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067852340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方爲富貴本源之不雜也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067852340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"他日能成才振耀前人之基業，成當代","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067868724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之功名，不招讒謗，不致傷害。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067868724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又在途上歩歩皆吉，四柱益加吉利，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067885108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是謂源清流潔，故能享福以過人，保其中而無悔也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067885108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆由命運。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067901492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067917876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"路滔滔，生旺而然，非幸也，乃命也，可不辯乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067917876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人之生，又有窮餓","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067934260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其身，愁苦孤寒，顚倒無何，一旦逢時，興然而起，或當營財滿屋，白","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067934260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222221353"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手庄田，或致君澤民，獨歩台鼎，斯人也，可後異見。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067934260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其故何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067950644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢因","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067967028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中曰主，生氣末旺，所用貴神，悉皆得位而成旺。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067967028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又日合格，奈何","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067983412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日主無力，不能勝任，其福亦勞困偃蹇，勿逢運扶。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067983412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其曰干得其强","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067999796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"健，用神出，虎嘯風生，元命用神方爲我用，我其乘之，則勃然最興。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716067999796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是偏氣乗和，衰以遇旺，故迎古而作掘起。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068016180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫建業創功，有大小","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068032564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之不同，當於所遭命之輕重辯之可也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068032564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有日","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068048948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"强，則四柱五行，殺純不雜，身殺俱旺，則根本元無制伏，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068048948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴不成。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068048948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟待運來制伏殺神，則化爲權，方此出興才德爲公卿，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068065332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"功名顯逹，出類超羣，是其身旺，殺神逢制，化爲權也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068065332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制神力旺，發","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068081716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神非常，安得其人不顯達，以至極品之尊貴乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068081716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"實有共命，又要行","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068098100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其運以扶，方見出與也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068098100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如茍運不至，卽常人耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068114484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又要四柱中曰主","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068130868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"健旺，用神亦旺，各相停，均爲富屋朱門，貴命之腎子也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068130868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及其長大，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068147252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成立豐隆，一逢惡曜運加臨元命，見封財而奪之，因其官而傷之，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068147252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222237737"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨其印而壞之，逢其食而損乏。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068147252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遭逢此運，祸不勝言，所以勝年見","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068163636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傾而不發。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068163636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如其惡連一去，又逢好運扶身，使我用神一新，譬如枯","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068180020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苗得雨，勃然而興；鴻毛遇風，飄然而舉，不可禦也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068180020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有人生五行身旺，羊刃比肩，俱各争旺，惟有財官殺神等物，虛","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068196404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浮輕少，無力成功名矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068196404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出門行運，又非作福之地，所以一生飢塞。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068212788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勞苦落剝，有志無成，或至中三晚景，頓逢殺運，假殺爲權，制伏羊","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068229172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刀，或得權貴以顯揚，或招貲財而發福，當隨五行淸濁，以遇其運","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068229172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而别之，是一生窮困，忽然而興起於中年晚景也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068229172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故知此元命用","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068245556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官乎生無氣，卽至運到方成富貴二興利，故未興者，乃得運","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068245556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而然也，學者可不勉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068245556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論興亡，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068261940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人生柱中，有純殺爲用也，殺神未制，則爲曰屋窮途之人，或作","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068278324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豪門卓幹之士。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068278324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故用逢制殺運，假殺而起，進用朝廷，操懽威福，而","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068294708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222254121"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不可脫制伏運，一入財鄕，則能党殺，便興禍患。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068294708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如此官旺殺旺運，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068311092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元功失計，所以命黨殺運，倘來生凶，偶然遇流年財殺少旺，殺神","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068311092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相黨，倂合興殃，身主孤寒尅害，輕則傾家徒配，重則刑棄其身，故","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068311092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其殺神併合，凶亡之可畏也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068311092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有如此殺刀者，一一難免禍福焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068327476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068343860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有柱中月令正氣官星，爲一生富貴，惟逢印運則利。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068343860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢官星喜逢","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068360244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財旺以生之，印旺以護之，故令其人能行仁布德，緯國經邦，懽重","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068360244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爵高，所以貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068360244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後遇殺神旺鄕，殺神祿位，歲殺併臨，官化爲鬼，丧","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068376628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身必矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716068376628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不行殺運，或逢傷官運，又無印綬治之，傷官得地，祿遭傷","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754620431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隕，䘮妻尅子，剝職生災，立可見矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754620431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更遇流年，儻地損官受剋，必致","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754636815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡爲𢡖惡，故欲官祿逢傷而免剝戮者，不甚難之乎！","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754636815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如有高見明","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754653199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"識，知進退存亡之檅而保其身者，官祿逢傷，六親免禍，亦當自己","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754653199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受惡疾而終者矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754653199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有四柱中所尃用神，無官殺氣，惟偏財正財","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754669583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當旺而己，財神當道，隱隱興𨺚，積財聚寳，徂少貴矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754669583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲知且看行。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754685967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222270505"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運如何若財逢官祿旺之鄉，又成富貴之局。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754702351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"設有不幸，財神脱局，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754718735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃相逢，財傾福敗，多患其凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754718735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及流年冲合，羊刃，財神盡傷，元命","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754735119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰絕，羊刃生凶，敗亡極矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754735119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫禀陰陽而生天地間，故造化之賦於人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754767887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禀造化而生，物亦如","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754784271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，莫不由陰陽變化。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754784271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是故推人吉凶休咎，斯理昭著。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754800655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然術家之法，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754817039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"固多究徴，索子平之外未有矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754817039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子平一法，專以日","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754833423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"干。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲主，而取提","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754833423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"綱所用之物爲令，次及年月時支，以表其端。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754833423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡格用月令提綱，勿","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754849807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於傍求年日時爲格。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754849807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今人生不知其法，於此百法百失。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754866191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"譬如月令","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754882575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以金、木、水、火、土爲要，但有一事而定言之，若於傍求，則有失悞。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754882575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754898959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其月令實事，則以遍求輕重淺深，格局破冲可也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754898959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"西山易鑑先生","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754915343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得其變通，將十格分爲六格爲重，曰官、曰印、曰財、曰殺，曰食神，曰","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754915343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官，而消息之，無不驗矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754915343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其法曰：逢官看財，逢殺看印，逢印看官，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754931727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222286889"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斯有奥妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754931727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不傳之法，取四者不偏不倚，生尅制化，而遇破休囚爲","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754948111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下運，有生有去爲福，有助有剝爲禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754948111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其理深長，最宜消詳切當，不","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754964495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昧庸術。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754964495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟熟讀幸加勉焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716754980879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子平之法，以曰爲主，先看提綱爲重，次用年曰、時支，合成硌局，方","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755013647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可斷之。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755013647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆以月令爲用，不可以年取格。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755030031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡看子平之數，取格不定，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755046415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十有九差。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755046415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟易鑑先生之法，月令用金只用金，用火只用火，八字","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755062799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水多，却取水，不來取火，况此差矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755062799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以法斷之，悞其大半。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755079183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是西川易","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755095567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鑑叅透，以機十八格凶，取六格爲重，用相生定格，合局，仍用年曰。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755095567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下以推輕重淺深，萬無一失。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755111951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六格法曰：逢官眉財，逢財㸔殺，逢殺","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755128335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看印，逢印看官。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755128335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用印不怕殺，是殺拘印，印拘身，還作上格取之。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755144719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如四杜逢印看七殺，但有官殺在運行官殺鄕，亦作貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755161103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月合通","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755177487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官，柱中遇財，財生官，妙矣，乃富歳之格。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755177487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中見財，要人財旺至，興","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755193871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222303273"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發福矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755193871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但見一殺，則以殺爲重，不可又行財旺之鄕，乃財生殺旺，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755210255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當作貧賤之格。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755210255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡格當以殺官言之。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755226639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"造化，先須看曰主，後把提綱看次第。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755259407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱專論一財官。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755275791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身𦙴財官","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755292175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可富貴，若還身旺財官損，只是朝求暮討而財官旺時曰主映紫","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755292175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"袍金帶石行疑則官旺而曰主弱，運行身旺最爲奇。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755292175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰主旺而財","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755308559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官弱，運入財官名利馳。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755308559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日主坐下有財官，月令相逢貴不難。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755324943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755341327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財宫爲緫論，早年富貴祿高攀。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755341327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺無依，更遷祖，不遷居。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755357711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死在外","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755374095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地，身旺無倚，損財傷妻。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755374095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或是外家冷落，或過房入舍。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755390479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺印旺，破","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755406863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財不聚，有財只好善破，或置物創屋，或門大而倉廪虛，內不足而","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755406863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外有餘。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755406863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官喜露，露則淸高；財要藏，藏則豊厚；殺藏官露，惡隱善揚。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755423247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人生遇此，名振鄕邦。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755439631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官殺太重身更强，一逢制伏作賢良。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755456015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺官拱","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755472399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印貴非輕，烜赫威揚定振名。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755472399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身居九夏，火土多，相逢水濟貴中和。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755488783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222319657"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水火元來要旣濟，管教名利振山河。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755505167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生居三冬，水冷金寒。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755521551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得火相","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755537935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"扶，莫作等閒。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755537935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火勢炎炎，如無水運行水鄕亦是羙；水勢滔滔，若無","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755554319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火，運入火鄕亦爲竒。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755554319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南方火炎，利入北方水運；北方水寒，利入南","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755570703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方火運。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755570703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東方木多，宜入西方金運；西方金旺，宜入東方木運水火。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755587087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有旣濟之功，金木有成名之論。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755603471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行得其相濟，威名榮振九天。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755619855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755636239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"邱","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755636239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行，辰戌丑未，若是重見，骨肉刑悲，父母不足，兄弟異離，親戚","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755652623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"情疎，更虧妻子，冲破提綱，多虧父母，或是刑，或是離異。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755652623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺比肩","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755669007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐驛馬，兄弟飄蓬好消洒。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755669007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八宇四馬總交馳，身榮勞碌任東西。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755685391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755701775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有身閒心不定，動則風流静則悲。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755701775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財星入庫主聚財，財星入庫妻","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755718159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"慳吝，謹守貲財不作人。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755718159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是財星至四馬，妻賢無處不欣欣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755734543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官殺","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755750927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重重不帶財，妻能内助不和諧。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755750927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公姑不驚妻無禮，奪𨚫夫懽命所","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755767311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"排。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755767311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星若也逢生旺，更得長生旺在時。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755783695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子息聰明多俊秀，見孫箇","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755800079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"箇着緋衣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755800079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此刼傷官印，傷妻更損兒。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755816463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"養子多不孝，乞養總非宜。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755832847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755849231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222336041"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主七殺帶梟神，妻主虛胎小産多。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755849231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"血氣不調成血疾，更看行運又","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755865615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何如。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755865615","margin
