{"lines":[{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男孒梟食重重見，身弱多因癆病隨。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755881999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女入梟食非爲吉，産難","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755898383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驚人病亦危。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755898383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人官旺兼財旺，招得賢夫更好見。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755914767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是財官俱受","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755931151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"損，傷夫尅子守空幃。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755931151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬旺身身更旺，爲人刑尅主孤貧。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755947535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得不","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755963919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顯財又顯，亦爲超邁貴人扶。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755963919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是招非，只緣水火相尅，或是日昏","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755980303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼暗。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755980303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命若也傷官旺，坐下傷官會馬夫。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716755996687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朝暮喃喃口不絶，百年","logicSentenceId":"7679063716756013071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終見帶刑孤。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716756013071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日如乙巳、戊辰、庚午辛未，日，干帶之，權貴之妻也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716756029455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更","logicSentenceId":"7679063716756045839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇此皆囚，前道","logicSentenceId":"7679063716756062223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛巳壬午，甲甲乙酉，俱是坐下財官逢之，富貴不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主賢，妻亦主貴，更不四柱又何如。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716756062223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如丙子丁丑、戊寅己卯生人","logicSentenceId":"7679063716756078607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少，丁亥戊子并庚寅，日主逢之命不輕。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716756094991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯丙申丁酉位，財官內","logicSentenceId":"7679063716756111375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隱顯聲名。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716756111375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥甲申見庚戊，印綬財官內禋藏，更得丙辰壬戌至。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716756127759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四時符印不非常。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716756144143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子内寅興于卯。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716756160527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳壬辰癸巳同，虛各虛利","logicSentenceId":"7679063716756176911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"任飄蓬。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716756176911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥庚申并己巳，生下財官並無有，妻宮子女帶虚花，東","logicSentenceId":"7679063716756193295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222352425"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"西南北是身家。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716756193295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午戊戌并庚子，女尅丈夫男尅子。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716756209679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳丙午丁","logicSentenceId":"7679063716756226063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未同，重重壬子主孤窮。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716756226063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅乙卯與戊午，支干同類子不足。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716756242447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己未","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851089442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申及癸亥，月令更旺成禍害，月主財官印綬全，月時符合福爲","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851089442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"綿。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851089442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干支同類併身旺，尅子刑妻破祖田。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851105826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好將四柱分强弱，莫犯隂","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851122210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽執一言。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851122210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此是五行眞妙訣，不逢智者莫虚傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851138594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此即淨禪師之造也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論命細法：","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851154978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"苟僧判正傳歌，卽印淨禪師也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過房七殺帶三刑，父明母暗是偷生。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851171362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我明我暗從他象，父死之時","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851187746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不送靈。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851187746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚金化成火相助，父亡見血不須疑。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851204130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"比肩三合族人害，三","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851220514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑䨐落及離妻。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851220514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"比肩暗損及門房，兄弟無情被罔欺。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851236898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如帶比肩成","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851253282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"别象，弟兄不睦報君知。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851253282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻帶三合及坐妻，妻曾認得是親支。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851269666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐妻","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851286050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"透妻成別象，定主離妻再娶妻。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851286050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多透妻財須怕婦，妻歸絶地不生","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851302434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兒。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851302434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化成别象尅正夫，必主欺夫禮義疎。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851318818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺食强亦如此，食明旺","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851335202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相懽然殂。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851335202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽母專位主傷生，母來又上受其驚。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851351586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天時地利生過月，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851367970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222368809"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七杀兼刑顶，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851367970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上偏印归杀，地，母有病。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁双者顶双。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851367970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"靈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰禄归時","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851384354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須應夢，小兒無乳食冲刑。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851384354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子乙西對偏生，丙戌丁丑妻獲靈。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851400738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"背","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851417122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父而生甲乙卯，此時須要記分明。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851417122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令甲子辰從水也，不然五月無水有火，不從也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851433506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊癸化火巳","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851449890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午，天干地支從火也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851449890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又將坐日甲木論。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851466274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"珞錄子云：學釋則離宮","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851482658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"修定，是如此取用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851482658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"杜老先生教鏡鍾僧判將此爲例，此日叅","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851499042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詳朝暮若相似此半年，忽然間得此時入處。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851499042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公云：初學進退了。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851515426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幾番後獲此法，非與他陰陽也，此别家幽微之經也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851531810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乂論心印","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851548194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"口訣，雙頂者，只可言八字有雙丙丁者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851548194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若只一丙一丁，下","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851564578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有冲刑者，可言歪頂無失也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851564578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又一法，言人見女麻靣者，是戊己","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851580962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"被甲乙尅之，不然，靣主有疤痕。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851580962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳見乙巳、乙卯、乙亥是矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851597346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851613730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此逓相貫穿，天干地支徃來相尅，化合之氣，死生破敗，皆此所","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851613730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851613730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其干支萬變如此，化病源此中出，成敗此中出，命之幽徵，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851630114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222385193"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫不由於此，而假外來哉。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851630114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更於此看得到處不須歸家。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851646498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多說","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851662882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851679266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱支中元有忌者，切忌運中透出病，運中忌財，作凶財，歲戰便","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851679266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲災。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851679266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡坐煞者，不可行煞，旺運身旺又加旺運，歲運併來，傷殺","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851695650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重我無情者，是綬。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851695650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"怕行財運，主惡死，或血疾。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851712034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬多母衆，或","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851728418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食衆乳，或寄養外人家。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851728418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如四柱有官星流氣，太歲冲官星，必因","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851744802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官訟。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851744802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇比肩故者，言比肩之人救助無事。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851761186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流氣轉生財官者，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851777570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生識生財，傷官有三，傷之不盡，多出吏道。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851777570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元有物氣傷官運及","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851793954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬，歲復見官星者，多凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851793954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化氣怕逢返本，不化，有變局。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851810338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如化不","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851826722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成者，可只用本日干斷。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851826722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如己士用癸水爲妾，運逢辰庫，主妾","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851843106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"興，自家人私通。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851843106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙用乙爲母，遇庚申，母多外情。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851859490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙用庚爲父，遇","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851875874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅丙多主父弱。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851875874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊用癸爲妻，若坐酉宮，或主好酒，本元無財，官","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851892258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運逢財，官有主凶，他人發財發官，火入水鄕，主血疾。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851892258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸引歸","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851908642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯，主陽不興，時歸敗絶，老後無成。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851908642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日干興流氣，公主悔氣入","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851925026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222401577"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851925026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令六甲日，以徧陽土爲父，陰士爲妻，陽金子陰金，女陽木。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851941410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰木同法，餘名倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851957794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻星入敗地，主妻不正。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851974178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如己酉、庚午、癸酉、","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851990562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑，是財入敗地也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716851990562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申、己亥乃四長生，必得聰明。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852006946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻財官印","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852023330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得氣爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852023330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元見財官，商旅農家，財多印陷，少年尅母，母不貞潔，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852039714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必重嫁。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852039714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人之命，日干同者，若我旺他衰，我爲正；他旺我衰，他","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852056098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲正。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852056098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼癸之水盛者，聰明多智，女多淫濫。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852072482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時上見財者，必須入","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852088866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舍。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852088866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支中有官無刑破者，因妻發官；支中有殺無制，囚妻致禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852105250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852121634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"令壬癸日運逆行者，生於正月、二月，取戊巳土爲官，故爲祿絕，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852121634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此爲背祿。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852121634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取丙丁火爲則，四柱不透出財神，此爲背祿不貧也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852138018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯暗藏三陽四陽之火爲財，如行子丑運，遇比肩分奪，交亥","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852154402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運，木長生而助火，主發財；戌運亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852154402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉運火死水敗，主破敗。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852170786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852187170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸生寅卯月，順運者，巳午運發財福，亦忌財神透露，歲運亦","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852187170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852187170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇財神透出，四柱元有羊刃、比肩，因妻致禍，忌申酉二運。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852203554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222417961"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如四柱元有印者，百色更改，童故鼎新。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852219938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如流年遇殺者凶，酉運","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852236322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"裸形沐浴刼殺，主死。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852236322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙子、丁丑、戊寅、辛卯、壬辰、癸巳、丙午、丁","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852252706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未、戊申、辛酉、𡈼戌、癸亥時犯之，多因孝病中成親。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852252706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如用子女之","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852269090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法，不喜入墓庫，如子女入庫，主無子女庫日用甲爲偏財，爲父，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852269090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐甲行酉地，爲財臨殺位，父死不歸家。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852269090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽干女命，食𮁾多者爲","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852285474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"娼；陰干女命，食傷官多者爲妓，有物去之爲良。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852285474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火至天干多主","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852301858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瘰癧，地支多時生瘡，用殺返輕，多爲僧道之首。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852301858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官說","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852318242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官若傷盡，却喜見官星。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852334626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官若論財，見禍不輕來。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852351010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官若用印。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852367394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅殺不如刑，傷官若論財，帶合有聲名。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852383778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官用財，不宜印鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852400162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852416546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見官，印運不妨，雜氣財官印俱不忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852416546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩戊合一，癸得再嫁，妻財受","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852432930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兙，生子無百。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852432930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬比肩，不忌財鄕，印綬多根，身旺，必帶印綬被傷","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852449314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅父母。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852449314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官殺混雜尅父母，財多身弱尅父母，干與支同尅妻。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852465698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852482082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222434345"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成寅，不怕殺多，女命比肩，卽姊妹貪斧多謊詐財有刼不怕露就","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852482082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852482082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火命人最好，月支屬火，干頭有木，提出寅矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852498466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉弱格，見殺必","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852514850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶，官貴火盛，旺處不傾。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852514850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土命不論胞胎，只論曰時，不怕官殺混雜，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852531234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽干方論，陰干不取子怕寅午火不怕水，寅木不怕金，巳金不怕","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852531234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火，己士不怕木，午火不熖水，永同川金不怕火，巳士戊十不怕木，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852531234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯木怕酉金，辰土怕寅木。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852531234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙日五月不怕殺，四柱元有病，要去病，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852547618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不去病不發。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716852547618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

l,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺尅後，子息必虧。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935647266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬入妻宮，必得能家之婦；殺臨子位，必招悖逆。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935663650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之見，祿入妻宮，食妻之祿；印臨子位，受子之榮；梟居子位，破祖之","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935680034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1386","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222483497"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"基。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935680034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則官月旺，得父眥財。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935696418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所忌財傷祿薄，最嫌鬼旺身衰。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935712802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"原其尅彼","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935729186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲財，生我爲印，食神暗見，人物豐肥；梟印重生，祖財飄蕩；咸池財","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935729186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露，主淫奢凶殺合年防自刃。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935729186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土尅水而成腹臟之疾；火鍜金以患","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935745570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癆瘵之災。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935745570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花會祿，酒色亡身；財旺身衰，因財䘮命。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935761954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1396","lineNum":0,"lineType" 63716935876642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰則女當寡困。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935876642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官貴生年，化凶煞而各垂萬古。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935893026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴忌乎多，祿宜乎","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935909410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少，絶慮忘思，無差無誤。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935909410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1414","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222499881"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又發財人元尅出來，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935925794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1416","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙見寅卯，祿，俱皆極用，申乙酉見之，不拘此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得一分三，緣何議。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935925794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祿","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935942178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬飛天是歲合，時日分兩頭，切須仔細求。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935942178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子若逢生，奏對，常人","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935958562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主災晦，心懷悔退成何事。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935958562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重陽剝官位，柱中有祿運逢財，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935974946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1423","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用乙見𫝕是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金主自天來，言前能說貴與賤，亦須不大運。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935974946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡行運逢祿馬，發","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935991330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"跡爲官也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716935991330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天月二德爲救解，百災不爲害。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936007714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向祿臨財甚希奇。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936024098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴頭","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936040482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主宫貲。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936040482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命中祿馬同，貴人福祿進珠珍。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936056866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人君子坐刑煞，名成少","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936073250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年發陰陽貴賤宜消息，熟曉於𮌍臆。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936073250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時身命許多般，一訣通變","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936089634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"看。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936089634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妖祥賦","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936106018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命理深微，子平可推。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936106018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先要取其日干，次則詳其月令，年時共表其","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936122402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936122402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妖神不忒于歲月，通叅於成敗，禍福無遺。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936138786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或有不見之形，須","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936155170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當審作；更有分抽之緒，後學難知。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936155170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天淸地濁，自然禀一氣之生。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936171554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936187938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行世貴，忌刑冲尅破之鄉；四柱支干，喜三合六合之地。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936187938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅中己亥，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936204322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1447","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222516265"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃財官印綬長生；辰戌丑未，係祿馬印星奇庫。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936204322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日貴時貴，大忌刑","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936220706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲尅破；拱祿拱貴，最怕塡實刑衝。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936220706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀無合有合，逢凶不凶，傷官之","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936237090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於年運到官鄕，不喜羊刃冲合，歲君運臨而禍至。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936237090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌魁罡，忌言","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936253474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星怕逢七煞；金神日刃，喜七煞而忌刑冲。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936253474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時上偏官，要制伏弱官，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936269858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"强官專殺莫逢见旺，亦要制伏爲强，但看本有本無，遇而不遇，要","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936269858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禀中和。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936269858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥多逢丑，地，怕塡實，不喜官星。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936286242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子日再逢子，時嫌丑","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936302626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午，亦畏庚辛。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936302626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸亥子，祿馬飛天。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936319010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離巽丙丁聚巳午倒冲天祿。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936335394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1463", {"lines":[{"lineId":"1482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人居六合，心相五行，欲曉二生，辯形察性。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936532002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星愷悌，貴氣軒昻。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936548386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936564770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"優游而仁慈寬大，懷豁逹而和𢃡聲音。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936564770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊姿美而秀麗，","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936581154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性格敏而","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936581154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聰明，印綬主多智慧，豈身自作心慈。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936581154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神善能飮食，體厚謳歌。","logicSentenceId":"7679063716936597538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530566656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官七殺，勢壓三公。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530566656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜酒色而偏爭好閗，受軒昻而扶弱欺强。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530583040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"情性","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530599424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如虎，急躁如風。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530599424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"梟印當權，使心機而始勤終怠，好學㙯而學多少","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530615808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530615808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏印劫刃，岀祖離","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530632192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1498","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"家，外象謙和尚義，内心狠毒無知，有刻剝之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"意，無慈惠之心；偏正財露，輕財好義，愛人趨奉，好說是非，嗜酒貪","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530632192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"花，亦係如此。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530632192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽官傷䀆，多㙯多能，使心機而傲物，氣高，多譎詐而","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530648576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"侮人，志大權高，骨俊眼人，眉粗目德心善穩厚而作事慈祥；魁罡","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530648576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性嚴，有操持而爲人𦖟敏。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530648576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰貴月貴，朝榮暮榮，爲人純粹而有姿","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530664960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"色，作仁德而不驕奢。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530664960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金神貴格，火地奇哉，有剛斷明敏之財，無刻","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530681344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剝欺瞞之心。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530681344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳鼠貴遇午冲，貧如顔子；壬騎龍背逢丁破，慾比","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530697728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1509","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222549033"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申棖。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530697728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"井欄飛天，其心傲物。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530714112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑合趨艮，智足多仁；六甲趨乾，主仁慈","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530730496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而剛介心平。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530730496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五陰會局，爲人佛口蛇心；二德印生，作事施恩布德。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530746880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行有化，看何以推之，四柱無情，取元干而論也。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530763264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且火炎主燥，必","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530779648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲燥而好禮；水淸兑下，主言話而施仁。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530779648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金白水淸，質黑肥圓，土氣","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530796032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"厚重，信在四時，彙合如然，四時返此。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530796032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事則舉其大略，須要察其細","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530812416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"微。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530812416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲識情理，學者用心於此。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530828800","margi {"lines":[{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大極判爲天地，一氣分有陰陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530861568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日干爲三，専論財官。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530877952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月支取格。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530894336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530910720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格不正者敗，無格有用者成。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530910720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有官莫尋格局，有格局喜官星、官印","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530927104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財食，無破淸高，殺傷枭刃，用之爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530927104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善惡相交，喜去殺而從善，吉","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530943488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶混雜，𤆔害吉以向凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530943488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有官有殺宜。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530959872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺制殺爲竒，有官有印畏。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530976256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財興，助財爲禍，身强殺淺，殺運無防；殺重身輕，制鄕爲富。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717530992640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺印","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531009024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜行財地，財多身𢐅，畏入財鄕。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531009024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男逢比刼，傷官，尅妻害子，女犯","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531025408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222565417"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官偏印丧子刑夫，㓜失雙親。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531025408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財星太重，爲人孤尅，身旺無依，年","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531041792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲月令，離祖成家。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531041792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰破提沖，强斷再續，時日對冲，傷妻尅子；日通","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531058176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月令，得祖安身。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531058176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以水遇春長，遇庚辛反假爲權；火旣夏生，見𡈼","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531074560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸，能爲福厚。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531074560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土逢辰戌廿未，木重成名；金坐申酉之中，火鄕發福；","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531090944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水居亥子，戊巳難侵；身坐休囚，平生未濟。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531090944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺者喜逢祿馬，身弱","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531107328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者忌見財官。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531107328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得時俱爲旺論，失令便作衰看。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531123712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱無根，得時爲旺；","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531140096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日干無氣，遇刼爲强。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531140096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身弱喜印，主旺宜官，財官印綬，破則無功；殺","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531156480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷梟劫，去之爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531156480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙秋生金透露，水木火運荣昌；丙丁冬降，水","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531172864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"汪洋，水土木方貴𩔰。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531172864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳春生，西南方有救；庚辛夏長，水土運無","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531189248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷；壬癸逢於土旺，金木宜榮。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531189248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有官有印，無破爲榮；無印無官，有格取貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531353088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531369472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格喜偏官，金神最宜制伏。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531369472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雜氣財官，刑冲則發。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531385856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官貴太盛，旺處必","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531402240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傾。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531402240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身太旺喜見財，官主太柔，不宜祿馬旺官旺。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531418624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印與財旺，","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531435008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入墓有","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531435008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍，傷官食神并身旺與庫興災","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531435008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運貴往干支取，歲重向乎官求。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531451392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531467776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多者行財而發，財旺者，遇比何妨。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531467776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格淸局正，富貴榮華；印旺官生，","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531484160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聲名特逹。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531484160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合官非爲貴取，合殺莫作凶推。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531500544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花帶殺喜淫奔，華葢","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531516928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢空多刻剝，平生不發；八字休囚，一世無權。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531516928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身衰遇鬼，身旺者則","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531533312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜泄宜傷，身衰者則喜扶喜助，禀中和，莫令太過不及。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531533312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遵此法，","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531549696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推詳禍福，驗如影響。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531549696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幽微賦","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531566080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地陰陽二氣，降於春夏秋冬，各生其時。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531566080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有用者則吉，無用者則","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531582464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1602","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222598185"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531582464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以泄天機之妙理，談大道之玄微。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531598848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天即生人，人各有命，所以","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531615232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"早年富霣，八字運限咸和，中主孤單。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531615232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行逢死絶敗，過房入舍；年","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531631616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月冲分，隨母從夫。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531631616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏財空而印旺，早歲父亡；偏財臨死絶殺宮，㓜","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531648000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲母離。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531648000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只爲財多印死，比肩多而兄弟無情，羊刃多而妻宫有損。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531664384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官逢死氣之方，子招難得；若見傷官太盛，子亦難留；如遇冲破提","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531680768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"綱，定主離於祖業。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531680768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再見空亡，三番四廢。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531697152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬逢生，母當賢貴；偏財","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531713536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸祿，父必崢嶸。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531713536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星臨祿旺之鄉，子當榮題；七殺遇長生之位，及","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531729920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"招貴夫。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531729920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自身借宮所生，必是依人過活；妻星失令，半路抛離。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531746304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若乃","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531762688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作宮所生，亦是他人義女，酒色猖狂，只是桃花帶殺，慈祥敏慧；天","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531762688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月二德聚來，印綬旺而子少息稀，正官旺而女多男少。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531762688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"梟神興，早","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531779072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年折夭；食神旺，老壽而高。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531779072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏財逢敗，父主風流；子矅若臨，破家蕩","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531795456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"產，自身蓬敗，早歲興衰。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531795456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻入墓，不得妻財；父臨庫，父當先死。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531811840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"比肩","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531828224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢祿，兄弟名高。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531828224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神多而好飧食，正官旺而受沽滋，","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531844608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身臨沐浴之","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531844608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1632","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222614569"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年，恐愁水厄；生入鬬尅之年，必逄火晦；","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531844608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女帶桃花坐殺，定主淫奔；","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531860992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷多而印綬被尅，母當淫蕩。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531860992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月冲者，難爲祖業；日時冲者，妻子","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531877376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"招遲。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531877376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見天元刑戰，父母難靠；如遇地支所生，凶中成吉，日主弱，","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531893760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水火相戰而招是非；甲木衰，逢金旺，而無仁無義。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531893760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃男命之玄","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531910144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"機，畧說女人之奥妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531910144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純粹在於八字，純有。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531926528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴者，一官生旺，四柱","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531942912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"休因，必爲貴者；濁淫者五行冲旺，娼淫者官殺交差，命主多合，此","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531942912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲不良。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531942912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滿柱殺多，不爲尅制。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531959296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬多而老無子，傷官旺而幼傷夫。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531975680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荒淫之慾，食神太過，四柱不見夫星，未爲貞潔；官星絶遇，休因孤","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531992064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦獨宿，淸潔源流。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717531992064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"釡猪相遇，木虎相見，四相二夫；土猴重叠，水火","logicSentenceId":"7679063717532008448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢蛇，夫宮早喪；食神一位，逢生旺招千，須當拜聖明。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717532008448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父母之宮，男","logicSentenceId":"7679063717532024832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命同斷，","logicSentenceId":"7679063717532024832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見此書，藏之如實。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717532041216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若何高士，對鏡分明，依其此法，萬無","logicSentenceId":"7679063717532057600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一失。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717532057600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1659","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222630953"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詳其徃聖，鍳以前賢，論生死全憑鬼谷，推洦息端的徐公陽庠陰","logicSentenceId":"7679063717532090368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死，陽死陰生，循環逆順，變化見矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717532090368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫陽木生亥死午，須存亡易見；","logicSentenceId":"7679063717532106752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽木跨馬逢猪，則吉凶可知。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717532106752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮生内而遇鷄死，兌生丁而逢虎傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717532123136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊藏寅而西方没，己生酉而艮中亡，庚逢蛇而崢嶸，而見鼠亦難","logicSentenceId":"7679063717532139520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717532139520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛生子，死在巽地，𡈼生甲，藏於震方。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717532155904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼生癸水衣禄足，運行猴","logicSentenceId":"7679063717532172288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地見灾殃。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717532172288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十干生死同斷，造化依此推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717532188672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627035700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又詳權刃雙題停均，","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627052084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位至侯王，中途或裘或危，運扶干出，平生爲富爲貴，身殺兩停。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627052084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627068468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴者用財而不用官，當權者，用殺而不用印。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627068468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印賴殺生，官因財旺。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627084852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食居生殺居後，功名兩全；酉破卯以破午，財名雙羙。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627101236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"享福五行歸","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627117620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祿，壽彌八字相停。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627117620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晦火無光於稼穡，陰木絶氣於丙丁。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627134004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火虛有熖，","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627150388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金實無聲。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627150388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水泛木浮者活木；士重金理者傷金。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627166772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水盛則危，火明則","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627183156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滅。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627183156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽金得煉，太過變格奔波；陽水歸垣，失令，終爲身弱；土重而掩","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627199540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火無光，逢木反爲有用；水盛則木無定，若好士運方榮。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627199540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行不可","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627215924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1689","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222647337"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太甚，八字須得中和。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627215924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"士止水流全福壽，土虛水盛必傷殘；運會元","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627232308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，須當夭折。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627232308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水盛多仁，土簿寡信。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627248692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水旺居垣須有智，金堅主義𨚫","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627265076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"能爲。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627265076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金水聰明而好色，水土混雜必多愚。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627281460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遐齡得於中和，夭折喪","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627297844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於偏枯。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627297844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌尅制，併冲，必犯刑名；子午相尅，門戸全無禮德。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627314228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"棄印","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627330612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"就財明偏正，棄財就殺論剛柔。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627330612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官無財可恃，雖巧必貧；食神制","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627346996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺逢梟，不貧則夭。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627346996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男多羊刀必重婚，女犯傷官須再嫁。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627363380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧賤者，皆","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627379764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因旺處遭刑；孤寡者，只爲財神破刼。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627379764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"去殺留官方論福；去官留殺","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627396148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有威權；逢傷官反得夫星；乃財命有氣，遇梟神而喪子息福氣無","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627396148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後而孤。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627396148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三戌冲辰禍不淺，兩干不雜利名齊。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627412532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子辛卯相逢，荒淫","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627428916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滚浪；子午卯酉全備，酒色昏迷。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627428916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天干殺𩕙，無制者賤；地支財伏，暗","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627445300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生老奇，因財致富。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627445300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃與歲運併臨，貪食乖疑。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627461684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命用梟食，因有病，","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627478068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姪男爲嗣，義女爲妻。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627478068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰時相逢，卯酉始生，必主迂移；平生敬信神","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627494452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祇，造化因逢戌亥陰尅，陰陽冠陽，則神有用。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627494452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官多無官，大旺傾危；","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627510836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1721","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007038222663721"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺多無殺，反爲不害；財多無財，運逢化殺生災。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627510836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八字得局失垣，平","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627527220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生不遇；四柱歸垣得令，早歲軒昂。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627527220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木逢類象，榮員高遷，命用梟神。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627543604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴營辦，財官俱敗者死，食神逢梟者凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627559988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍藏亥卯，經商利路；絲","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627576372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"綿丁巳孤鸞，合作聰明看女，日犯裸形沐俗，濁濫淫娼。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627576372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰祿歸時","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627592756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見財，則清高富貴；歸祿有財而獲福，無財歸祿必須貧。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627592756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財印混雜，","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627609140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終爲困窮；偏正濁亂，必致傷殘。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627609140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲患逢戰鬬，羊劣不喜刑冲。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627625524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627641908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從戊合，少長無情，多有不仁；庚達丙擾，豈知遇正官，却無俸祿。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627641908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627658292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄逢七殺，乃有聲名。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627658292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不從不化，淹留在路之人；從化得從，顯逹功","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627674676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名之士。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627674676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化成祿旺者生，化成祿絶者死。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627691060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"處僧道之首，用殺反輕，受","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627707444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"憲臺之職。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627707444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏官得地，生地相逢，壯年不祿；時歸敗絕，老後無終。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627723828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627740212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢卯木，遇巳土梟食之人；亥乃神将，遇酉金嗜盃之客。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627740212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財逢旺地","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627756596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人多福，官遇長生命必榮。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627756596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁生酉金，丙辛遇之絶嗣；財臨殺地，父","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627772980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"死而不歸家。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627772980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八字日支同類，殺年殺運生災。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627789364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若能觀賢，熟讀詳玩。","logicSentenceId":"7679063717627805748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
