{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數體洪範，法遵子平。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184486813731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命天地之奥妙，聽空谷之傳聲。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184486830115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一氣流行，則","logicSentenceId":"7679054184486846499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬寒而夏暑；三陽生發，自春長以秋成。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184486846499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竊聞既生有滅，若虧則盈，","logicSentenceId":"7679054184486862883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"造化歸源，尽返寅申己亥。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184486862883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行藏蓄，各居四季邱陵。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184486879267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生長有時，自","logicSentenceId":"7679054184486895651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春夏秋冬之屬；旺衰有數，察貧賤富貴之機。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184486895651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"搜尋八字，专論財官；","logicSentenceId":"7679054184486912035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次究五行，須求氣候。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184486912035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論財官之輕重，察氣候之淺深。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184486928419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推向背財官","logicSentenceId":"7679054184486944803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之得失，論當生格局之高低。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184486944803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"他來尅我爲官鬼，身旺當權，我去尅","logicSentenceId":"7679054184486961187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"他爲妻財。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184486961187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官强則富。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184486977571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年傷身主，乃父與子而不親；時刻曰辰，是子","logicSentenceId":"7679054184486993955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不遵於父命。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184486993955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年尅日兮，上能淩下；日尅年兮，下去犯上。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487010339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得有物","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487026723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"制日干，則可化惡爲祥；更要本主逢喜神，則将凶而變吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487026723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜神慶","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487043107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"會，當知資産豐隆；四柱無情，定見禍端並作；或見本主相冲，三刑","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487043107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重疊，歲運欺淩，必招横事。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487043107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"純粹五行入格，臺閣風清；身强七殺逢","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487059491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423355813888"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏，藩垣鎭守。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487059491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無財官而有格局，青雲得路；無格局而有財官，黄門","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487075875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成名。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487075875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官格局俱損，不貧寒而功名增蹬之夫。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487092259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日干月令俱强，非","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487108643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"窮因，必草茅水逸之士；两丁坐南，離而無制，是不遵禮法凶暴之","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487108643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徒。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487108643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸遇戊巳之相應，乃懷德抱才聰慧之士。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487125027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛逢乙木於南墓，","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487141411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須富而不仁；丙逢辛金於北鎭，縱貧而有德。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487141411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年時月令有偏印，凶","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487157795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉未明；大運歲君逢壽星，災殃立至。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487157795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幼年乏乳，食神遭刑尅之宫；","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487174179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壮歲崢嶸，乃財官居純粹之位。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487174179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽日食神得地，無冲損，則暗合官","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487190563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星；陰日食神無破虧，雖契合則自親印綬；偏財能益壽延年。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487190563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刀","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487206947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七煞，善奪財化鬼，","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487206947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財星有破，費祖風别立他鄉；印綬被傷，失宗業","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487223331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"抛離故里。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487223331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人命以貴神爲福，遭尅陷則凶禍不祥；五行會凶曜爲","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487239715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"災，喜合殺井食神爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487239715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命虧杀旺，要天赦二德呈祥，身弱財豐，喜","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487256099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃兄弟爲助；月令値貪神健旺，善飮食而資質豐满。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487256099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱有吉","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487272483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曜相扶，堆金積玉；五行無凶殺侵犯，名題聲揚。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487272483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅辰巳亥壘犯，有","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487288867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423355830272"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聰明生發之心；子午卯酉重逢，害酒色荒淫之志。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487288867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人無殺，一貴","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487305251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何妨。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487305251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜逢天月德神，忌見殺官混雜。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487321635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴衆則舞裙歌扇，合多則暗","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487338019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"約偷期。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487338019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行健旺，不遵禮法而行；官殺互逢，定是風聲之配。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487354403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"廻眸","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487370787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倒挿，泛水桃花，沐浴□□，螟蛉重見，多爲奴妾娼妓，少有三貞九","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487370787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"烈，雙魚雙女號淫星，不宜多犯官星七殺曰夫主忌見重逢，寅申","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487370787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"互見，性荒淫，己亥相逢心不已。","logicSentenceId":"7679054184487370787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或有傷官之位，不遠嫁，定主尅夫；","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053671458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨冲梟印之神，非孤離，終須死别。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053671458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱有官鬼入墓，使夫星久入","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053687842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黃泉；歲運臨天絶之宫，俾鴛配分飛異路。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053687842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知女命難婚，運入背","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053704226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫之位。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053704226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲識男兒早娶，定是運合財鄉，","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053720610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子尅重重，殺没官衰，傷食","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053736994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重，傷妻疊疊，財輕身旺弟兄多。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053736994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若不如斯，定是刑冲妻妾位。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053753378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暗合","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053769762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財星，妻妾衆；虚朝財位，主妻多。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053769762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財星入墓，必定刑妻。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053786146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支下伏神，偏","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053802530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"房寵妾。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053802530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻星明朗，喬木相求，","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053818914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰求升合。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053933602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣神旺","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053949986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"處刧財多，或逢偏印尅曰神，非貧夭壽。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053949986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須知乞化，要審榮枯得失，","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053966370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當究輕重淺深。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053966370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官禄殺强，無制則夭，曰衰財重，倘殺則窮。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053982754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更看歳","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053999138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運何凶何吉，身宫冲破無依倚，不離祖必出他鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497053999138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤艮巽，互換","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054015522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朝好，馳騁則心無定主。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054015522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中若逢華葢，犯二德清貴之人；官星七","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054031906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺落空亡，在九流任虚閒之職。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054031906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行尅戰非傷，曰主不爲災；歲運","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054048290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"併臨，若損用神皆有禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054048290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木逢金尅，定主腰協之災；火被水傷，必是","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054064674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"眼目之疾。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054064674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合火神旺盛，尅庚辛，損頭面及膿血之疾。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054081058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如傷日干，","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054097442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及財官太盛，折肢體，有眷戀之災。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054097442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心肺喘满，亦本金火相刑，脾胃","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054113826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"損傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054113826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢因土木戰尅，","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054130210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支水干頭有火，遭水尅，必主腹脴心朦；支火","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054146594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干頭有水，遇火旺則内障睛肓；火土煩焦，蒸四曜，則髮秃眼昏。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054146594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"潤","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054162978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下純潤，元氣返神清骨秀。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054162978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"熒惑乗旺，臨離巽風中失音；太白堅利，","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054179362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423355863040"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合兑坤，兵箭落魄；","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054179362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財星入墓，少許刑冲，必發傷官傷盡，或見宫星","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054195746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054195746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十有八格，當從善惡推求，總繫五行，各取旺衰消息。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054212130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺何","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054228514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劳印綬，身衰不喜財官，中和爲福，偏黨爲災。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054228514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但見貴神朝拱，祿馬","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054244898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飛天，遥合虚邀不得。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054244898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冲格逢合，皆忌七殺官星，各嫌羈絆，填實則","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054261282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054261282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然運到官鄉，當以退身避職。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054277666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬痩官破，困守窮途；禄旺財豐，","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054294050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"崢嶸仕路。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054294050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如臨喜處以得禍，是三合而隱喜星；或逢凶處而返祥，","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054310434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃九宫而露吉曜。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054310434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知職品高低，當求運神向昔清奇，則早歲成。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054326818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名玷缺則晚年得地，運行則一宮十載流年乃逐歲推移，津路通","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054343202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亨，权高爵顯；程途偃蹇，禄薄宫卑。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054343202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推尋子位，先看妻宫，死絶者嫡","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054359586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庶難存；太旺者别門求覔。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054359586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻星𩔰露，子息必多刑害。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054375970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗣害，男女罕","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054392354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054392354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若問兄弟多寡，細檢四柱于支，月令雖强，更看運神向背，死絶","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054408738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑傷，鴈行失序；相生喜慶，棣蕚聊荣。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054408738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟身旺，父命有虧；財帛官","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054425122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多，母年早尅。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054425122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見官鬼出見，母返長年；如逢脱氣排運，父還有壽。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054441506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423355879424"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬臨午位，癸坐巳宫，禀中和兮，祿馬同鄉，遇休因也，胎元絶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054457890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054474274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨申位，庚坐燕寅，巳入巽乾；乙臨雙女，金乘火位，甲坐坤宫，名曰","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054474274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"体囚，最嫌尅制。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054474274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺忌逢言䘮魄，壽星欣遇曰還魂。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054490658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫命能施智","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054507042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"力，難出網羅；造化幽微，乃除功妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054507042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧寒將盡，能令白屋出公卿；奢","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054523426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"侈太過，反使朱門生餓殍；家貲將廢，定生不肖之男。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054523426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054539810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婚媾多刑，","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054556194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必娶無壽之妻妾。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054556194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四宮背禄，不可安求；官将不成，財當見廢；八字","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054572578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無財，須求本分。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054572578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"越外若貪，必招凶事。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054588962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"噫！","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054605346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甘貧養拙，非原憲之不才；","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054621730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼓腹吹笙，使伍員之挫志。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054621730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順則行，逆則棄。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054638114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知命樂天，困窮合義。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054654498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洪","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054670882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"範數終，渊源骨髓。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054670882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"碧渊賦","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054687266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"即捷馳千里，馬同渊源。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嘗謂分二氣以定三財，播四時而成萬物，皆由命令也。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054703650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斯令者，遇","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054720034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四時而立四極，專以日主以定三元，命乃無令而不行，合乃無命","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054720034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"府不立。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054720034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"信知命令之相叅，尤知天地之全體也。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054736418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或云：予□言命皆","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054752802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423355895808"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天命，而非人命欤？","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054752802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天命関乎氣数，人命稟乎五行。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054769186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣數五行何以","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054785570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殊，天命人命何以異？","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054785570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誠哉是理，可得而議矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054801954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然而人命榮枯得失。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054818338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盡在五行生尅之中，富贵貧窮，不出乎八字中和之外。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054834722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先觀氣節","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054851106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之淺深，後看財官之向背。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054851106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之命内，皆不離乎財官；諸格局中，只","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054867490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要虚邀祿馬。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054867490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先賢已成矜式，後學須要變通。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054883874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太過無克制者，貧賤","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054900258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不及，無生扶者，天刑宜向之而違背决之，貧賤，宜背之而運向斷","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054900258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之困窮。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054900258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜生而逢生，贵而堪斷；愛尅而值尅，吉亦可言。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054916642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢官而看","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054933026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財，見財而富贵；逢殺而看","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054933026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"印遇印以榮華，逢印看官而遇官。十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054933026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八贵，逢财忌殺而有殺，十有九貧。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054933026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖木盛逢金，造作棟梁之器；水","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054949410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多遇土，修防提坼之功。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054949410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火炼秋金，鑄作劍鋒之器；木疎季土，培爲","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054965794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"稼穑之禾；火炎有水，名爲既濟之文；水淺金多，號爲體全之象。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054965794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054982178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙運入西方，身旺，功名可許；壬癸路經南局，主徤，財貴堪圖。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054982178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼殺","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054998562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不須逢旺地，食神最喜刼財鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497054998562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未逢於甲乙，富貴無疑；寅午","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055014946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423355912192"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戌遇於丙丁，榮華有凖。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055014946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛局全己酉丑，位重權高；壬癸格得，申","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055031330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子辰，學優才足。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055031330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳局全四季，榮冠諸曹；更值德秀三奇，名揚四","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055047714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"岳。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055047714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木全寅卯辰之方，功名自有；金備申酉戌之地，富貴無虧。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055064098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水歸","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055080482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子丑之源，榮華之客；火臨巳午未之域，显達之人。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055080482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木旺宜火之","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055096866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高輝，秋闇可試；金堅愛水之相涵，文學堪誇。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055096866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用火愁水，用木愁金。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055113250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春木重重，休爲太旺無依；夏火炎炎，莫作太剛有厭。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055129634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋金銳主最","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055146018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲奇；冬水江汪眞可羙。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055146018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"削之剝之爲奇；生我扶我爲忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055162402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁生於","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055178786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冬月，貴乎戊巳當頭；庚辛産於夏天，妙乎𡈼癸得局。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055178786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙秋生，貴","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055195170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜玄武；庚辛夏長，妙用勾陳；丙丁水多嫌北地，逢戊巳，反作貴推。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055195170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛火旺怕南方，遇戊巳反成榮斷甲乙秋生透丙丁，莫作傷看。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055211554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳夏産，露庚辛，當爲貴論。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055227938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火帶水多，貴行木運；土逢木旺，樂入","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055244322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火鄕；庚逢水重，木合金□炎热；戊遇酉多，身衰氣鋭。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055244322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愛熒煌。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055260706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055277090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及喜生扶，太過宜脱剝。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055277090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官殺混雜，身弱則貧；官殺相停，合殺爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679054497055293474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423355928576"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月宫星，早年出仕；日時正貴，晚岁成名。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111255592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胞胎逢印綬，祿亨千鍾；","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111271976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財氣遇長生，肥田萬傾。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111271976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋冬官星逢刃傷，存金去火贵无疑；腊月","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111288360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官喜见，官破印重，傷禍而死。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111288360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財旺生官者，乃贵少而富多；傷官","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111304744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見贵者，又官高而財足。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111304744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無傷不貴，有病者奇。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111321128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理明於後，何必他求。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111337512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖始用之爲奇，宜終去之爲美。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111353896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"審其轻重，毋取一途。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111370280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如十小火炎，","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111386664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇庚辛休作，身旺官輕而取；或木絶而坐金重，逢殺印難爲身弱","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111386664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣旺之断；財輕勿經刼地，顿見妻災。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111386664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼財羊刃，有官殺台閣之臣；","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111403048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸禄倒冲行刃傷，廊廟之士。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111403048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺有殺，行印綬權斷之官；身强主","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111419432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弱，无印綬，遇财星，寿常之辈。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111419432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃偏官有制，應职掌于兵權；正官","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111435816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正印无傷，出仕牧於庶上。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111435816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"润下稼穑給賞之官；子午爲尊位，黄門","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111452200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之客。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111452200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日癸時兼亥丑，魁名及第入翰林；壬曰壬時叠壬辰，高節","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111468584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衣恩登御閣。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111468584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日德見魁罡，遇刑冲，貧寒之士；魁罡見財星，顯得地","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111484968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄食之人；傷官見官，妙入印財之地；財星破印，宜逢比刼之官。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111484968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111501352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423355944960"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢財運逢殺，古亦堪陳；命逢殺，運逢財，凶而可决。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111501352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女遇傷官，歸禄","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111517736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得之極貴；男逢羊刃，身弱隨之爲奇。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111517736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金神飛禄傷官，女命逢之最","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111534120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌；羊亦傷官七殺，男命值之得權；金神入火逢刃殺，貴而無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111534120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111550504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄無官，逢食傷荣而有權；正印無官，居官不显；羊亦七殺，岀仕馳","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111550504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名，身旺無依；僧道之命，桃花滚浪，女妓之流；金弱火絶，土木消磨","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111550504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之匠；身强才淺，金火陶冶之流。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111550504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官逢財而有子；七殺有制亦多","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111566888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兒。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111566888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬被傷，母年早喪；財源被劫，父命先傾。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111583272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男命傷官須損子，女","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111599656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命傷官定尅夫。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111599656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月財官身旺，公显父荣；日時禄馬長生，妻賢子","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111616040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111616040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月中歸禄，無財官，父䘮他邦；年逢禄馬被冲破，公亡外郡；日逢","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111632424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財，時逢劫，妻妾产亡；太歲值殺，月值傷，弟兄不睦；專禄若遇陰錯，","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111632424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外家零落；逐馬如遇阳差，公姑真假。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111632424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲月值殺，有刑害，公父連傷；","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111648808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日神背禄，無財助，妻□離散；","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111648808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正財偏財見合，妻妾姦淫；傷官正官","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111665192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有克破，夫妻刑并。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111665192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺妻傷子，必因食宿遭伤；旺子傷夫，乃是官星","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111681576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423355961344"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"失位。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111681576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女逢財旺生官，夫權必奮；男遇財多身弱，妻話偏聽差錯。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111697960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111714344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰外家冷淡，建刃伏年，祖基微淺；財官生時，逢財旺生官，助國興","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111714344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家之子；正官重見，多生女子少生男；出現偏財，少愛，正妻偏愛妾。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111714344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財星得位，因妻致富成家；官禄歸垣，显己增荣祖業。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111730728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年正官、月傷","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111747112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官，公强父弱；日值財時刼財，父興子敗。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111747112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍全從革之金，且貧且","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111763496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賤；曰虎備潤下之水，曰富曰贵。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111763496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春木荣而水淺，補衲之僧；夏火炎","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111779880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而金衰，簮冠之道。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111779880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳全潤下，奔流之輩；朱雀三合，立武窘弱之","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111796264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徒。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111796264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金剛木弱，行商坐賈之人；土宜水渴，破祖離鄉之客。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111812648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金生秋月","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111829032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重重，貧無寸鐡；火長夏天金疊疊，禄有千鍾。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111829032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"春木水多，貧賤之","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111845416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輩；冬水金盛，𩖀弱之人。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111845416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未遇刑冲，無人不發；","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111861800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午卯酉带","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111861800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑合多者淫訛。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111861800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夏金疊火，秋木重金，非貧且賤；季木盛金，春金多","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111878184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火，不夭則貧。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111878184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"季木無根，從妻福，禄位高崇；夏火失色，配夫菜，功名","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111894568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"显逹。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111894568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火向春林逢水旺，好去求名；土臨季地，見金重，将來出仕。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111910952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111927336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423355977728"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙夏荣土氣厚，功名半許足田庄；丙丁冬旺水源清，爵位全備荣","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111927336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"錦綺。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111927336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專禄带食傷，權掌閫外；羊刃入官殺，威震邊疆。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111943720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱禄夹禄拱","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111960104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，爵禄豊荣；倒冲遥巳欄义，功名显達。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111960104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬趨乾，甲趨艮，清朝之士；","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111976488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛朝陽，乙鼠貴，文學之臣。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111976488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"局全風虎，良将之才；柱備雲龍，大人之","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111992872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"德。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728111992872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四庫全備，龍變化，逢大海爲九五之尊；三奇局秀，鳳騰翔，遇天","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112009256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門乃三六之主。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112009256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺才官而致富，暗禄馬以荣華。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112025640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入格以貴而推，破","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112042024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"局以貧而斷。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112042024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"究一理而察萬端，明片言以通萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112058408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後學術士，毋怠","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112074792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於斯。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112074792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"造微論","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112091176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"淵源古本已載有，今本删去，今增補。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩儀肇闢，六甲攸生，将三元而作三才，建四時而爲四柱。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112107560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"于爲禄","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112123944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本，定一生職位高低；支作命基，佈三限壽元終始。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112123944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年生爲根，月建","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112140328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲苗，日管經营，断中年之休咎；時爲結果，定晚岁之荣枯。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112140328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先推胎","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112156712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"息之由，次入變通之化。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112156712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲官爲貴，缘上下以咸和；多滯","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112173096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"危本根","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112173096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423355994112"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元而相尅。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112173096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是故格清局正，當爲臺閣之臣；印旺官生，必爲鈞衡之","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112189480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"任。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112189480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬頭带劍，鎭壓邊疆；印綬逢華，尊居翰苑。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112205864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄雖多而有害，福不","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112222248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲祥；殺雖重而無伤，刑當不禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112222248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三奇忽遇，才高立解成名；六合正","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112238632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢，家富又能增業。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112238632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡親於寡宿，孤獨躘踵；長生，陷於空亡，貧寒","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112255016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遷蹇。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112255016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花臨帝座，因己因身，咸池更曾日宮，缘妻致富，恨原淺薄。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112271400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢生旺而不榮，本主興隆；遇休因而反結。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112287784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃臨於五魁，定須重","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112304168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"配流徒；勾絞疊於三刑，應是□遭編配。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112304168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以登仕途者，莫逢吞滔，","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112320552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爵禄亏停；當兵权者，勿遇夭中，身權退失，□襟澄徹。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112320552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢因水濟江","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112336936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"湘，學問淵源；本是水居壬癸，慈祥愷悌，木乘甲乙之鄉，眊燥炎陽；","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112336936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火盛丙丁之地，名高祿重。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112336936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾金早會庚辛，貫朽粟陳，鎭土重親戊","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112353320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112353320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木繁而無金斵削，縱榮而不歲孤窮；火炎而無水淘溶，縱發而","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112369704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"早年夭折。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112369704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奥若水之浮泛，惟凭士以隄防。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112386088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土重而無木疏通，速歸","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112402472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愚濁；金堅而無火锻煉，終是凶頑。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112402472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至若金脆火炎，多則損己；木柔","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112418856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423356010496"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金重，利則傷身。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112418856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水清而不假，土多土弱而不禁，木盛火强，燥而微","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112435240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𦕈，水畧濟以寛和。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112435240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須将匀配爲佳，亦以均調爲上。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112451624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大显者貴守深","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112468008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隱，大屈者貴守卑伸。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112468008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽極年高，皆是禄臨帝旺，職崇位𩔰，爲緣馬","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112484392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"會官星。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112484392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"華葢逢空，偏宜僧道；學堂遇貴，惟利師儒。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112500776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行若也蕭索，","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112517160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五命因而低弱。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112517160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日逢空寡，其妻多致生離；時值孤虚，其子多饒不","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112533544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肖。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112533544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"絶宫爲鼓盆之殺，胎宫爲白虎之神，天空臨嗣息之宫，未歲損","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112549928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成家之子。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112549928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運逢吉宿，無木主，則未足歡娱；眼守凶神，有根苗則不","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112566312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須畏懼。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112566312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲君若臨惡矅，一歲迍邅；生時若值休因，一生愁嘆。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112582696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"源清","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112599080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，其流必遠；本濁者，所作無成。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112599080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八字超羣，不貴即當大富；五行駁","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112615464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雜，居安不可慮危。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112615464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"休因者，身性卑微，旺相者，名位壮實。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112631848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先强後弱，","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112648232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必先吉而後凶；始弱終强，亦始凶而終吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112648232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若乃運限所臨之地，憑","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112664616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流年星辰凶吉以定禍福。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112664616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人鑑論：","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112681000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423356026880"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洪濛肇判，甲子攸生。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112697384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"幽𩔰而變通莫測，沉潜於二理尤深。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112713768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十四","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112730152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"字之精神妙用，萬凶萬吉人之灿知。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112730152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日生爲主，年長爲君，先論根","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112746536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本，察貴賤之由易","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112746536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"見。假使粗識深藏之體，孰得而知？葢貴君難吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賤由不易，森刻三才，势□权衡。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112746536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"轻重包罗八卦，自仔規矩方圓天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道尚有盈虧，人事豈無反覆。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112762920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或先貧而終富，或先販而後兴，當捨","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112779304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"短而從長，毋取彼而捨此。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112779304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱俱嫌其一字，大醇亦求其小疵，詳","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112795688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"察其言，毋輕以斷。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112795688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官在禄鄉，伊尹負荷衡之任；時居肯地，□岩興","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112812072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作相之臣。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112812072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生逢貴格，入仕爲臺閣之尊；重叠鬼生，樂道有山林之","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112828456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"興。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112828456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是知居官居貴，五行醇而不疵；多滞多憂，八字雜而又戰。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112844840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"根甘","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112861224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"橘苦，賈誼屈於長沙；源濁流清，太公興於渭水。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112861224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬同鄉而會君","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112877608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臺閣；殺印重旺而早入利名。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728112877608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兄多逢弟，宜嗟范子之貧；穷賢生身，","logicSentenceId":"7679055728341942306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可比老朋之壽。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728341942306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夾官夾貴，日時值而岐字雕梁；刼財奪馬，岁時逢","logicSentenceId":"7679055728341958690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而蓬門雍墉。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728341958690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嗣位尅絕鵲之巢而鳩古之妻；位犯傷鸞之孤而鳳","logicSentenceId":"7679055728341975074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423356043264"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無匹偶。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728341975074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行運背禄，昔曰富而今曰貧；命遇旺身，昨曰悲而今曰笑。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728341991458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱坐學堂之士，回也不愚，三元助墓庫之中。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342007842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"邱之好學。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342024226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年逢官","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342040610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，才高立解成名；時值偏財，家富又添好業。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342040610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚行内地，禱爾於祗；","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342056994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬入戌鄉，胡不遄死。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342056994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伯牛有疾，緣戰尅以交差；司馬何憂，葢比和","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342073378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而無位。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342073378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身中衰弱，逢吉運出爲凶；命坐堅牢，遇禍年而反福，殺須","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342089762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重而多合，何傷日月之明，□雖多而有破，難際風□之會，遇而不","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342089762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342089762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛在壬癸之鄉，憂而不憂；甲乙行丙丁之地。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342106146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或若生逢絶敗，","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342122530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鄭谷歸耕；禄馬病衰，馮唐皓首。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342122530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九宫旺相難逃，邀我桑中。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342138914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱合","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342155298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"和，未免題詩於葉上；西施美貌，自身多带長生，緣珠墜樓，凶惡又","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342155298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢七殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342155298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤鸞入命，妻哭夫而去哭婦，烟花绊身，女求男而男求女，","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342171682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頭目陷而肢体相亏，财有耗而田宅有害。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342171682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生时若遇刑冲，一生屢","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342188066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乏；歲月□临劫夺，百岁孤寒。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342188066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財入財窠，不貴即當大富；殺居太歲，","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342204450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居安不□虑□。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342204450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃若官星透露，未可便作貴推；殺星下攻，□不便","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342220834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423356059648"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲凶兆。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342220834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵歸禄喜逢於印綬，刑殺宜值於濟和。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342237218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以當憂不憂，","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342253602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聞喜不喜。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342253602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"考其根而明其實，論其始而究其終。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342269986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故知失其本而忘","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342286370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其未，不救其實而義有餘。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342286370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以妻宫有尅，少年無少娶之人；鬼位","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342302754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遥傷，未歲損成家之子。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342302754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生平不已而寿算松椿，財禄带多而福姿","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342319138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蒲柳。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342319138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"源清者其流必遠，本壯者其葉必榮。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342335522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三命冠羣，不貴即當大","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342351906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富；九宫弱陷，怕凶運，大忌凶年。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342351906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"千條萬緒，當求不見之形；百派一","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342368290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"源，貴得彌身之地。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342368290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詳陳本末，備察盈虧，澄神定慮，深畧沉機，可考","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342384674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而知，不言而喻。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342384674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後之君子，鑒以前賢。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342401058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言術者十常八九，造首者百","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342417442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無一二。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342417442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辭簡而意微，言近而指遠，爲之賢乎己鑒，命無忽諸","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342433826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謀遠慮。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342532130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"德性居沉靜之宫；術業精微，帝座守文章之舘。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342548514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉福生旺，","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342564898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423356076032"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬全要精神。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342564898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魁罡有靈變之機，離坎乃聰明之户。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342581282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人禄馬宜","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342597666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢，刼刃，空亡可遠。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342597666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長生招君子之可愛，衰敗遇小人之慨嫌。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342614050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342630434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鬪亂兮不仁不義；五行相生兮爲孝爲忠；印綬在刑冲之内，心亂。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342630434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身忘日時，居墓庫之中，憂多樂少。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342646818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日干旺而災咎寡，財命衰而惆","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342663202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帳多。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342
