logicSentenceId":"7679055728342810658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三位相生，一生","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342827042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"稱意。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342827042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官俱旺，應显逹於仕途；財貧均□，豈淹留於白屋。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342843426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄入聚","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342859810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生之地，富贵可知；马奔禄旺之鄉，榮華可斷。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342859810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲取交關利息，須尋","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342876194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合相扶；財官带禄朝元，定主安然獲福。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342876194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月衰時旺，早歳豐肥；木","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342892578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423356092416"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"重土輕，終身漂傷，慣取市纒之利。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342892578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必因旺处，","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342908962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"逢財，忽然显达□家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定是刑冲。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342908962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見貴士本當時，得女以扶持；貴禄有情，因男子而升吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342925346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南啇北旅，定因馬道之通；東販西馳，必是車運之利。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342941730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日千困弱，伯","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342958114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牛敢怨穹蒼；禄馬衰微，顔子難迯短命。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342958114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶莫凶於刼刃，吉草吉則","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342974498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剛强；官微馬劣，男迯女走。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342974498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天羅地網，非横之災；脱命天亡，遇之必","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342990882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不得實而死；窮途逢刼，危疑必犯於自刑；絶處逢財，妻子應難諧","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342990882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老；大耗小耗，多因博戯亡家；官符死符，必主獄訟時有或行，四柱","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342990882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇絶，三命刑傷，未免徒絞之刑，難逃黥面之苦。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728342990882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢五鬼，雷傷虎","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343007266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"咬無疑；更直羣凶，惡殃横死，定斷女多淫賤，男必猖狂。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343007266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或問人之","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343023650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"情性賢愚善惡，先推貴賤旺相之由，衰敗方究。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343023650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"机巧靈變心高者。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343040034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魁罡爲禍，性順者六合爲祥，觀幽閒瀟酒之人，遇華葢孤虚之位。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343056418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好持勢倍覇之輩，犯偏官刼刃之權，刼刃生鄙吝之慳，更出机𨳨","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343072802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之險。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343072802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謀略大因於壬癸，威風氣猛於丙丁。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343089186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤囚遇之無精神，破敗","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343105570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423356108800"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇之多疎坦。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343105570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙順而仁慈大量，庚辛虧而果斷氣剛。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343121954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"燥敗，火盛","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343138338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須疑，隱忍金多定論。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343138338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑戰者愚頑，安静者賢後。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343154722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金木司令而銅生，","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343171106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火土逢時而相助。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343171106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不勞心而衣食自足，不費力而家計自成。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343187490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更若","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343203874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得神扶持，定是權尊鄉里。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343203874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄貴拱位者，臺省揚名。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343220258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其所憂者福不","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343236642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福，其所慮者成不成，禍不禍者，吉處遭凶；成不成者，格局見破。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343236642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343253026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其格者則傷，破其格者則禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343253026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"譬若苗逢秋旱而冬廩空虚，花被春","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343269410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"霜而夏果無成，智謀思慮，措用無成，縱有回天轉軸之机，而無建","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343269410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"功立業之遂。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343269410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈不見酈主烹鼎，范生背廙，淵明東歸，子羙西去；孟","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343285794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"軻不遇，馮衍空回。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343285794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"買臣負新而行歌，江革苦寒而坐泣。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343302178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢苗而不","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343318562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秀者有之，秀而不實者有之。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343318562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更值傷敗太過，一福不適芻蕘；縱有","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343334946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"百藝多能，難免飢寒苦疾，困於溝壑，命使其然爾。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343334946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淹滯無成，何勞","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343351330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嘆嗟。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343351330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲問富貴，全仗財官，朕何由得之。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343367714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大莫大於鎡基，奇莫奇於","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343384098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秀異。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343384098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逹聖達賢者，無時不有；至富至貴者，自古皆然。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343400482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或生申月之","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343416866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423356125184"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中，文高武显；或居冠帶之下，業大財奇。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343416866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若此刻妙，何如推测先論","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343433250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學堂之内，三奇四福，次察格局之外，一吉二宜。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343433250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若巳未見甲午爲","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343449634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祥，壬申见丁巳爲瑞。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343449634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼子丙午，主光風儒雅之人；辛酉丙申，長俊","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343466018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秀荣華之士。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343466018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽全憑純美，造化最喜長生，難辨者日精月華。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343482402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343498786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"測者金堂玉匱，得之者荣，遇之者貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343498786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇賢愚显晦，無非造化鈞陶。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343515170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物既荣枯，爲人豈無成敗。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343531554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假若鳳生於雉，蛇化爲龍，芳蘭不断","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343547938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓬蒿，枯木尤生於山野。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343547938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"少貴老賤，初迍後亨。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728343564322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢由大運之衰旺，以","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652320783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"致富貴之更变。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652320783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格局純而反雜，惆悵殘春；運行老而得時，優游晚","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652337167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"景。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652337167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"防不測運之艱危。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652353551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以時有春有秋，月有圓有缺。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652369935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嘗覌資廕之子，","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652386319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"親一喪而無聊，復見畊釣之人，運一通而殊显，多年爵禄亘俱休。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652386319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時運至者，片時相遇；值生旺者，未必爲凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652402703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有情者通，無情者滯；有","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652419087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合者吉，有冲者凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652419087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官印岁臨仕途，定知進擢；食財運遇庶民，亦喜","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652435471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荣昌。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652435471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或有少依祖父之荣，長借兒孫之貴，又有埀髫難苦，至老無","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652451855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423356141568"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"依。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652451855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢因四柱之旺衰，所由大運之亨否。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652468239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈不見枯槁之木，縱逢春","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652484623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而不荣；茂盛之標，須凌霜而不 {"lines":[{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古有琢磨之玉，值價連城；世有正直之人，自","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652517391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成家計。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652517391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如烹煉之餘而不朽，如歲寒之後而不凋。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652533775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"消息妙在变通，","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652550159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍福當察衰旺，庶幾君子其鍳，是幸","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652550159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲識五行生死訣，容易豈與凡人説。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652582927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星中但以限爲憑，子平但以","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652599311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運爲訣。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652599311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行先布十二宮，看來何格墮時節。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652615695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官印綬與食神，當","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652632079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"知輕重審分明。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652632079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宫星怕臨七殺運，七殺猶畏官星臨。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652648463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星混雜當","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652664847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壽夭，去官留殺子細尋。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652664847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"留官去殺莫逢殺，留殺去官官莫逢。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652681231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官殺","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652697615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受傷人必夭，更宜財格定前程。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652697615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日時偏正問何財，生怕平頭带殺","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652713999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652713999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼若重逢人夭壽，就知偏正甚爲災。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652730383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有財官運須荣發。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652746767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財地官","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652763151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卿是福胎，只怕日干元自弱，財多生殺感身衰。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652763151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財多身弱行財運，","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652779535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423356157952"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此處方知下九台。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652779535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官不逢傷財不絶，壽山高聳豈能推。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652795919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第一限逢","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652812303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬鄉，運生生旺必荣昌。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652812303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官鄉會合遷官職，死絶當頭是禍殃。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652828687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652845071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是逢財來害印，堕崖落水惡中亡。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652845071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲官在任他鄉死，作客逢喪在","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652861455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"路傍。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652861455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印不逢財人不死，如前逐一細推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652877839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官印綬分明説，莫道","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652894223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神非易訣。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652894223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神有氣勝財官。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652910607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只怕傷殘前外截，却分輕重細推","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652926991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詳。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652926991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大忌財官爲死絕，傷官命運莫逢官，斬絞徒流禍百端。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652943375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日德日","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652959759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴逢尅戰，此命危亡立馬看。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652959759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飛入拱禄嫌填实，最怕絆神來犯干。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652976143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子運行年來申子壬寅申地見丙申，己丙一同推禍福。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728652992527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯宫乙木","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653008911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"怕相逢，巳宫戌庚丙辛會。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653008911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午丁年上午戌凶，丑未年中須是禍，但","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653025295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜遷運而捜尋。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653025295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同官同運如逢運，逢禄刑禍來相侵。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653041679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外逢仍遠逢","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653058063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内敵，其餘官分外方𡬶。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653058063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外逢内敵爲災重，内逢外敵禍微侵。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653074447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653090831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土皆分四季，雜氣之中難又易，逐一依定數中推。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653090831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受制受刑隨運","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653107215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，只定其凶此運中，何年月日災刑重。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653107215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此是石金玉匣訣，只此泄","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653123599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423356174336"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"漏與君知。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653123599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以日爲主，專論財官。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653156367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢官乃爲扶身之本，財爲養命之原，故推天","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653172751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時，察地利，約大過而不反，以中和而爲用。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653172751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"去留舒配而中理，輕重","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653189135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"强弱而表正。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653189135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先觀節氣之深淺，後論財官之向背。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653205519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之命内，皆不","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653221903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離乎財官，諸格局中，總要虚邀禄馬。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653221903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先賢已成矜式，後學須自亦","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653238287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"通。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653238287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜何之而運昔决之貧賤官背之面，运向断之，困弱喜生以逢。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653254671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生貴而可取，受尅而値尅，吉而堪言，逢官而堪財，見財富貴；逢殺","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653271055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而看印，遇印荣華；逢印看官而遇官，八而七貴；逢財看殺原有殺，","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653271055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十有九貧。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653271055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙運入西方，身旺功名可許；壬癸路經南城，主徤","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653287439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653287439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印財不宜身旺地，食神最喜刼財鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653303823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官殺混雜，身弱則貧。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653320207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653336591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺兩停，合殺兩貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653336591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月官星，早年出仕；日時正貴，晚歲得名。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653352975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"胞胎","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653369359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢印綬，禄享千鍾；財氣遇長生，田肥萬頃。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653369359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋冬官星逢刃，傷存全","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653385743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423356190720"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"去，火貴無疑；臘月傷官喜見官破印重傷而禍死。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653385743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財旺生官者何，","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653402127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴少而富多；傷官見官者何，官高而冨足。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653402127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無傷不貴，有病为奇，宜","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653418511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當棄之；理妙於斯，何必外取。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653418511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如炎火木少，遇庚辛，休作身旺官輕","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653434895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而取；或土重水絶，逢壬癸，難作身旺官輕而决。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653434895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財輕莫逢刧地，印","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653451279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多最妙財鄉；財旺生官，用禄取貴；殺星制刃，刼实圖名；身旺偏財","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653451279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何取，必取横財主捷；正財偏刼，頻見妻災。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653451279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653467663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼財羊刃，入官煞臺","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653484047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閣之臣；歸禄倒冲逢刃，傷廊廟之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653484047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺有煞逢印綬權断之官；","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653500431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主弱逢印，見財星，尋常之客。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653500431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽刃傷官有制，膺職掌於兵刑；正官","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653516815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正印無傷，出仕牧其士庶。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653516815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財旺稼穡，給餉之官；飛禄朝陽，侍廷之","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653533199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653533199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤本清氣，幾國之荣；子午爲極尊，黄門之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653549583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸時癸時兼","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653565967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥丑，魁名及第入翰林；壬日壬時叠寅辰，高爵承恩登御関。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653565967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日德","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653582351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見魁罡，終吉運，贫寒之士；魁罡見財，官氏得地衣禄之人。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653582351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官見","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653598735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官，妙入財印之地；財星破印，貴行比刼之中。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653598735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命逢財，運逢殺，吉而","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653615119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423356207104"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堪言；命逢殺，運逢財，凶而可决。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653615119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女多傷，官歸禄，得之極吉；男逢羊。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653631503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刃身弱遇之爲奇，金神歸禄攔义，女命逢之最忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653647887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃傷官七殺，","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653664271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男子植之得權；金神入火，逢殺刃，貴而無疑；殺重有印，逢食傷，荣","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653664271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而自有。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653664271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正官正印，居官不显；羊刃七殺，出牧馳名；身旺無依，僧道","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653680655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之例，桃花滚浪，娼妓之流。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653680655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金弱火强，土木消溶之匠；土多水淺，行","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653697039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"商針線之工。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653697039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五湖雲遶，始荣終辱，己身貧；遍野桃花，一世風流多","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653713423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酒色。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653713423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神拱煞，盗賊之徒；秀氣失時，清名之士。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653729807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印旺身强多嗜酒，","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653746191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丁壬姤合犯淫訛。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653746191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身印俱强，平生少病；天月德助，處世無殃。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653762575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"食神","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653778959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺，勝似財官貴全。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653778959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官殺有棄命就財就殺就官者，有餘富貴無","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653795343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"依。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653795343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專旺絶食絶財絶官者，無限。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653811727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貧窮身弱，棄命要無根，官居宰輔，","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653828111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主衰身化，得其時，位近天廷。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653828111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男命類屬從化，照返鬼仍。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653844495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命純和","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653860879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"清貴，濁益淫娼，宜細詳之。","logicSentenceId":"7679055728653860879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽木無根，主於丑月，水多轉貴，金多則折。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236148239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇乙木無根，","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236164623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生臨丑月，金多轉貴，火多則折。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236164623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇丙火無根，子申金見，","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236181007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無制無生，此身貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236181007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇六甲坐申，三重見子，運至北方，","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236197391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須防横死。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236197391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙臨申位，陽水大忌，有制身强，旺成名利。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236213775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己入亥月，怕逢陰木，月逢印生，自然成福。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236230159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己日逢殺，","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236246543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印旺財伏，運轉東南，貴高財足。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236246543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇壬寅壬戌，陽土透露，","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236262927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不混官星，名崇显禄。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236262927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰水無根，火鄉有貴；陽木無根，","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236279311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火鄉即畏。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236279311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉陰柔不留多火，比肩透露，格中返忌","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236295695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成寅□主，何愁殺旺，露火成名，水来漂荡。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236295695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚年日主，","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236312079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423356354560"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"支火炎炎，見土取貴，見水爲賢。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236312079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辛身弱，卯提入格。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236328463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉身弱，見財成格。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236344847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳無根，火土見重，透财名彰，","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236361231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露根則賤，","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236361231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙無根，怕逢申酉，殺合逢之，𩀱目必朽。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236393999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲木無根，","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236410383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生於丑月，水多轉貴，金土則折。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236410383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙木酉月，見水爲奇。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236426767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有根丑絶，無則寅危。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236443151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇乙木坐酉，庚丁透露，二庫歸根，","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236459535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤神得失。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236459535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙火申提，無根從殺，有根而旺，脱根壽促。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236475919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷火無根，水鄉必忌；陰火無根，水鄉有救。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236492303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇陰火酉月，","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236508687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"棄命就財，北方入格，南則爲災。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236508687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳亥月，身弱爲棄。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236525071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"印月同推，嫌根刼北。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236541455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚金無根，寅宫火局，南方有貴，","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236557839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須防壽促。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236557839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳陰柔，休凶官殺，運限加金，聰明显達。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236574223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日戌提，癸于未月，運喜東方，逢冲則絶。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236590607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"棄命從財，","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236606991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423356370944"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須要会財；棄命從殺，須要會殺。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236606991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從財忌殺，從殺喜財","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236623375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命逢根氣，命塤無猜。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236623375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五言獨步：","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236639759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有病方爲貴，無傷不是奇。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236656143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格中如去病，財禄兩相隨。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236672527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯多金丑，貧富高低走。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236688911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南北怕逢申，北方休見酉。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236705295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"健禄生提月，財官喜透天。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236721679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不宜身再旺，惟喜茂財源。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236738063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土厚多逢火，歸金旺玉。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236754447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秋冬天水泛泛，名利總虚浮。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236770831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙生居卯，金多反吉祥。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236787215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不宜重見殺，火地得衣糧。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236803599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火忌西方酉，金沉怕水鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236819983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木神休見午，水到卯中傷。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236836367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土宿休行亥，臨官在巳官。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236852751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南方根有旺，西北莫作逢。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236869135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰日朝陽格，無根月建辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236885519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"西方還有貴，丁怕火來侵。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236901903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙木生居西，嘆逢全己丑。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236918287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴坎離宫，貧窮申酉守。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236934671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有殺","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236951055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"只。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論殺，無殺","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236951055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論用。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729236951055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只要去殺星，不怕提綱重。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927405568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583007423356387328"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙居逢申，殺印暗相生。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927421952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木旺金逢旺，冠袍必掛身。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927438336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離火怕重逢，北方反有功。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927454720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然宜見水，猶恐将提冲。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927471104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八月官星旺，甲逢秋氣深。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927487488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財官兼有助，名利自然亨。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927503872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曲直生春月，庚辛于土逢。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927520256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南離推富貴，坎地却猶凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927536640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙生三月，庚辛戌未存。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927553024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑官𡈼戌位，何慮見無根。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927569408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木茂宜金火，身衰鬼作関。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927585792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時分西與北，輕重辨東西。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927602176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時上胞胎格，月逢印綬通。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927618560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺官行運助，職位至三公。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927634944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二子不冲午，二寅不冲申。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927651328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得三分三格，財官印綬全。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927667712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運中逢尅破，一命長黄泉。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927684096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進氣死不死，退氣生不生。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927700480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終年無發旺，猶忌少年刑。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927716864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時上偏財格，干頭忌比肩。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927733248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月生逢主旺，貴氣復重添。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927749632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行十載數，上下五年分。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927766016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先看流年岁，深知來在旬時上一位貴藏在支中。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927782400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927798784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日主要剛强，名利方有氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927798784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正月寅宫元是木，木生火旺土長生。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927831552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊兼午未官中喜，","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927847936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申酉休囚數莫行。","logicSentenceId":"7679055729927847936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2389","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天爲吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2390","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"死木休囚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2391","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"者，視金□。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2392","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"相看棟梁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2393","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陽木也，火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2394","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"弱不能尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2395","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金金沉不。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2396","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"能剋木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2397","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"活水陽木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2398","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"忌金□死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2399","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金土理也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2400","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"活木休因。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2401","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也，眞珠辛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2402","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金也，弱柳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2403","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬午，癸未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2404","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"喬松。庚寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2405","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辛卯，木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2406","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"言一生一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2407","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"就一旺一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2408","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"衰一扶之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2409","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2410","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583008913072472073"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終非治木之基；廢鐡銷金，豈是滋流之本。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001295924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木盛能令金白，缺，王而","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001312308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"反被水相欺。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001312308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火無木則終其光，木無火則晦其質。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001328692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乙木秋生，拉朽","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001345076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"摧枯之易也；庚金冬死，沉沙墜海，豈難乎。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001345076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凝雲之草，奚用逢金。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001361460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001377844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"士乏金，不能勝木。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001377844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火木熖而先烟，水旣徃而猶濕。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001394228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大扺水寒不流，","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001410612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木寒不發，土寒不生，火寒不烈，金寒不鎔，皆非天地之正氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001410612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001426996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物初生，未成而成，久則滅，其超凡人聖之機，脫死回生之妙，不","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001426996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"象而成，不形而化。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001426996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"固用不如固木，花繁豈若根深。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001443380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如扎金戀水","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001459764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而沉形，南木飛灰而脫休，東水旺木以枯木枯源，西土實金而虛。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001459764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己火因土，晦皆大過，五行貴在中和。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001476148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以理求之，愼勿苟言，掬盡寒","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001492532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"潭須見底。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001492532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元一氣兮先天，禀淸濁兮自然。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001525300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓍三才以爲象，播四氣以爲年。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001541684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001558068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干爲祿，以向背定貧冨；以支爲命，詳順逆以循環。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001558068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運行則一辰十","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001574452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2454","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583008913072488457"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"載，折除乃三曰爲年。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001607220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"折除者，乃一年二十四氣，七十二侯。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001623604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命有節","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001639988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣淺深，用之而爲妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001639988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其爲氣也，將來者進，成功者退，如蛇在灰，如","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001656372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鱔在塵。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001656372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣者，四時向背之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001672756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其爲有也，是從無而立有；其爲無","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001689140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也，天埀象以爲文。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001689140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此五行臨於絶地，而建貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001705524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行絶處有祿馬，","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001721908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其爲常也，立仁立義；其爲事也，或見或聞。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001721908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"崇爲實也，竒爲貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001738292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"將","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001754676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星扶德，太乙加臨；木主休囚，行藏泪沒。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001754676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至若勾陳得位，不虧小信","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001771060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以成仁；眞武當權，知是大財而分端。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001771060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不木不義，庚辛與甲乙交争，","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001787444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或是或非，壬癸與丙丁相畏。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001787444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故有先賢謙己，處俗求仙。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001803828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"崇釋則離","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001820212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宮修定，歸道乃水府求玄。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001820212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見不見之形，無時不有；抽不抽之緖，萬","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001836596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古聯綿。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001836596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以何公惧其七殺，宜父畏以元辰。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001852980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"峨眉闡以三生，無全","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001869364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"士庻；鬼谷布其九命，約以星觀。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001869364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今集諸家之要，畧其偏見之能。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001885748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001902132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以未解曲通，玅須神悟。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001902132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臣出自蘭野，幼墓眞風。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001918516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入肆無懸壺之𡭹，","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001934900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遊街無化杖之神。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001934900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"息一氣以疑神，消五行而通道。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001951284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤立其牝牡，","logicSentenceId":"7679066809001967668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2504","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583008913072504841"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金木定其剛柔。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002000436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晝夜分爲君臣，節時分爲父子。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002016820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不可一途而取，不","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002033204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可一理而推。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002033204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時有冬逢炎熱，夏草遭霜，類有陰鼠棲水，神龜宿火。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002049588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以陰陽罕測，志物難窮。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002065972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵一冬暑少，九夏陽多，禍福有若禎。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002082356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祥術士希其八九。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002098740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或若生居休敗，早歳空亡；若遇徤旺之鄕，連年","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002115124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偃蹇。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002115124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若乃初凶後吉，相源濁而流淸；始吉終凶，狀根甘而裔若。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002131508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002147892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乎萌兆，察以其元根。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002147892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其苗先實，從花後胎生元命，三獸定其門宗；","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002164276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"律呂宮商，五虎論其成敗。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002164276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無合有合，後學難知；得一分三，前賢不","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002180660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"載。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002180660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年雖逢於冠帶，尚有徐災；運將至於衰鄉，猶披尠福。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002197044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大叚天元","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002213428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羸弱，宮吉不及以爲營；日下興隆，月凶不能成其咎。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002213428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇尊凶卑","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002229812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，救療無功，尊吉甲","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002229812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2527","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凶逢災自。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愈，祿有三會，災有五期。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002229812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶多吉少，","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002246196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"類大過之初交；福淺禍深，喻同人之九五。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002246196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聞喜不喜，是六甲之虧；","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002262580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當憂不憂，頼五行之救助。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002262580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八孤臨於五墓，戌未東行；六虛下於空","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002278964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡，自乾南首。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002278964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2541","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孤虚空亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2542","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之日如甲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2543","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"干旬世人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002311732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2545","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戌亥爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2546","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583008913072521225"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天元一氣，定侯伯之","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002311732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2548","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"尊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荣支；作人元，運商徒而得失。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002311732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若乃身旺鬼","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002328116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"絶，雖破命而長生；鬼班身𧙴，逢建祿而壽天；背祿逐馬，守窮途而","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002328116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酒惶。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002328116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祿馬同鄕，不三合而入座。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002344500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官崇位顯，定知夾祿之鄕；小盈大","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002360884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虧，恐是刧財之地。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002360884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生月帶祿，八仕居赫奕之尊；重犯奇儀，藴籍抱","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002377268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出羣之器。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002377268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰男陽女，時觀出入之年；陰女陽男，更看元辰之歲。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002393652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002410036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地之相逢，宜退身而避位。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002410036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶㑹吉會，返吟伏吟。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002426420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰錯陽差，天衝地","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002442804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"擊。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002442804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或逢四殺五鬼，六害七傷，天羅地網，三元九宮。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002459188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福臻成慶，禍并","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002475572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"危疑。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002475572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"扶兮速速，抑乃遲遲。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002491956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歴貴地而待時，遇比肩而爭競。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002508340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至若人","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002524724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疲馬劣，猶托財旺之鄕。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002524724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或乃財旺祿衰，徤馬何避。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002541108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"掩衝歲臨尚不","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002557492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲災；年登故宜獲福。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002557492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大吉生逢小吉反壽長年，天罡運至，天魁繼。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002573876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生績壽從魁抵蒼龍之宿，財自天來，天㣫臨昴胃之鄕，人元有害。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002590260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金祿窮於正首，庚重辛輕，木人困於金鄕。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002606644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅深卯淺，竗在識其通","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002623028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變，拙説猶神。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002623028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巫瞽昧於調絃，難希律呂；庚辛臨於甲乙，君子可以","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002639412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2587","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583008913072537609"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求官；北人運至南方，貿易獲其厚利，開朝懽而旋至。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002655796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲盛火之炎","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002672180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，尅禍福之遥，則多因於水土，金木未能成器，聽衰樂以難明。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809002672180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似","logicSentenceId":"7679066809667944500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木盛而花繁，狀宻雲而不兩。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809667944500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乗軒本冕，金火何多；位列班卑，陰陽","logicSentenceId":"7679066809667960884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不定，","logicSentenceId":"7679066809667960884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以龍唫虎嘯，風雨助其休祥；火勢將興，故先烟而後熖。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809667977268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆見凶","logicSentenceId":"7679066809667993652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中有吉，吉乃尤凶；吉中有凶，凶爲吉兆。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809667993652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍旬向未，言福可以近推；","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668010036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"纔八衰鄉，論災宜其逆課。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668010036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男迎女送，否泰交居；陰陽二氣，逆順折","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668026420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"除。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668026420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占其金木之內，顯於方所分野；標其南北之閒，恐不利於徃來。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668042804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一旬之內，於年中而問月；一歲之中，亦月中而問日。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668059188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"向三避五，指","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668075572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方靣以窮通；審吉查凶，述歲中之否泰。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668075572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅丁卯，秋天宜以保持；","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668091956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳戊辰，度乾宮而脫厄。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668091956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"値病憂 66809668468788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"須要制其神殺，輕重","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668485172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"較量，身尅殺而尚輕，殺尅身而尤重。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668485172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於循環八卦，因河洛以爲","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668501556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

enceId":"7679066809668698164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"災自奢生，迷而不返，禍從惑起，殊當易從，復處爲","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668714548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萌。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668714548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福善禍淫，吉凶冀兆。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668730932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於公明季玉，尚無變識之文；景繐仲舒，","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668747316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本哉比形之妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668747316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詳其徃聖，益以前賢。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668763700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或指事以陳謀，或約文而切","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668780084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668780084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多或少利，二義難精。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668796468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今者叅詳得失，補綴道踪，規爲心鑒，汞掛","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668812852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淸瑩，引列終緒，十希得九","logicSentenceId":"7679066809668812852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
