{"lines":[{"lineId":"2735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正財偏財見比肩分奪，刧財羊刃，又見嵗運冲合，必死。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669091380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官之格，財旺身弱，官殺重見，混雜羊刃，歲運又見，必死。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669107764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破敗殘","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669124148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷，","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669124148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"2739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱祿拱貴塡實，又見官沖刃，歲運見卽死。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669140532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2740","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7583008913072603145"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日祿歸時，刑冲破書見七殺，官星空亡，冲刃必死。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669156916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺官大忌，歳運","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669173300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相併必死。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669173300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘諸格，並忌殺及塡實，歲運併臨，必死。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669189684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲諸凶神惡殺，印綬空","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669206068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亡、吊客、墓病死宮諸殺，十死九生。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669206068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星太歲，財多身弱，元犯七殺","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669222452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身輕，有救則吉，無救則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669222452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金多夭折，木盛飄流，木旺則天，土多痴","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669238836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𣏁，火多頑愚，大過不及。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669238836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作此論，一不可拘，二須敢斷，必須理㑹論","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669255220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，求其生死要矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669255220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"2753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"會耍命書說","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669271604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫造命書，先賢已窮盡天地精微之藴而極矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669287988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自唐李虛中一行","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669304372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禪師，宋徐升東齋，明王銓醉醒子諸公登覺，淵海淵源，其理雷同，","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669304372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至矣盡矢，無非木火土金水之微妙耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669304372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今之後學加增旨意口訣，","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669320756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫非先賢己發之餘意，大同小異。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669320756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今將海洲一書合成一集一覧。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669337140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"2761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"便知不心齊究二書之旨，刪繁去簡，永爲矜式。","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669353524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"2762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卷五終","logicSentenceId":"7679066809669369908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
